Job Description:

We are looking for a Part-Time Virtual Clinical Trial Navigator (Medical Doctor) based in the Philippines to provide one-on-one support to patients and families navigating the clinical trial process. This role requires strong medical knowledge, patient advocacy, and coordination skills, as well as experience in clinical research, patient education, or healthcare navigation. The ideal candidate will assist patients in understanding clinical trials, finding suitable studies, answering questions, and facilitating communication between research teams and participants.

This is a remote, part-time position with the opportunity to transition to full-time. Candidates must be willing to work overlapping hours with USA time zones.

Key Responsibilities:

    • Provide personalized guidance to patients and families considering clinical trials.
    • Assist in trial searches, helping patients identify suitable studies based on their diagnosis, medical history, and location.
    • Answer questions regarding trial participation, including eligibility, safety, travel, expenses, and potential risks.
    • Identify primary point of contact for clinical trial enrollment at various locations.
    • Facilitate communication between patients and research teams, ensuring a smooth connection with study coordinators.
    • Offer patient education and resources to help participants understand the trial process and make informed decisions.
    • Advocate for patients’ needs, ensuring they receive the best possible support throughout the clinical trial journey.
    • Overtime transitions more of a management role as the team of Trial Navigators grows.

Qualifications:

  • Must be a Licensed Medical Doctor (MD) based in the Philippines.

  • Clinical experience in patient care, oncology, research, or trial navigation is highly preferred.

  • Strong understanding of clinical trials, research protocols, and eligibility criteria.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to provide medical guidance to patients and families.

  • Experience in clinical research, patient advocacy, or case management is a plus.

  • Familiarity with HIPAA regulations and patient confidentiality standards.

  • Ability to work remotely, with a stable internet connection and professional setup.

  • Availability to work part-time with overlapping hours in USA time zones.

jobs.description:
Head of IT & Security

About us:

At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours. As leaders in the heavy-duty repair industry, we power shops with technology that helps them run smarter and more efficiently. As an AI-First company, we invite artificial intelligence to eliminate friction, spark innovation, and drive efficiencies in every conversation— for our teams and our customers. Fullbay is the number one cloud-based shop management software for commercial repair shops and is growing fast. This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing team and help shape the next phase of growth for the company.

Position Overview:

Fullbay's Security and IT Manager owns two functions that are usually split across two people: the security program that keeps Fullbay's systems, people, and customer data safe, and the IT operations that keep the business running day to day. Reporting to the VP of IT, this role designs the security and IT program from the ground up and owns its execution end-to-end — there's no existing playbook to inherit and no separate team to hand the work to.

This role is well-suited to someone who has built a security program before, not just operated inside one — someone comfortable being the primary responder when an MDR alert escalates, the person who leads SOC 2 through an actual audit, and the same person who's also the company's escalation point when someone's laptop won't image. This is a player-coach role: you set the standards, and you personally execute the work.

Success here looks like passing SOC 2 audits with no major findings, on schedule; security incidents that get triaged, contained, and resolved fast enough that they stay incidents, not breaches; IT support that doesn't make employees wait, with devices provisioned before day one and tickets closed without a saga; and a risk posture leadership can see clearly at any time, not just when an audit forces the question.

The Right Wrench for the Job

A shop's most dangerous moments are never the ones people see coming. The person who wires the electrical panel, checks the fire suppression, and makes sure the alarm actually calls someone when it goes off isn't thinking about any one repair — they're thinking about what keeps the whole building standing. This role does that for Fullbay's systems and data, and then still picks up the phone when someone's laptop won't turn on.

You're the right fit if you've built a security program from a blank page before — not just operated inside one someone else designed — and you know the difference between a control that looks good on paper and one that actually holds up when an auditor or an attacker tests it. You can walk into a SOC 2 evidence review in the morning, triage a real MDR alert at noon, and still be the person who gets a new hire's laptop imaged and ready before their first day.

This isn't the role for someone who wants to own strategy and hand off the keyboard. If your instinct is to write the policy and let someone else enforce it, this isn't your shop. But if you're the kind of person who'll design the program, defend it to an auditor, and still crawl under the desk to fix a network cable — we'd like to talk.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Security Program Ownership: Design, build, and continuously improve Fullbay’s security program using NIST CSF 2.0 as the governance architecture and CIS Controls v8.1 (IG1 to IG2) as the tactical execution roadmap.
  • Security Operations Oversight: Manage Fullbay’s always-on MDR platform, which provides automated threat detection and triage across endpoints and cloud environments. Serve as the primary responder for escalated alerts requiring human judgment, and lead investigation, containment, and remediation for confirmed incidents, including participation in an on-call rotation for high-severity escalations.
  • SOC 2 Readiness and Audit Management: Lead all SOC 2 readiness activities including control mapping, evidence collection, gap remediation, and audit firm coordination for Type I and Type II engagements.
  • Tool and Platform Governance: Own and configure Fullbay’s security tooling stack, including the MDR platform, MDM, email security, anti-phishing, and security awareness training. Tune and maintain tools to Fullbay standards, and evaluate new tools or vendors as needed.
  • Policy and Standards Development: Author, maintain, and enforce information security policies, standards, and procedures across the organization. Ensure policies align with regulatory requirements and audit frameworks.
  • Identity and Access Management: Oversee IAM posture across Google Workspace, including passkeys, MFA, SSO, and privileged access controls, including MDM and Apple Business Manager configuration.
  • Incident Response: Develop and own the incident response plan. Serve as the primary responder for security events escalated by the MDR platform or identified through other internal monitoring. Lead response activities and post-incident reviews.
  • Risk Management: Maintain a risk register. Identify, assess, and track security risks across people, process, and technology. Communicate risk posture to the VP of IT and senior leadership.
  • Security Awareness: Oversee the security awareness training program, including phishing simulations and compliance-based training cycles.
  • Vendor and Third-Party Risk: Assess security posture of third-party vendors and new software applications. Maintain a vendor risk inventory and drive remediation for identified gaps.
  • End-User IT Support: Serve as the primary escalation point for company-wide technical support, resolving hardware, software, network, and account issues for employees across the organization.
  • Device & Asset Lifecycle Management: Own procurement, provisioning, and deprovisioning of company devices, coordinating imaging and configuration through Apple Business Manager and NinjaOne, and maintaining an accurate IT asset inventory.
  • SaaS Application Administration: Manage user provisioning, licensing, and configuration across Fullbay’s core SaaS applications, including Google Workspace and other business tools, ensuring accounts are created, modified, and deactivated promptly.
  • Onboarding & Offboarding: Own the IT components of employee onboarding and offboarding, including account creation, device setup, access provisioning, and timely access removal.
  • IT Vendor & Procurement Management: Manage relationships and contracts with IT vendors and service providers, evaluate new tools, and control IT spend.
  • Adheres to all confidentiality and compliance regulations.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Minimum Education & Work Experience:

  • 7-10 years of combined experience across IT operations and security, cybersecurity, or information security required; 10+ years preferred.
  • Experience managing and responding to alerts from an MDR/EDR platform, including triage, investigation, and remediation of confirmed incidents, required.
  • Demonstrated experience owning a compliance or regulatory program (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, or equivalent) required.
  • SOC 2 audit experience (Type I or Type II) strongly preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Hands-on experience administering Google Workspace, MDM platforms (e.g., NinjaOne, Apple Business Manager), and providing general end-user IT support required.

Key Skills and Qualifications:

  • Deep knowledge of security frameworks including NIST CSF 2.0 and CIS Controls v8.1.
  • Working knowledge of MDR/EDR platforms and MDM solutions, with the ability to investigate and respond to escalated alerts.
  • Required platform experience: Google Workspace administration and security configuration, Apple Business Manager (ABM), NinjaOne endpoint management.
  • Preferred platform experience: Proofpoint email security, Ironscales anti-phishing.
  • Strong understanding of IAM concepts including SSO, MFA, passkeys, and privileged access management.
  • Ability to operate as a player-coach: design the security program, set the standards, and personally execute the work.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present security risk and program status to executive leadership.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Engineering, Legal, Finance, and business stakeholders.
  • Preferred certifications: CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCSP, CompTIA Security+, or CASP+.
  • Strong general IT troubleshooting skills across Mac and Windows environments, networking fundamentals, and common business SaaS applications.
  • Experience with IT ticketing/helpdesk systems and asset management tools.

jobs.excerpt: Please note: This role is posted as Customer Support & Monitoring Specialist - Emergency Response for candidate sourcing purposes only.
jobs.description:
Please note: This role is posted as Customer Support & Monitoring Specialist - Emergency Response for candidate sourcing purposes only. The official title for this position is Wildfire Response Specialist

Please note: We do not accept unsolicited candidate introductions, referrals, or resumes from external recruiters or staffing agencies.

Location: Remote (U.S. based). This role supports Frontline customers in every market we serve and requires availability for rotating shifts, including overnights, weekends, and holidays. Candidates located in PST/MST time zones are preferred.

Background Check Requirement

As part of our hiring process, Frontline Wildfire Defense conducts comprehensive background checks for all new hires. These checks typically cover the past 7–10 years and may include employment and education verification. For roles that require work in the field, driving record verification is also required. Employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of these background checks.

About Frontline Wildfire Defense

Founded in 2017, Frontline developed the first fully integrated wildfire defense system to stop the leading cause of home loss in wildfires: ember-driven ignition. The system combines exterior sprinklers, full-coverage design, and connected software for remote monitoring and response, allowing homes to protect themselves long after families evacuate or infrastructure fails.

Proven effective during the 2025 Los Angeles wildfires, 96% of homes with Frontline systems survived. That success has earned top industry recognition, including Frontline being recognized as one of TIME’s Best Inventions 2025 in the Green Tech category and receiving the PCBC Gold Nugget Award for “Most Innovative Housing Concept” and the Best of IBS Award for “Best Home Technology.”

As wildfires grow hotter and more frequent, our vision is to give people the tools and strategies to live safely with fire. We’re building a mission-driven team creating real-world solutions in wildfire safety and climate tech.

About This Opportunity

When a wildfire is moving toward a Frontline customer’s home, you will be the calm, knowledgeable voice on the other end of the line. As a Wildfire Response Specialist, you will be part of Frontline’s dedicated 24/7 response team, helping homeowners and commercial customers make sure their wildfire defense systems are ready, running, and doing their job when it matters most.

Every Frontline system is designed to protect a property even after its owners have evacuated. Our fire-tracking software alerts customers when a wildfire comes within 10 miles and starts an automatic activation countdown. Each system has a connected controller with Wi-Fi, cellular, and satellite connectivity and a backup battery. When it activates, eave sprayers and roof rotors wet the home and up to 30 feet around it with water and Class A foam, switching to a pool, tank, or well if water pressure drops. Your job is to make sure the people behind those systems are never on their own: before, during, and after a fire.

You will answer inbound calls and messages around the clock, reach out proactively to customers in a fire’s path, troubleshootsystem and connectivity issues in real time, and coordinate with our engineering and field service teams so every issue is resolved. Off-peak, you will help customers get ready for fire season and help us build the playbooks, tools, and processes this team runs on. This is a remote, hourly role with rotating shifts.

Key Responsibilities

Active Fire Response

  • Monitor active wildfire incidents and Frontline’s fire-tracking alerts, identify customers within alert range, and prioritize outreach based on fire proximity. behavior, and evacuation status.
  • Proactively contact customers in a fire’s path to confirm they received their alerts and understand their system’s status, and guide them through activation or override decisions in the Frontline app.
  • Verify system readiness in real time, including controller connectivity, backup battery, water pressure, and secondary water source, and resolve or escalate issues immediately.
  • Provide calm, clear guidance to customers who are evacuating or under stress, always reinforcing that personal safety and official evacuation orders come first.
  • Track incidents using official sources (e.g., CAL FIRE, InciWeb, National Weather Service Red Flag Warnings, and local evacuation zone maps) and share accurate, timely updates with customers and internal teams.
  • Log system activity and performance during fire events, including activation, runtime, water source changes, and faults, and escalate failures to on-call engineering and field service without delay.

24/7 Customer Support

  • Respond to inbound calls, texts, emails, and app messages from homeowners and commercial customers at any hour, in fire season and out of it.
  • Troubleshoot the Frontline app, controller, alerts, and connectivity (Wi-Fi, cellular, and satellite) over the phone, and walk customers through solutions step by step.
  • Follow a defined escalation matrix to bring in engineering, field service, or leadership when an issue goes beyond first-line support, and own the issue through resolution.
  • Create and manage service tickets and dispatch requests so field technicians have everything they need to act.
  • Keep detailed, accurate records of every interaction, decision, and follow-up in our ticketing and customer systems.

Post-Fire Recovery

  • Follow up with every affected customer after a fire event to confirm system status and schedule foam and water refills, inspections, or repairs with our field service team.
  • Document system performance and property outcomes after each event so the data can inform product improvements and Frontline’s performance reporting.

Readiness & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead proactive readiness check-ins before fire season and during Red Flag Warnings: confirm the app is installed, contacts are current, and systems are healthy.
  • Help build and refine the response playbooks, call scripts, escalation protocols, and knowledge base this team will run on.
  • Spot recurring issues and customer pain points and share them with Product, Engineering, and Field Services so we fix root causes, not just symptoms.
  • Performs additional related tasks as assigned.

Qualifications

Must-Have:

  • 2+ years in a high-pressure, customer-facing role such as emergency dispatch, alarm or central station monitoring, a network operations center, crisis support, or technical support for connected devices.
  • A calm, steady presence under pressure, with proven ability to de-escalate distressed callers and communicate clearly and with empathy.
  • Comfort troubleshooting connected technology over the phone (apps, Wi-Fi, cellular devices, controllers) and explaining it in plain language.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to prioritize quickly when several urgent situations happen at once.
  • Strong documentation habits and experience with ticketing or CRM systems.
  • Availability to work rotating shifts, including overnights, weekends, and holidays, and to take on extra shifts or on-call time during active fire events.
  • A quiet, private home workspace with reliable high-speed internet and a backup connectivity plan.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace (Gmail, Sheets, Docs, Drive) and Slack.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.

Nice to Have:

  • Emergency communications or monitoring training as APCO or NENA telecommunicator training or The Monitoring Association (TMA) operator training.
  • Incident Command System familiarity (e.g., FEMA IS-100 and IS-700) or wildland fire coursework.
  • Working knowledge of wildfire behavior, Red Flag Warnings, and evacuation zone tools such as Genasys Protect or Watch Duty.
  • Experience with irrigation, plumbing, sprinkler, smart home, or security system installation or support.
  • Experience with ServiceTitan or similar field service management software.
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish.
  • Experience in a high-growth startup or a role that helped build a new team or process from scratch.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary Range: $29.00 - $36.00 per hour, based on experience (non-exempt; overtime eligible).
  • Company-provided cell phone and laptop
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Flexible time off + 14 paid holidays (yes, your birthday is one of them!)
  • Work-from-home stipend to support your remote setup
  • Remote-first work environment, fostering work-life balance and autonomy
  • Company-provided equipment
  • Join a high-performing, mission-driven team doing work that truly matters
  • And much more!

Join Our Mission!

If you're excited about building technology that protects homes and families from wildfire disasters, we want to hear from you! Apply today and become part of a fast-growing team with purpose and innovation at its core.

Diversity and inclusion are essential values at Frontline. We know we'll do our best and most impactful work when we feel represented, and we belong. We encourage talented people from a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.description:
CancerNavigator is an early-stage healthcare company (remote, headquartered in Washington, D.C.) dedicated to supporting cancer patients in their hour of need.

Our Mission & Our Work, in Brief

Cancer is the number one cause of death for commercially insured Americans and the top cost driver for health plans. And, cancer patients are struggling.

CancerNavigator is a white-glove, end-to-end, cancer support service for patients and their families. We work with health plans across the country to provide 1-1 support to members facing a cancer diagnosis. All of our support is delivered through dedicated Oncology Certified Nurses, who work with members to catch cancer early, get them to fantastic experts for their care, and help them through the thousands of other problems patients and their families face.

Join us to help serve cancer patients in their hour of need.

The “Research Associate” Role

The number one priority of a research associate is to produce high-quality research that will help patients understand crucial information in their hour of need. Research Associates support the following efforts:

  • Creating Custom Documents for Patients: The Patient Service Team’s mandate is to help cancer patients make decisions in this difficult hour of need, and our mechanism for serving patients is education. The primary responsibility for a researcher on our team is to create excellent tailored documents for patients, and to collaborate with our oncology nurse navigators to teach each patient what they need to know about their specific situation. This is an “on-demand” function – when patients need help, our entire team jumps into action.
  • Enhancing Our Research Base: Our team has spent over five years building a deep research foundation on nearly every cancer type and subtype, which we use to inform the education and guidance we deliver to patients. The cancer landscape is continually evolving, and our research base requires updating regularly to reflect changes in diagnostics, treatment protocols, techniques, and more. A central function of a research associate is to assist in the enhancement of our core research base by identifying gaps in our research as we serve patients, and occasionally performing research “deep dives” to fill in those gaps.

The Requirements

The right person for this role would be eager to jump in immediately and begin mastering the clinical content. More specifically, we are looking for someone with:

  • 1-2 years of professional research experience on clinical topics
  • Experience reading and examining academic literature on medical subjects
  • Ability to quickly master complex clinical content in both depth and breadth
  • Ability to execute research projects autonomously
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Masters degree requiring research in a related field
  • Willingness to work MST hours

Compensation and Benefits

  • Salary Range: $71k-76k (dependent on qualifications and experience)
  • Remote-first work; live where you want within the continental U.S.
  • All-company on-sites 2-3 times per year in Washington D.C. (HQ) or other locations
  • Medical and Dental Insurance (80% employer paid), Vision Insurance (100% employer paid)
  • Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA
  • Group Life and AD&D Insurance (involuntary with the option to buy-up coverage)
  • Unlimited PTO

Our Culture & Values, In Brief

We’re building a company where what we do matters. The goal couldn’t be clearer – serve cancer patients. As the business grows, and the work becomes more complex, we need to become more, not less, committed to why we are doing this.

We have three company values, which guide our company:

  1. Patients first, always: In everything we do, we put the cancer patient (and their families) first; we exist to serve them in their most urgent moments.
  2. Respect for our responsibility: We strive, as a team, to respect the gravity of the responsibility we bear to patients, always acting and producing in a way that is worthy of the trust they have placed in us.
  3. Kindness to and respect for others: We treat our teammates well, no exceptions. We are one team.

At CancerNavigator, we believe a well-rounded and diverse team is a key to our success. We never discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status.

California Consumer Privacy Act - Job Applicant Notice

If we move forward, we will also collect reference and background check information. We use this information to review your application, schedule interviews, and verify your background. Please note: This is a U.S. based, remote position that requires regular travel across the country (50-75% domestically as required.). Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States and comfortable with a travel-based schedule.

Verndale is a digital experience agency dedicated to driving growth by helping businesses create meaningful human connections in an increasingly digital world. As we expand our Marketing Services practice, we are seeking an Associate Director, Content Strategy: a senior, client-facing content strategist who can lead enterprise content programs across discovery, design, build, migration, governance, AI search, personalization, and performance.

This role sits within the Marketing Services team and reports to the VP, Content Strategy. The Associate Director will help turn content strategy from a project deliverable into a governed content system that fuels discoverability, relevance, and measurable business impact across human and AI-driven journeys.

The ideal candidate is strategic and hands-on. They know how to build content strategy into complex digital programs, integrate it with design, technology, analytics, SEO, AI search, and personalization, and produce polished client-ready deliverables. They must also be AI fluent and ready to build practical solutions using AI tools, not simply experiment with them.

Verndale is fully remote enabled. This position can be remote, with a preference for candidates based in Canada.

Responsibilities

  • Lead content strategy workstreams across discovery, design, build, migration, and optimization programs.
  • Oversee and execute editorial content strategy, including content inventories, content assessments, transformation strategy, message planning, and editorial planning.
  • Oversee and execute UX content strategy, including content audits, gap analyses, taxonomies, content hierarchies, copy planning, and content planning for design and migration.
  • Oversee and execute delivery content strategy, including content matrices, governance models, workflows, guidelines, migration support, and authoring guidance.
  • Facilitate client workshops, stakeholder interviews, content working sessions, and alignment meetings that connect content decisions to business goals and audience needs.
  • Present polished deliverables, recommendations, project updates, and decision points to marketing, digital, technology, and executive stakeholders.
  • Design content approaches that support AI Search, Answer Engine Optimization, Generative Engine Optimization, personalization, site search, related content, filtering, and content reuse.
  • Develop structured, governed, machine-readable content strategies, including taxonomy, metadata, schema guidance, content models, prompt-ready source content, and reuse patterns.
  • Use AI tools to improve content inventories, audits, gap analyses, taxonomy exploration, migration mapping, content QA, prompt testing, answer testing, and content performance review.
  • Build repeatable AI-assisted workflows, prompts, QA routines, documentation, and review protocols that improve speed and quality without sacrificing judgment, accuracy, or governance.
  • Influence the pilot, adoption, and improvement of content-related AI tools in partnership with Strategy, SEO and AI, Personalization, Analytics, Experience Design, and Technology teams.
  • Help clients understand where AI can improve content operations, where human review is required, and how to govern AI-enabled content workflows responsibly.
  • Define and improve content lifecycle processes across planning, creation, review, approval, publishing, optimization, maintenance, and retirement.
  • Set content quality standards, review criteria, performance indicators, and documentation practices that can be used consistently across programs.
  • Identify process gaps, quality risks, content ownership issues, and workflow blockers, then recommend practical improvements.
  • Create content governance models that clarify roles, responsibilities, decision rights, approval paths, editorial standards, and maintenance cadences.
  • Support compliance-aware content processes for clients in regulated, brand-sensitive, or multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Use analytics and performance data to assess content effectiveness and inform future content planning, optimization, and governance decisions
  • Develop taxonomies, metadata models, tagging strategies, and structured data approaches that help power navigation, search, personalization, content relationships, and reporting.
  • Guide information architecture work including navigation strategy, sitemaps, content hierarchy, page-level content planning, and content inputs for wireframes and visual design.
  • Lead content migration strategy, including inventories, keep/edit/kill analysis, migration mapping, content matrices, content models, authoring requirements, and migration readiness.
  • Help establish repeatable methods and level-of-effort guidance for taxonomy, information architecture, and migration work so these activities can be scoped and delivered consistently.
  • Partner with Business Development, Client Services, and Practice Leads to shape content strategy solutions for proposals, pitch meetings, and active accounts.
  • Scope and estimate content strategy activities across discovery, redesign, migration, AI search, personalization, content operations, and optimization programs.
  • Contribute to packaged content strategy offerings, delivery standards, internal templates, case studies, POVs, and thought leadership.
  • Serve as a senior content strategy voice on strategic accounts and as an escalation point for content strategy delivery and quality.
  • Help identify opportunities to grow content strategy revenue within broader Marketing Services and Experience engagements.
  • Coach cross-functional teammates on content strategy methods, client facilitation, deliverable quality, and content decision-making.
  • Create enablement materials that help internal teams understand content strategy, AI-ready content, taxonomy, migration, and governance.
  • Lead through example, advocacy, and mentoring while supporting a collaborative, high-performing team culture.
  • Help build fluency in AI-assisted content workflows across the practice, including prompt development, source evaluation, quality review, and responsible tool use.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in content strategy, content design, content operations, digital strategy, or a closely related discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience leading workstreams, mentoring content strategists, enabling cross-functional teams, or guiding client stakeholders.
  • Deep experience across editorial content strategy, UX content strategy, delivery content strategy, content governance, and content operations.
  • Strong knowledge of digital redesigns, platform implementations, CMS programs, content migrations, and enterprise digital transformation activities.
  • Experience with content management systems and digital platforms such as Sitecore, Optimizely, Adobe Experience Manager, Contentstack, Drupal, WordPress, or similar systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to create taxonomies, metadata models, content models, information architecture inputs, content matrices, migration plans, and governance documentation.
  • AI fluency, including practical experience using generative AI and LLM-based tools to support content strategy, content operations, research synthesis, content QA, taxonomy development, migration planning, and optimization.
  • Readiness to build AI-assisted tools and workflows, including reusable prompts, review protocols, QA checklists, source-of-truth practices, and team enablement materials.
  • Working knowledge of how content strategy supports AI Search, AEO, GEO, site search, personalization, structured content, and measurable experience performance.
  • Experience defining content quality standards, performance measures, review criteria, and lifecycle processes for complex content programs.
  • Comfort using analytics, search data, content performance data, and qualitative research to inform recommendations.
  • Proven ability to facilitate workshops, lead client conversations, influence stakeholders, and present executive-ready recommendations.
  • Experience scoping and estimating content strategy work for proposals, statements of work, and active engagements.
  • Strong writing, storytelling, documentation, and communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience in an agency, consulting, enterprise, healthcare, financial services, higher education, or other complex stakeholder environment preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, English, Journalism, Digital Strategy, UX, Information Science, or a related field preferred, or commensurate experience

Ten Great Reasons to Work at Verndale

  1. We are a rapidly growing company that is just as scrappy and entrepreneurial today as when we were founded in 1998.
  2. We are relentlessly curious and enthusiastically solve our clients’ complex business problems through technology, data, and design.

  8. We offer top-of-the-line Health Insurance, plus monthly perks customized to meet individual employees’ needs.
  9. We support a healthy work/life balance.
  10. We are fully remote enabled and embrace the evolving definition of the workplace

Compensation & Benefits

The team partners closely with Operations, Legal, Compliance, and Risk to deliver timely and accurate resolutions and identify opportunities to improve the customer experience.

As a Senior Complaints Specialist at Upstart, you will investigate and resolve escalated and regulated customer complaints, applying regulatory knowledge and sound judgment to determine appropriate outcomes. You’ll also look beyond individual cases to identify recurring issues, surface trends, and help improve the processes and controls that shape the customer experience.

We believe that sustainability should not require customers to compromise on price, convenience, or performance. Our mission is to create positive & systemic impact for the critical industries that sustain life. We value innovation and take pride in challenging the status-quo; we choose to view obstacles as opportunities. We value new ideas and encourage the team to apply creativity and invent new solutions to meet challenging demands. We foster open, direct communication, and a collaborative working environment through our unique approach to work culture. About Tidal Grow AgriScience:

Tidal Grow AgriScience develops next-generation agricultural technologies designed to improve crop performance, nutrient efficiency, and grower profitability. By translating advanced chitosan science into practical, scalable products, we create innovative agricultural solutions that integrate seamlessly into modern farming operations to deliver higher yields with more efficient inputs.

Tidal Vision strives to build and invest in the highest performing and most innovative team. We put our people and customers above process, avoid company-wide rules as much as possible, and have the courage to take unusual approaches to advance our mission. Our commitment to developing, practicing and promoting direct and open communication, responsibility and freedom, and leading with and seeking context is a responsibility for every role at Tidal Vision.

The Director, Portfolio Strategy & Product Marketing leads the commercial strategy and market success of Tidal Grow AgriScience’s product portfolio. The role owns segmentation, targeting, positioning, pricing, channel strategy, label and claims strategy, launch planning, and lifecycle commercialization.

This role is a critical member of the Product organization, working alongside Product Management and R&D to shape and commercialize Tidal Grow AgriScience's product portfolio. As the portfolio's commercial leader, the Director drives market strategy, positioning, pricing, channel strategy, launch planning, and lifecycle commercialization to ensure products achieve successful market adoption and long-term growth.

  • Lead portfolio commercialization strategy across crop nutrition, biostimulant, and crop protection markets.
  • Own segmentation, targeting, positioning, value propositions, pricing architecture, and channel strategy.

  • Own label and claims strategy, partnering with Regulatory on registrations, substantiation, and compliance.
  • Partner with Product Managers to translate technical capabilities, efficacy data, and customer needs into commercially successful products.
  • Partner with Marketing to establish promotional strategy, message hierarchy, proof points, and sales-enablement priorities; Marketing owns creative development and execution.
  • Build market, customer, competitive, pricing, and channel intelligence into portfolio plans, business cases, forecasts, and commercialization decisions.
  • Work with the Chief Product Officer on product vision, roadmap priorities, portfolio architecture, and investment decisions.
  • Align Product Management, R&D, Commercial Ag Science, Regulatory, Marketing, Sales, and Operations around commercialization plans and market outcomes.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in agriculture, agronomy, agricultural economics, marketing, business, crop science, or a related field.
  • At least 15 years of progressive experience in agricultural product marketing, portfolio strategy, product management, market development, or commercial leadership.
  • Commercial leadership experience across both crop nutrition/fertilizer and crop protection.
  • Proven success leading segmentation, positioning, pricing, channel, launch, lifecycle, and portfolio strategies for agricultural products.
  • Strong understanding of grower economics, agricultural distribution, retail channels, product labels, claims, and commercialization requirements.
  • Ability to translate technical and field-performance data into differentiated value propositions and commercially compelling strategies.
  • Strong financial acumen and experience developing value-based pricing, channel economics, and product business cases.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive decisions without direct authority.
  • Executive-level communication, judgment, and presence.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience leading a multi-product portfolio within an established agricultural input company.
  • Experience launching and scaling innovative or technically differentiated agricultural products.
  • Experience across distributor, retailer, and direct-to-grower channels.
  • Success operating in an entrepreneurial or rapidly scaling business.

At Oritain, we’re solving a problem most people don’t even realize exists until it matters. Where did this product really come from? Is it what it claims to be?

We are global leaders in product origin verification, with locations in Washington D.C, Auckland, Dunedin, London, Paris and Singapore.

We sit at the intersection of forensic science and supply chain technology, harnessing science and data to verify the genuine origin of materials across the world's most critical commodities. Our mission is to protect people and the planet by ensuring transparency and integrity in global supply chains. We empower the world’s leading brands to make positive changes across their supply chain; ensuring product integrity, meeting regulatory demands, and reducing the risk of fraud and unethical sourcing - creating real change in our world.

As demand for supply chain transparency continues to grow across the US market, we are seeking an Account Executive to join our US sales team.

About the role:As an Account Executive, Americas, you'll play a key role in accelerating Oritain's growth across the US, helping leading brands and retailers build more transparent, trusted and resilient supply chains. Reporting to the SVP of sales, you'll own the full sales cycle, from initial engagement through to signed membership agreements, closing mid-market opportunities.

This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious sales professional who wants to develop their consultative selling expertise in a highly relevant market. You'll engage senior stakeholders, challenge conventional thinking, and position Oritain as a trusted advisor in supply chain traceability, compliance and sustainability. Supported by SDR and Marketing-generated opportunities, you'll also take ownership of building your own pipeline and creating new business opportunities.

What you'll be doing

You'll own and manage the complete sales cycle, taking opportunities from prospecting and qualification through to proposal, negotiation and close. Working with mid-market brands and retailers across the US, you'll build strong business cases, lead commercially focused conversations and create solutions that deliver value for customers while helping Oritain achieve its growth ambitions.
A key part of the role will be developing and executing a territory plan, maintaining a healthy pipeline and generating new business opportunities through targeted outreach, referrals, networking and industry events. You'll work closely with our SDR and Marketing teams to maximise opportunity creation while ensuring your own prospecting efforts complement wider sales activity.
You'll use insight-led selling techniques to engage senior stakeholders across sourcing, compliance and sustainability functions, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor rather than simply a supplier. By understanding each customer's business, regulatory challenges and strategic priorities, you'll help them navigate increasingly complex supply chain risks and make informed decisions.
Working cross-functionally with colleagues across Science, Legal, Marketing and Account Management, you'll help progress opportunities efficiently and ensure customers experience a smooth transition following a successful sale. You'll also maintain accurate Salesforce records, provide reliable forecasts and use sales and AI tools to continuously improve performance, identify deal risks and increase sales effectiveness.
As a representative of Oritain in the market, you'll attend industry events (up to 20% travel), build valuable relationships and stay informed on emerging regulations and trends that influence customer priorities across supply chain transparency, compliance and sustainability.

What we're looking for

We're looking for an early career salesperson with two + years' experience in a quota-carrying B2B closing role, such as Account Executive or Sales Executive. You'll have a track record of achieving or exceeding targets and experience managing full sales cycles, including opportunities you've sourced yourself. Experience selling into mid-market organizations with multiple stakeholders and longer sales cycles will be important for success in this role.
You'll be comfortable building pipeline through proactive prospecting and relationship development, rather than relying solely on inbound leads. Strong communication skills are essential, as you'll need to simplify complex concepts for business buyers and influence senior decision-makers with confidence. Experience using Salesforce as well as modern sales and AI tools will help you hit the ground running. You'll also be willing to travel across North America when required.
Beyond experience, we're looking for someone who is naturally curious, takes ownership of their results and brings energy and resilience to every conversation. You plan effectively, manage your time well and maintain a disciplined approach to pipeline management and forecasting. Most importantly, you're someone who builds trust through strong listening skills, empathy and a genuine desire to understand customer challenges and help solve them.
Experience in risk, compliance, ESG, sustainability or supply chain-related sales would be advantageous, as would an interest in fashion, textiles, science or sustainability. However, these are not essential requirements.

What you'll get

At Oritain, exceptional performance doesn't go unnoticed. We believe in rewarding high performers with meaningful opportunities, whether that's taking on projects, influencing business decisions, or accelerating your career development.
As a member of our global commercial team, you'll work closely with colleagues across Sales, Marketing, Science, Legal and Customer teams, giving you broad exposure across the business and the opportunity to make a visible impact on Oritain's continued growth. You'll have access to senior leaders, collaborate with experts in their fields and contribute to solving some of the most important challenges facing global supply chains today.
In return for your ambition and impact, you'll join a collaborative, purpose driven organization where your growth is taken seriously, your work has real influence, and your success is recognized.

Hypori, Inc. is a high-growth cybersecurity SaaS company transforming how organizations think about secure mobility. jobs.description:
Senior Frontend Engineer

About Inco

Inco is building the confidentiality layer for blockchains through encryption technologies. We’re building the next generation of secure, scalable, and privacy-enhancing solutions for Web3, enabling fintech, payments, and blockchain applications to have the same confidentiality and capabilities users expect from Web2.

Who You Are

We’re looking for a senior frontend engineer who has built production-grade Web3 user experiences and understands the unique complexity of blockchain applications.

You have strong frontend fundamentals, but you also understand that Web3 frontend engineering is not just about building interfaces. It requires safely fetching and interpreting onchain data, integrating wallets, handling signatures, managing client-side state, and designing user flows where security and correctness matter.

You should be comfortable building polished, reliable UIs while also thinking deeply about how users interact with wallets, sign messages, grant permissions, manage session keys, and execute intent-based flows. You understand the security risks of asking users to sign transactions or messages, and you care about making those flows clear, safe, and difficult to misuse.

We’re looking for someone senior who can own frontend architecture end-to-end, raise engineering standards, and mentor more junior engineers. You should be the type of person who can turn ambiguous product requirements into secure, elegant, production-ready user experiences.

This role is remote / hybrid / based in Bangalore (preferred).

Responsibilities

Frontend Architecture & Development

  • Design, build, and maintain production-grade frontend applications using modern frontend technologies.
  • Own frontend features end-to-end, from product requirements and UX flows to implementation, testing, and deployment.
  • Build responsive, performant, and reliable user interfaces for Web3 products.
  • Create reusable frontend components, patterns, and architecture that allow the team to move quickly without sacrificing quality.
  • Work closely with product, design, backend, and protocol teams to translate complex Web3 flows into intuitive user experiences.

Web3 Product & Wallet Integration

  • Build frontend experiences that integrate with wallets, smart contracts, indexers, RPC providers, and blockchain data sources.
  • Implement flows involving transaction signing, message signing, intent signing, session keys, delegated permissions, and account abstraction.
  • Design user experiences around balances, transaction history, onchain transactions, permissions, and Web3 payment flows.
  • Understand how to fetch, cache, reconcile, and display onchain and offchain data safely and accurately.
  • Handle edge cases common in Web3 applications, including pending transactions, reorgs, failed RPC calls, wallet disconnects, chain switching, stale balances, and inconsistent indexer data.

Security & Correctness

  • Ensure frontend flows are secure by default, especially when users are asked to sign messages, authorize intents, or store session keys locally.
  • Apply best practices for client-side key management, session key storage, permission scoping, signature domain separation, and phishing-resistant UX.
  • Work with the team to identify and prevent risks around malicious signatures, replay attacks, unsafe approvals, incorrect transaction previews, and confusing wallet prompts.
  • Treat frontend correctness as critical infrastructure, especially when user funds or private information are involved.

Leadership & Mentorship

  • Lead technical design discussions and help define frontend architecture, standards, and best practices.
  • Review code and mentor junior engineers on frontend quality, Web3 security, testing, and production readiness.
  • Improve engineering velocity by building strong abstractions, documentation, and internal tooling.
  • Take ownership of frontend quality across performance, reliability, security, accessibility, and maintainability.

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of frontend engineering experience, with strong production experience building complex applications.
  • Strong expertise in TypeScript, React, and modern frontend development.
  • Experience building Web3, crypto, wallet, DeFi, payments, or blockchain-related frontend products.
  • Strong understanding of wallet integrations, transaction flows, message signing, and onchain data fetching.
  • Experience working with libraries and tools such as viem, wagmi, ethers.js, WalletConnect, RainbowKit, or similar.
  • Strong understanding of frontend state management, API integration, caching, and real-time data updates.
  • Ability to reason carefully about security-sensitive frontend flows involving user funds, permissions, signatures, or keys.
  • Experience owning large frontend features from design to production.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work closely with product, design, backend, and protocol engineers.
  • Experience mentoring junior engineers and raising frontend engineering standards.
  • Startup mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration, and taking ownership end-to-end.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building wallets, smart account interfaces, account abstraction flows, or session key systems.
  • Experience with intent-based protocols, delegated permissions, EIP-712 signatures, EIP-1271, EIP-4337, or EIP-7702.
  • Experience building frontend interfaces for privacy-preserving, security-sensitive, or financial applications.
  • Experience with indexers, subgraphs, custom backend APIs, RPC providers, and blockchain event reconciliation.
  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex Web3 flows for mainstream users.
  • Experience with frontend testing, including unit tests, integration tests, end-to-end tests, and wallet interaction testing.
  • Experience with Next.js, Tailwind, design systems, component libraries, and frontend performance optimization.
  • Open-source contributions or prior work in crypto, wallets, DeFi, payments, or developer tools.

What Success Looks Like

  • You will help build the frontend experience for Inco’s core products, making advanced privacy and Web3 payment flows feel simple, secure, and intuitive.
  • You will be responsible for creating interfaces that users can trust when signing intents, managing permissions, interacting with wallets, and moving funds privately.
  • You will help establish the frontend foundation for Inco’s products while mentoring the team and setting a high bar for quality, security, and user experience.

Dropbox is hiring an Integrated Campaign Strategist to architect and orchestrate marketing campaigns for priority product launches and evergreen marketing motions. This role turns business priorities, audience insight, and product positioning into a clear campaign strategy that defines the audience, narrative, journey, channel roles, activation sequence, and measurement plan.

You will be the steward of how these campaigns show up in market across owned, earned, and paid channels. Working across Product Marketing, Brand and Creative, Comms, Web, Lifecycle, Paid Media, Content, Events, Marketing Operations, Analytics, and Sales, you will align teams around one integrated plan, connect individual activations into a coherent enterprise buyer experience, and guide the campaign from brief through launch, optimization, and learning.

You will help Dropbox bring important product stories to enterprise audiences with greater consistency, relevance, and effectiveness.

  • Campaign strategy architecture: Translate mid-market and enterprise business goals, product positioning, audience insight, and market context into integrated campaign strategies for key launches and evergreen motions, including objectives, audience, narrative, journey, channel roles, phasing, and measurement.

  • In-market stewardship: Own the campaign through launch and sustainment, protecting the strategic throughline while ensuring creative, messaging, timing, and audience experience remain coherent across touchpoints and regions.

  • Performance and optimization: Partner with Marketing Data Science and channel owners to define full funnel success measures, synthesize owned, earned, and paid signals, identify what is driving or limiting performance, and recommend changes to audience, narrative, creative, sequencing, or channel mix.
  • Portfolio learning and scale: Capture campaign insights, codify reusable plays, distinguish enduring strategy from launch specific execution, and apply learning across the enterprise campaign portfolio to improve future launches and evergreen motions.

Requirements

  • 8+ years B2B marketing experience in integrated campaigns, enterprise marketing, product marketing activation, brand to demand, or a related discipline, ideally in SaaS or technology.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading enterprise product launch campaigns and building evergreen motions for a multi product B2B portfolio.

  • Experience marketing to complex enterprise buying groups across industries, company sizes, regions, or stages of maturity.

  • Experience using AI to accelerate research, briefing, content variation, synthesis, or analysis while retaining human ownership of strategy, judgment, and brand decisions.

How You’ll Support Our Mission

We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer who brings deep technical expertise and an even deeper sense of ownership. This is not a role for someone who waits to be told what to do next. You will help architect, configure, and continuously improve the network infrastructure that underpins ESO products, and you will do it alongside a team that values candor, collaboration, and steady progress over headline-grabbing heroics.

What You’ll Be Doing - the day to day

  • Design, deploy, and maintain cloud and hybrid network infrastructure across environments.
  • Configure and manage F5 BIG-IP systems for load balancing, traffic management, and application delivery
  • Administer Web Application Firewalls (WAF) and Barracuda solutions to protect application and network layers
  • Partner with security and engineering teams to evaluate risk, enforce policy, and resolve incidents, asking the right questions early so the right solutions get built
  • Troubleshoot complex network issues methodically, communicate findings clearly, and document resolution paths that the whole team can learn from
  • Identify gaps and improvements proactively, bring forward recommendations with context, and follow through on the work
  • Support a culture of continuous improvement, not through dramatic overhauls, but through consistent, deliberate progress

What we are looking for - the essentials

  • 5 or more years of hands-on network engineering experience, with meaningful time spent in cloud environments
  • Proven experience configuring and managing F5 BIG-IP (LTM, ASM/WAF)
  • Solid working knowledge of load balancing principles and real-world application delivery
  • Experience with Azure networking, VNets, NSGs, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, or equivalent
  • Familiarity with Barracuda, SonicWall and other network appliances
  • Comfort working across firewall platforms and translating security requirements into network policy
  • A communication style that is direct, open, and respectful, you surface concerns early, share context generously, and engage in honest dialogue even when it is uncomfortable
  • A growth mindset: you measure yourself not against perfection but against where you were last quarter

How you work

At ESO, the strongest signal of a great engineer is not what they know on day one, it is how they approach learning, collaboration, and accountability over time. We are looking for someone who:

  • Asks the questions that move conversations from stuck to forward
  • Takes ownership without needing to own everything alone
  • Brings teammates along rather than working around them
  • Holds themselves to high standards and is honest when those standards are not met
  • Wants to grow, not just in technical depth, but as a teammate and contributor to something that matters

About ESO

ESO is a fast-paced, growing data, technology, and research company passionate about improving community health and safety through the power of data. We pioneer innovative, user-friendly software to meet the changing needs of today’s EMS agencies, fire departments, and hospitals. We’re small enough to be nimble and fun, but big enough to be a great place to work. We serve thousands of customers out of our offices across the US, Canada, Northern Ireland, Czech Republic, Denmark and Costa Rica.

Are you ready to Make a Difference? At ESO, we believe in bringing your true self to work every single day. If you don’t match all the qualifications on the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway! We are looking for passionate, innovative, and authentic people to help drive our mission.

All offers are contingent upon a successful background check.

ESO is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We invite you to consider opportunities at ESO regardless of your gender; gender identity; gender reassignment; age; religion; race; national origin; political affiliation; sexual orientation; disability; veteran status; or other non-merit factor.

Overview

The Payroll & HR Ops Specialist is responsible for the accurate and timely administration of payroll and the execution and continuous improvement of HR operational processes across the employee lifecycle. This role manages payroll processing for a diverse workforce, including unionized hourly and salaried employees and non-union salaried exempt employees, ensuring compliance with collective bargaining agreements (CBAs), company policies, and applicable laws and regulations. In addition, the role executes key HR transactions, maintains accurate employee records and HRIS data, supports HR programs and compliance initiatives, and provides responsive, high-quality service to employees and leaders. Working closely with Payroll, Total Rewards, Finance, and CTS (IT), the Payroll & HR Ops Specialist leverages HRIS capabilities, reporting, and data analysis to strengthen data integrity, streamline workflows, improve system efficiencies, and support consistent, compliant, and effective payroll and HR operations that enhance the employee experience.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Payroll Processing & Compliance· Process weekly payroll for union and non union hourly and salaried employees, ensuring accurate application of wage rates, overtime, shift differentials, premiums, retro pay, and other earnings in alignment with CBAs and company policies.· Manage payroll changes for hires, terminations, promotions, transfers, and union status updates, while ensuring correct calculation and withholding of union dues, benefit deductions, garnishments, and related items.· Interpret and apply collective bargaining agreements and federal, state, and local wage and hour laws (including FLSA) to payroll processing and employee pay inquiries.· Partner with Total Rewards, Finance, and Pension teams on year-end processing, compensation cycles, audits, retirement transitions, payroll registers, variance reports, and exception reports prior to payroll submission· Identify discrepancies, research root causes, and implement corrective actions to prevent reoccurrence · Support internal audits by providing payroll documentation, reports, and reconciliationsProcess Improvement, HRIS Optimization & Reporting· Evaluate workflows and procedures to identify opportunities for process improvements and efficiency gains· Partner with the HR Payroll Manager to optimize HRIS (Workday) configurations, pay rules, and automation, and support system testing, transition and implementation activities from UKG to new HRIS (Workday), integrations, configuration changes, and updates· Develop and maintain payroll procedures, job aids, and documentation to support consistent processing· Use HRIS payroll reporting tools to support payroll operations, audits, and compliance requirements, and analyze data to proactively identify risks, inefficiencies, and recurring payroll issuesEmployee Experience, Support & Projects· Serve as primary contact for HR-related inquiries, providing timely and accurate responses to procedures and programs· Partner with Total Rewards and jobs.excerpt: ABOUT 321 THE AGENCY321 is a full-funnel creative agency built for brands that operate in complex, regulated industries — healthcare, insurance, legal services, home services, entertainment, and travel and tourism.
jobs.description:
ABOUT 321 THE AGENCY

321 is a full-funnel creative agency built for brands that operate in complex, regulated industries — healthcare, insurance, legal services, home services, entertainment, and travel and tourism. We're a remote, AI-first team that combines strategic creative with CRM infrastructure, performance marketing, and paid media to drive real, measurable business outcomes for our clients.

We don't separate strategy from execution. Our digital marketing practice is built on the belief that paid media and CRM aren't parallel tracks — they're two sides of the same funnel. The Director of Digital Marketing is the leader who makes that integration happen across every client we serve.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As Director of Digital Marketing at 321, you will lead the agency's paid media and CRM/MarTech practices as a unified digital performance department. This is a senior leadership role with real strategic authority — you'll own the department's operating model, develop the team's capabilities across both disciplines, and serve as the senior digital voice in client strategy, new business, and agency planning conversations.

The right person for this role thinks in funnels, not channels. You understand that a paid search click is only as valuable as the automation sequence that follows it, that CRM segmentation should inform audience targeting, and that attribution only makes sense when you can see the full journey from impression to closed deal. You're as comfortable reviewing a High Level workflow build as you are auditing a Google Ads account structure — and you lead a team that covers both.

You'll also work in close coordination with 321 AIM, the agency's proprietary performance marketing platform, on overlapping clients, ensuring paid media strategy and lead generation infrastructure are tightly aligned rather than operating in silos.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Department Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, manage, and grow the Digital Marketing department, which spans paid media specialists and CRM/MarTech strategists as a unified practice
  • Set the department's operating model: campaign workflows, QA standards, platform governance, reporting cadences, and cross-discipline collaboration frameworks between paid and CRM functions
  • Conduct regular 1:1s and performance reviews; provide strategic coaching and actively develop team capabilities across both paid media and marketing automation disciplines
  • Define role scopes, skill development paths, and staffing recommendations as the department grows to warrant additional headcount
  • Partner with the Director of Client Strategy to align digital performance plans with overall client strategy and business objectives
  • Serve as the escalation point for media performance issues, CRM technical challenges, and cross-channel strategy questions across the client portfolio

Paid Media Strategy & Execution

  • Own the agency's paid media strategy framework across all digital channels: Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube, Performance Max, Demand Gen), Meta Ads, LinkedIn, TikTok, and programmatic platforms
  • Lead media planning, budget allocation, audience strategy, and campaign architecture for new and existing client accounts across 321's primary verticals — healthcare, insurance, legal services, home services, and entertainment
  • Oversee campaign setup, launch, and optimization standards — including bidding strategies, audience segmentation, creative testing frameworks, and attribution modeling
  • Develop and enforce first-party data strategies, including CRM-to-platform audience integration, customer match lists, and retargeting architecture
  • Apply working knowledge of regulated industry advertising requirements — including healthcare, insurance, and legal — to ensure campaigns meet compliance standards while still performing
  • Stay current on platform updates, privacy regulation impacts (iOS, cookie deprecation, consent mode), and measurement alternatives — and translate those into updated agency practices

CRM, Funnel & Marketing Automation

  • Lead the agency's CRM and marketing automation practice, overseeing strategy and execution for client programs built primarily on High Level, with additional experience in HubSpot and Salesforce Marketing Cloud
  • Develop full-funnel automation strategies including lead capture and qualification workflows, nurture sequences, re-engagement programs, pipeline stage triggers, and retention campaigns
  • Ensure CRM architecture decisions support paid media goals — including lead source tracking, cost-per-lead reporting by channel, and audience syndication back to ad platforms
  • Oversee funnel builds from intake form through appointment booking, sales handoff, and post-conversion retention — with particular depth in home services, legal, and healthcare client programs
  • Set quality standards for CRM deliverables: segmentation logic, workflow documentation, tagging conventions, and data hygiene practices
  • Stay current on evolving MarTech capabilities — including AI-powered personalization, conversational marketing, and automation enhancements — and proactively introduce relevant innovations to client programs

Integrated Performance & Full-Funnel Thinking

  • Champion the integration of paid media and CRM as a unified performance engine — ensuring that audience data, lead behavior, and conversion signals flow between platforms to continuously improve campaign efficiency
  • Develop cross-channel attribution frameworks that give clients a clear, accurate picture of marketing ROI from first touch through closed revenue
  • Lead the agency's performance reporting approach for digital: establishing dashboards, KPI frameworks, and narrative reporting standards that connect channel performance to business outcomes
  • Partner with 321 AIM on shared clients to ensure paid media strategy, lead qualification criteria, and CRM nurture sequences are coordinated and mutually reinforcing
  • Identify opportunities to introduce performance-based pricing models (price-per-qualified-lead) to applicable client accounts, and develop the supporting measurement infrastructure

Client Engagement & Agency Growth

  • Serve as the senior digital authority in client-facing strategy sessions, QBRs, and new business pitches — communicating complex paid and CRM strategies in clear, business-outcome terms
  • Collaborate with Client Strategy on account planning, identifying opportunities to expand digital scope, introduce new channels, or deepen automation investments
  • Contribute paid media and CRM strategy, projection modeling, and recommended tech stack recommendations to agency proposals and RFP responses
  • Champion the integration of AI tools across the digital practice — from bid management and creative performance analysis to CRM personalization and workflow automation

WHAT YOU HAVE

  • 10+ years of experience in digital marketing with demonstrated depth in both paid media and CRM/marketing automation — agency experience strongly preferred
  • At least 2–3 years in a department leadership, team lead, or senior manager role with direct reports across digital disciplines
  • Expert-level command of paid search and paid social platforms: Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube, PMax), Meta Ads Manager, and at least one additional platform (LinkedIn, TikTok, or programmatic DSP)
  • Hands-on experience building and managing CRM programs in High Level is strongly preferred; HubSpot and/or Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience also valued
  • Proven ability to architect full-funnel automation: lead capture, qualification workflows, multi-step nurture sequences, pipeline triggers, and retention programs
  • Deep understanding of audience strategy, first-party data integration, and the mechanics of syncing CRM data with ad platforms for targeting, suppression, and lookalike modeling
  • Experience managing paid media and CRM programs in regulated industries — healthcare, insurance, legal services, or home services — including working knowledge of applicable advertising compliance requirements
  • Strong command of attribution modeling, conversion tracking implementation (Google Tag Manager, GA4), and cross-channel reporting
  • Proficiency with reporting and data visualization tools (Looker Studio, Power BI, or similar) and the ability to build client-facing dashboards that tell a clear performance story
  • Excellent communication skills — able to translate complex digital strategy into clear recommendations for clients at the CMO or ownership level
  • Comfort with AI-powered optimization tools across both paid media and CRM, and a proactive mindset toward identifying new applications
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to manage department operations across a remote, multi-client environment
  • Platform certifications (Google Ads, Meta Blueprint, High Level, HubSpot) are a plus
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated experience

REPORTING STRUCTURE

The Director of Digital Marketing reports directly to the SVP of Strategy and is a member of the agency's leadership team. This role directly manages the Digital Marketing department, encompassing paid media specialists and CRM/MarTech strategists. The Director of Digital Marketing maintains a working relationship with 321 AIM leadership to align strategy and performance outcomes for shared clients, and collaborates closely with the Director of Client Strategy and Creative Director on integrated account delivery.

COMPENSATION
