jobs.description:
Zipliens is a leading lien resolution company that specializes in streamlining the lien process for personal injury law firms. We are looking for proactive, results-driven individuals to join our dynamic team.

We are improving how we handle Single Event lien resolution, building better tools and reporting as we grow.

In this role, you’ll support the Sr. Director of Single Event in that effort. You’ll help review and update how we process work through our portal, document workflow changes and share needs with our Product and Development teams, and keep our data clean and accurate. You’ll also help track team metrics and maintain and improve the reports the team relies on, including lienholder and agency reporting.

This role is a good fit for someone who understands how single event lien resolution operations work day-to-day, likes bringing order to processes and data, and is comfortable working with both operations and technical teams.

Requirements

Responsibilities:

Workflows & Process Improvement

  • Work with the Sr. Director of Single Event to review current workflows in the portal, identify steps to cut, combine, or add, and help document the updated workflows as clear, written needs Product and Development can build from.
  • Help build lienholder-specific workflows in coordination with our Agency Management team.
  • Support workflow updates as new tools from R&D are introduced.
  • Share workflow needs with Development, and support testing by gathering feedback and passing it along.
  • Use data to spot bottlenecks, repeated manual steps, and technical issues across the lien resolution process, and bring recommendations to the Sr. Director.

Data Quality

  • Clean up and maintain customer, client, and metric data on an ongoing basis, including lienholder and agency contact data. Find and fix gaps, duplicates, and errors.
  • Flag recurring data issues to Development, along with what’s needed to prevent them (e.g., new fields or validation).

Reporting & Metrics

  • Help define the team’s core KPIs with the Sr. Director (e.g., lien reductions, time to resolution, recovery ratios), and track starting performance so future changes can be measured.
  • Assess what reporting is available today, identify gaps, and work with Development and Data Engineering to build the reports and dashboards the team needs.
  • Pull, maintain, and refine recurring reports, including lienholder and agency reporting that supports the Agency Manager.
  • Work with Lien Resolution Operations and Customer Success so reporting supports customer needs and broader operational goals.
  • Track whether workflow and process changes improve results, and over time help track performance against KPIs across the Single Event team.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in an operations, data, reporting, or process improvement role.
  • Working knowledge of lien resolution, personal injury, healthcare claims, or medical billing workflows.
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills (pivot tables, lookups, cleaning and combining data).
  • Experience documenting workflows or processes and explaining operational needs to technical teams.
  • Strong attention to detail and comfort working with messy, incomplete, or inconsistent data.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining data and process issues to non-technical and technical audiences.
  • Organized and self-directed. Comfortable on a new team where processes are still being defined.
  • Experience handling sensitive or confidential information, including PHI.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent work experience.

Preferred

  • Experience with Tableau or similar reporting tools.

SUMMARY OF POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:

The TikTok Ads Performance Specialist is responsible for the strategic planning, execution, and optimization of TikTok advertising campaigns for U.S.-based client accounts.

Unlike Google Ads (intent-based) or Meta (audience-based), TikTok performance marketing is driven primarily by creative experimentation, attention capture, and rapid iteration. Success on TikTok requires an understanding of platform culture, scroll behavior psychology, hook creation, and short-form video testing methodologies.

This role focuses on creative strategy, campaign testing velocity, budget management, pixel tracking accuracy, and performance scalability.

SCHEDULED DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Campaign Strategy and Setup

  • Conduct structured intake to understand client offers, audience profiles, and KPIs.
  • Design campaign frameworks aligned with lead generation or revenue objectives.
  • Structure campaigns using appropriate objectives such as Lead Generation, Conversions, or Traffic.
  • Configure ad group segmentation based on testing methodology.
  • Launch campaigns using controlled budget allocation frameworks.

Creative Strategy and Testing Velocity

  • Develop structured creative testing plans.
  • Identify and script high-performing hooks with strong emphasis on the first three seconds.
  • Test multiple creative formats including UGC-style videos, native storytelling formats, problem-solution structures, and testimonial-based creatives.
  • Monitor creative fatigue and performance decay.
  • Analyze retention metrics and hook performance.
  • Scale high-performing creatives using structured iteration systems.

Audience Targeting and Optimization

  • Build broad targeting structures aligned with TikTok algorithm best practices.
  • Test interest-based segmentation when appropriate.
  • Monitor CPM, CTR, conversion rate, and cost per acquisition metrics.
  • Adjust bidding strategies and audience structures based on performance data.
  • Identify whether performance changes are driven by creative variables or audience structure.

Tracking and Attribution

  • Install and verify TikTok Pixel implementation.
  • Configure Events API when applicable.
  • Verify domain setup and event prioritization.
  • Align TikTok event tracking with GoHighLevel CRM capture.
  • Ensure UTM parameters are properly structured.
  • Conduct regular quality assurance checks to validate conversion accuracy and source attribution.

Budget Management and Scaling

  • Monitor daily and weekly spend pacing.
  • Maintain cost efficiency thresholds.
  • Reallocate budget toward high-performing creatives.
  • Prevent overspending during learning phases.
  • Implement structured scaling methodologies.
  • Review CRM pipeline quality to assess lead-to-revenue alignment.

CRM and Reporting Alignment

  • Ensure TikTok leads flow correctly into GoHighLevel.
  • Validate source attribution accuracy within CRM.
  • Provide structured weekly performance summaries.
  • Deliver monthly reports including spend, lead volume, cost per lead, creative performance breakdown, and scaling recommendations.

UNSCHEDULED DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Respond to urgent campaign adjustments.
  • Participate in strategic planning sessions.
  • Remain updated on TikTok platform updates and algorithm changes.
  • Support broader paid media initiatives when required.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • Primarily sedentary; extended periods of computer work, campaign monitoring, and data analysis.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • Remote work environment with collaboration across U.S. time zones. Requires stable internet connection, reliable computer equipment, and professional virtual communication standards.

COMPETENCIES AND SKILLS:

  • Strong understanding of short-form creative strategy and hook-based marketing psychology.
  • Proficiency in TikTok Ads Manager.
  • Experience installing TikTok Pixel and basic Events API configuration.
  • Familiarity with CRM integrations, preferably GoHighLevel.
  • Strong analytical and performance optimization skills.
  • Disciplined budget management capability.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to work aligned with U.S. Eastern Time.

LEVEL OF EDUCATION / TRAINING / QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 2-4 years of hands-on TikTok Ads experience required.
  • Demonstrated experience running and optimizing lead generation campaigns.
  • Experience installing TikTok Pixel and configuring conversion tracking.
  • Understanding of short-form content trends and platform-native creative.
  • Experience working with U.S.-based clients preferred.
  • Experience running Meta Ads considered a secondary but valuable skillset.
  • Reliable computer or laptop and strong, stable internet connection required.

PERFORMANCE METRICS (KPIs):

  • Performance will be evaluated based on:
  • Creative testing velocity
  • Lead volume growth
  • Cost per lead/acquisition efficiency
  • Campaign scalability
  • Budget pacing accuracy
  • Client satisfaction

About the job

WEKA is architecting a new approach to the enterprise data stack built for the age of reasoning. It transforms legacy data silos into data pipelines that dramatically increase GPU utilization and make AI model training and inference, machine learning, and other compute-intensive workloads run faster, work more efficiently, and consume less energy.

WEKA is a pre-IPO, growth-stage company on a hyper-growth trajectory. We’ve raised $375M in capital with dozens of world-class venture capital and strategic investors. We help the world’s largest and most innovative enterprises and research organizations, including 12 of the Fortune 50, achieve discoveries, insights, and business outcomes faster and more sustainably. We’re passionate about solving our customers’ most complex data challenges to accelerate intelligent innovation and business value. If you share our passion, we invite you to join us on this exciting journey.

What You’ll Be Doing

This is a customer-facing Premium Services role that combines deep, hands-on Ceph architecture and administration with the high-touch, outcome-driven approach of a Senior Designated Services Engineer (DSE). You will be the primary Ceph subject matter expert for assigned strategic customers and internal initiatives, owning the design, deployment, lifecycle operations, and performance of Ceph-based object storage environments. In parallel, you will play a key role in ensuring WEKA's Customer Success, contributing to our five-star Gartner reviews. You will work with cutting-edge technologies and top-tier customers, providing technical expertise and strengthening customer relationships.

Collaborating closely with Account Teams, you will gain deep insight into customers' business requirements, technical needs, and system environments. Your role involves resolving technical issues, bridging gaps between customers and Engineering, and ensuring the highest level of service.

Ceph Architecture & Operations

  • Architect, deploy, and operate large-scale production Ceph clusters supporting S3 with an emphasis on availability, performance, and operational simplicity.
  • Own cluster lifecycle activities: upgrades, patching, configuration management, routine health checks, and proactive risk remediation.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across the Ceph stack, lead incident response and root-cause analysis.
  • Establish and maintain runbooks, operational best practices, and customer-facing documentation; drive continuous improvement in reliability, observability, and automation.
  • Partner with customer teams on security and compliance requirements
  • Advise on hardware and topology choices to meet workload requirements.

Designated Services Engineering

  • Serve as the primary technical liaison between customers and WEKA Engineering/Product to address feature gaps, reliability concerns, and documentation improvements.
  • Own, track, and document customer issues via the ticketing system; drive issues to resolution with clear, timely communication and executive-ready updates when needed.
  • Proactively monitor customer environments (Ceph and WEKA) using observability and remote monitoring tools to identify and remediate risks before they impact production.
  • Support account teams (Customer Success, Sales Engineering, Partners/Resellers) with deep technical expertise and credibility in front of senior customer stakeholders.
  • Contribute to knowledge sharing through internal and customer-facing documentation (FAQs, KB articles, runbooks) and repeatable troubleshooting playbooks.
  • Manage multiple engagements and cases concurrently, balancing urgency, impact, and long-term customer outcomes.
  • Participate in on-call and follow-the-sun support rotations as required; work occasional alternative hours (nights/weekends/holidays) and travel as needed.

Learning & Growth at WEKA

  • Ramp on WEKA’s architecture, tooling, and support model, and progressively take ownership of designated services engagements beyond Ceph.
  • Develop deeper expertise in S3-compatible object storage concepts and ecosystems (clients, load balancing, performance testing, multi-tenancy), with mentorship from WEKA SMEs.
  • Partner with internal teams to improve product supportability and operational excellence for object-storage use cases.

Requirements

We’re looking for a senior, customer-facing engineer who can lead Ceph architecture and operations today, and who is excited to grow into a broader object-storage and WEKA role.

  • 10+ years in customer-facing technical roles solving complex enterprise infrastructure issues.
  • 5+ years of hands-on Ceph experience in production: cluster design, deployment, upgrades, and day-2 operations.
  • Strong understanding of Ceph internals and operational mechanics: MON quorum, MGR active/standby, OSD behavior, CRUSH and CRUSH maps, pools and placement groups (PGs), recovery/backfill and rebalancing.
  • Experience operating large-scale (multi-PB) Ceph environments and navigating the operational challenges of fleet size, PG scaling, and long-running recovery events.
  • Practical experience with Ceph RGW and S3 concepts (buckets, users/tenants, load balancing, scaling patterns, performance troubleshooting).
  • Expertise in Linux/Unix administration in multi-platform, distributed environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across hardware, OS, networking, and distributed storage layers (including diagnosing performance bottlenecks and failure scenarios).
  • Deep understanding of networking (Infiniband, Ethernet, DPDK, UCX), cloud computing, and distributed storage.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring stacks (Prometheus/Grafana and common log/metrics tooling).
  • Proficiency in Python and/or Bash; comfort building automation for monitoring, diagnostics, and repeatable operational tasks.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

It’s Nice If You Have

  • Experience with Kubernetes/Containers and/or cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, OCI, GCP) in storage-heavy environments.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Slack, and collaborating across Support, Engineering, and Product teams.
  • Experience supporting HPC or AI/ML infrastructure (GPU clusters, high-throughput networking, performance benchmarking).
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code or config management (Ansible, Terraform, etc.).
  • Strong technical writing skills and a habit of creating reusable runbooks and playbooks.

What Success Looks Like

  • Customers view you as a trusted technical leader for Ceph and object storage, and they proactively engage you for architectural guidance and operational reviews.
  • You can independently assess Ceph cluster health, identify risk, and lead remediation plans that improve availability and performance.
  • You deliver consistent, high-quality customer communications and drive issues to resolution while partnering effectively with internal teams (CS, Product and Engineering).
  • You build durable artifacts (runbooks, dashboards, automation, postmortems) that raise the operational maturity of customer environments and WEKA’s supportability.
  • You ramp quickly on WEKA’s products and processes and expand your ownership beyond Ceph into broader designated services engagements.

The WEKA Way

  • We are Accountable: We take full ownership, always–even when things don’t go as planned. We lead with integrity, show up with responsibility & ownership, and hold ourselves and each other to the highest standards.
  • We are Brave: We question the status quo, push boundaries, and take smart risks when needed. We welcome challenges and embrace debates as opportunities for growth, turning courage into fuel for innovation.
  • We are Collaborative: True collaboration isn’t only about working together. It’s about lifting one another up to succeed collectively. We are team-oriented and communicate with empathy and respect. We challenge each other and conduct positive conflict resolution. We are being transparent about our goals and results. And together, we’re unstoppable.
  • We are Customer Centric: Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We actively listen and prioritize the success of our customers, and every decision we make is driven by how we can better serve, support, and empower them to succeed. When our customers win, we win.

Experience in freight, logistics, or transportation billing is preferred, as the role involves shipment-based invoicing, supporting documents, and industry-specific charges. Accuracy, organization, and knowing when to clarify discrepancies rather than make assumptions are essential.

jobs.title: Director, Staffing Transformation & Operations
jobs.excerpt: As our Director, Staffing Transformation & Operations, you will lead a critical transformation in how Member Care scales across staffing strategy, workforce management, vendor strategy, and AI enablement.
jobs.description:
As our Director, Staffing Transformation & Operations, you will lead a critical transformation in how Member Care scales across staffing strategy, workforce management, vendor strategy, and AI enablement.

This transformational leader will own the multi‑year staffing strategy for Member Care. You will lead the evolution of our staffing model, the intentional use of outsourced partner capacity, and the way AI, automation, and human-in-the-loop workflows improve productivity and service delivery. You will directly oversee workforce management and scheduling functions (skilling, staffing, scheduling, and real‑time management) and vendor/BPO operations, ensuring we consistently meet or exceed service level, quality, and margin goals while delivering a top-notch member and employee experience.

In your first year, you will help build a stronger, more AI-enabled staffing engine by scaling a segment-based staffing approach, improving visibility into forecasting and workforce assumptions, and driving a prioritized automation roadmap tied to service, productivity, and savings outcomes.

Reporting to the Head of Member Care Strategy & Operations, you will partner closely with Member Care Advocacy (our member-facing teams), Staffing Forecasting, Quality, Training, Project Management, Finance, Product, Engineering, IT and vendor partners to turn strategic priorities into an operating model that works in production. This is a rare opportunity to help redefine a healthcare contact center operating model at a moment when AI, service complexity, and margin expectations are reshaping how the function must scale.

Key Responsibilities

    Staffing Strategy & Workforce Management

    • Own the multi‑year Member Care staffing strategy across channels, roles and staffing type, ensuring alignment with company growth plans, product roadmap, and client commitments.

    • Translate demand forecasts into clear capacity, staffing, skilling, and scheduling requirements across internal and outsourced teams.

    • Lead the workforce management function, including long-term capacity planning, short-term staffing plans, schedule design, skilling, real-time management, and feedback loops between plan and actual performance.

    • Evolve the staffing model through segment-based role design, cross-skilling, and routing strategy to improve service delivery, efficiency, and employee experience.

    • Define the next phase of the staffing model in an AI-forward environment, including how work should shift away from purely inbound, next-available handling.

      • Vendor Management

      • Own Member Care’s current and long term vendor strategy- who we partner with, how and for what defined value

      • Proactively identify and mitigate vendor and operational risk through contingency planning, diversification, and surge or outage coverage strategies.

      • Define and maintain performance standards and KPIs for vendor partners (e.g., service levels, quality, MSAT, AHT, escalation rates, adherence, error rates, unit cost).

      • Oversee the management of BPO relationships.

      • Ensure BPO partners are trained, enabled, and informed at the same standard as internal teams by coordinating with Training, Knowledge, Quality Coaching, and Product/IT.

      • Partner with Legal, Procurement, IT, Cyber Security and Finance on contracting, pricing, tech enablement, security and commercial terms, ensuring we can meet both performance and margin goals.

      • Build and maintain a robust issue and escalation management process with vendors, ensuring clear ownership, timely root cause analyses, and durable corrective actions.

      • Ensure systems are set up for accurate invoice reconciliation with our vendors

        • AI Enablement, Productivity, & Tooling

        • Own and centralize the Member Care AI enablement roadmap into one prioritized view of opportunities, bets, and expected impact.

        • Partner across Product, Engineering, IT, and Operations to identify, prioritize, and scale AI and automation opportunities that improve frontline workflows and member experience.

        • Modernize how productivity is defined and measured so it better reflects complex, non-queue-based work and AI-augmented service delivery.

        • Use data and structured experimentation to refine staffing models, routing strategies, partner allocations, and AI priorities.

          • Operational Performance, Analytics, & Tooling

          • Own a core set of staffing, productivity, vendor, and financial performance metrics, including service level, staffing efficiency, occupancy, utilization, adherence, quality, unit cost, and BPO versus internal mix.

          • Partner with Analytics and Finance to connect demand, capacity, staffing decisions, service outcomes, and financial results in a way that supports better in-year decision-making.

          • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and IT on tooling requirements related to IVR, chat routing, WFM platforms, skills management, and reporting, ensuring systems support the complexity of the staffing model.

          • Drive a disciplined test‑and‑learn approach to staffing (e.g., pilots on tiering, routing strategies, channel mix, BPO vs. internal allocations) and ensure learnings are documented and institutionalized.

            • Leadership, People Development, & Culture

            • Lead, coach, and develop a high‑performing team that includes ICs and people-managers.

            • Set a clear vision, strategy, and roadmap for the staffing and vendor management function, with defined milestones and success metrics over an 18‑month horizon.

            • Foster a culture of partnership, transparency, and shared accountability across all cross‑functional partners.

            • Represent the company’s staffing and vendor strategy in executive leadership forums and, as needed, in client, prospect, and RFP settings.

              • Cross-Functional Collaboration

              • Partner closely with Staffing Forecasting to align on forecasting assumptions, surge plans, and tooling needed to execute the staffing strategy.

              • Collaborate with Member Care Advocacy and Service Excellence to ensure staffing and vendor decisions reflect member experience goals, escalation themes, and quality insights.

              • Work with Operations Enablement and Project Management on the staffing implications of new clients, new products, and major operational changes (e.g., routing redesigns, new service lines).

              • Coordinate with Finance on budget planning, margin improvement initiatives, and unit cost tracking tied to staffing and vendor performance.

              • Partner with Client Success and Sales to help explain our staffing and vendor strategy to clients and prospects, as needed, including in RFP responses, client design sessions, and client business reviews.

Qualifications

    Experience:

    • 10+ years of experience in staffing strategy, operating model design and/or transformation or a related operational strategy function, including at least 2 years in a people management role.

    • Consulting background, particularly in strategy, operations, or transformation work, is strongly preferred.

    • Proven experience leading cross-functional operating model or service transformation initiatives in a high-volume, multi-channel environment.

    • Experience partnering with senior leaders across operations, finance, product, technology, and external partners to drive complex operational change.

    • Experience leading technology-enabled transformation, including AI, automation, workflow redesign, or tooling modernization.

    • Experience in healthcare, health benefits, or another highly regulated service environment strongly preferred.

      • Skills:

      • Exceptional strategic and systems thinking, with the ability to connect forecasts, staffing levers, service design, technology investments, and business outcomes.

      • Strong analytical and commercial judgment, with comfort working with complex operational and financial datasets and making tradeoff decisions tied to service, savings, and execution risk.

      • Ability to lead enterprise change through influence and align cross-functional stakeholders in environments where authority is shared.

      • Strong judgment in identifying, prioritizing, and scaling AI, automation, and workflow redesign opportunities based on operational and business impact.

      • Clear and confident communication, including experience presenting to senior leaders, executive forums, and external partners.

        • Education:

        • A Bachelor’s degree is required. A degree in Business, Operations Research, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, Healthcare Administration, or a similar field is preferred.

        • Advanced degree (e.g., MBA, MHA, MS in Operations Research or Analytics) is a plus.

          • Additional Requirements:

          • Ability to work in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment with competing priorities and tight timelines.

          • Interest for Included Health’s mission to raise the standard of healthcare for everyone.

          • Willingness to travel up to 10-20% as needed for key internal meetings, site visits, and vendor/client engagements.

Physical / Cognitive Requirements:

    Physical Requirements:

  • Stamina, strength, mobility, manual dexterity, vision, hearing, environmental factors.
  • Ability to effectively communicate and engage with others, with accommodations available for visual or auditory impairments
  • Ability to handle physical tasks related to the job, with accommodations provided as needed.
  • Ability to respond effectively to changing situations, with accommodations available for varying response times.
  • Prompt and regular attendance at assigned work location.
  • Ability to remain seated in a stationary position for prolonged periods.
  • Requires eye-hand coordination and manual dexterity sufficient to operate keyboard, computer and other office-related equipment.
  • No heavy lifting is expected, though occasional exertion of about 20 lbs. of force (e.g., lifting a computer / laptop) may be required.

    • Cognitive Requirements:

  • Problem-solving, decision-making, attention to detail, critical thinking, communication skills, stress tolerance.
  • Facilitate communication and collaboration with clients and stakeholders.
  • Adaptability to different work environments, with support provided for managing workload and pace
  • Ability to maintain focus and attention on tasks, with accommodations available for individuals with attention-related conditions.
  • Ability to interact with leadership, employees, and members in an appropriate manner.

The base salary range for this full-time position is $$186,360 - $229,779 per year in the United States, plus bonus eligibility and equity. About the role

MyFitnessPal is investing in creators as a scalable growth channel. As Influencer Marketing Manager, you will lead the day-to-day execution of our influencer program while owning how we measure its success and demonstrate its return on investment. You will manage a team of influencer specialists and work directly with talent, agents, and internal partners.

What you'll do

Day-to-day execution

  • Oversee creator communications and provide hands-on support throughout the partnership lifecycle, from outreach and onboarding to briefing, content delivery, payment and performance analysis
  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with creators, talent managers, and agencies to drive loyalty, preferred rates, and repeat partnerships
  • Evaluate incoming and proposed influencer deals, determining which are worth pursuing based on audience fit, performance potential, and cost
  • Directly manage relationships with celebrity and macro influencers, including negotiation oversight and content planning
  • Review creator content to ensure it meets brand standards, messaging requirements, and campaign objectives
  • Track influencer performance against established KPIs and report results to stakeholders on a regular cadence

Program management

  • Manage influencer budgets and allocate spend across creators, tiers, and platforms to maximize return
  • Partner with cross-functional teams (e.g., Brand, Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, Legal, Finance) to support ongoing marketing campaigns and integrate creator activity into broader plans
  • Lead, coach, and develop influencer specialists who negotiate creator contracts, setting priorities, deal guidelines, and quality standards
  • Improve existing automations and build new automated processes (e.g., outreach, tracking, reporting, payments) to increase team efficiency and scalability

Strategy and measurement

  • Develop influencer strategies and programs aligned with overall brand and business objectives
  • Research industry trends, emerging platforms, and competitor activity, and translate findings into actionable recommendations
  • Determine how we define and measure program success, including the KPIs, benchmarks, and reporting framework used across the organization
  • Own our approach to conversion measurement, including attribution methodology and tracking tools, so creator activity can be credibly tied to downstream results such as installs, trials, and paid subscriptions

What you'll bring

  • 5-7 years of experience in influencer, creator, or social media marketing, including experience managing celebrity or macro talent
  • Proven experience managing budgets and negotiating or overseeing creator contracts
  • Experience leading or mentoring team members
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience in attribution, performance reporting, and ROI analysis
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills
  • Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube creator ecosystems
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience in health, fitness, nutrition, or consumer subscription apps
  • Familiarity with mobile measurement partners, affiliate platforms, and creator management tools

Our widely adopted standards and frameworks are the foundation of health information exchange worldwide, enabling data to be shared, accessed, and applied to improve health outcomes and system performance.

We are entering an exciting new chapter of growth and transformation. Our strategic vision emphasizes brand recognition, revenue diversification and growth, and the ability to innovate in response to emerging healthcare challenges.

Position Summary

The Board & Operations Coordinator is a newly created role at HL7 International, established to bring dedicated focus to the day-to-day execution that keeps our Board governance, committee and working group operations, and leadership coordination running smoothly. Reporting to the COO and working closely with the CEO, this is a high-ownership position for someone who thrives on keeping complex, multi-stakeholder work organized, on track, and ahead of the curve.

This is an early-career opportunity for someone who is highly organized, tech-savvy, and energized by being the person who makes things happen. You don’t wait to be told what needs to happen — youanticipate it, consult and collaborate across functions as needed, build the systems around your responsibilities, and own the outcome.

How You’ll Make an Impact

In this role, you will become a key part of the operational backbone of HL7’s governance and executive functions. Because you own this work,HL7 executive leadership can stay focused on strategy, growth, and leadership — confident that Board and committee meetings are running smoothly, governance deadlines are never missed, and every partner interaction is well-coordinated.

Success in your first year looks like this: you are effectively running the Board calendar, risk and issues with key initiatives are being tracked, meeting minutes are accurate, professional, and delivered on time; governance processes like elections and committee communications go off without a hitch; and leadership consistently relies on you to handle the coordination of operational tasks.

Cook Inlet Region, Inc. is seeking a talented candidate to join the Yah (Dena'ina: "grow") Leadership Program.

Cook Inlet Region, Inc., also known as CIRI, is one of 12 land-based Alaska Native regional corporations created pursuant to the Alaska Native Claims Settlement Act (ANCSA). CIRI’s regional boundaries roughly follow the traditional Dena’ina territory of Southcentral Alaska. CIRI was incorporated on June 8, 1972, and is owned today by a diverse group of more than 9,500 Shareholders who live in Alaska and throughout the world.

CIRI offers excellent benefits for eligible employees. Benefits include paid holidays, paid time off, 401K with employer match, dental, vision, health insurance plans through the Federal Employee Health Benefits (FEHB) program, as well as life and disability benefits.

CIRI only accepts applications through our online career page at

Program Overview

In alignment with CIRI’s mission, values and policies, this multi-year program is designed to provide CIRI Shareholders and confirmed Descendants professional growth, senior and executive leadership-level development, and expand CIRI, and its affiliates, senior and executive leadership talent pool. During the program's first year, the successful candidate will be placed at CIRI and directly report to the CEO. In addition to the CIRI President, a CIRI executive will be assigned to mentor the successful candidate for the duration of the program. An individual development plan will be created based on the successful candidate’s interests and skills. The individual development plan will help guide the successful candidate through the program. CIRI will support the successful candidate’s placement within CIRI and with CIRI subsidiaries during the program.

During year one of the program, the Yah will receive exposure to and learn various executive-level leadership skills, including an understanding of CIRI’s business lines and strategy, operations, and ANCSA/mission-critical programs and benefits. S/he will provide senior and executive level leadership support to the CIRI executive leadership team (ELT), serve as a liaison between internal/external contacts and the CIRI ELT, and help oversee special projects. Additionally, s/he will represent CIRI at business, community, and Shareholder and Descendant meetings and events. The ideal candidate will value innovation, creativity and strategic thinking, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Major Activities

  1. Serve as a bridge for communication between the executive leadership team and internal CIRI departments, maintaining credibility, trust, and support among CIRI staff and leadership.
  2. Work closely with the executive leadership team, including managing special projects.
  3. Participate as an adjunct member of the executive leadership team, including scheduling and attending meetings.
  4. Ensure the executive leadership team is well-informed and well-prepared for upcoming meetings and commitments related to assigned projects.
  5. Prioritize conflicting needs and handle matters expeditiously and proactively, including those raised by the executive leadership team, and matters of a sensitive or confidential nature.
  6. Draft correspondence and reports as needed.
  7. Work with the communications team to coordinate strategic communications for diverse audiences regarding the executive leadership team’s outreach efforts and activities.
  8. Follow up on contacts made by the executive leadership team. Lead efforts to build and maintain strategic relationships within CIRI and with CIRI-affiliated entities, current and potential business partners, and the community.
  9. Support education efforts related to the Alaska Native Claims Settlement Act (ANCSA) and CIRI’s history and unique model of self-determination.
  10. Participate in learning opportunities to enhance skills.
  11. Attend ELT, Board, and Shareholder meetings and events.
  12. Travel frequently with the executive leadership team.
  13. Perform other duties as appropriate and as assigned.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

  • Understand CIRI’s mission, vision, values and strategic focus areas, and incorporate knowledge into daily activities.
  • General understanding of the history and compliance requirements of the SBA 8(a) program.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills to work effectively and cooperatively at all levels of the organization, including with management and staff, CIRI-affiliated organizations and employees, and external business associates. Always acts professionally in dealing with others.
  • Ability to make decisions that involve strategic thinking, problem-solving, and sound judgment.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to maintain accurate records and prepare and submit comprehensive reports.
  • Excellent financial management skills, including the ability to develop and manage department budgets.
  • Detail oriented, including superior organizational and follow-up skills.
  • Attention to accuracy and detail, including the ability to research, organize and analyze technical information.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills; ability to effectively present information and respond sensitively to questions from managers, staff and the public.
  • Proficient using Microsoft Office products, such as Word, Excel and PowerPoint, and industry-standard computer software and databases.
  • Strong leadership, supervisory, management and mentoring skills.
  • High degree of sensitivity regarding confidential information.
  • During year one of the program, the position may be based in Anchorage, Washington, D.C., or work remotely.
  • Ability to travel, as necessary.

Physical Abilities

  • Sufficient fine motor skills for use of computers and calculators with an ability to withstand repetitive keyboarding for extended periods.
  • Visual and communication ability adequate to perform the essential functions of the job.
  • Ability to safely operate a motor vehicle and fly by commercial or small aircraft.
  • Ability to kneel, bend and twist at the waist on an occasional basis.
  • Ability to reach below shoulder height with regular frequency (desk position) and at or above shoulder height on occasion.
  • Ability to push, pull, carry and lift objects weighing up to 20 pounds on an occasional basis.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in relevant field.
  • Master’s degree in business or advanced degree in relevant field preferred.
  • Seven+ years’ experience in business, organizational leadership, finance, operations, legal or related field.
  • Two years of supervisory experience.
  • Work experience that illustrates a knowledge of ANCSA and/or Alaska Native cultures preferred.
  • Ability to obtain a security clearance.
  • Ability to pass a background and driving record check.

Essential

  • Essential - Experience developing business with public sector organisations, with an understanding of their stakeholder structures, decision-making processes and workforce priorities.
  • Confident communication and presentation skills, with the ability to ask thoughtful questions and explain the value of a learning solution.
  • Strong research, organisation and CRM skills, with the ability to manage a pipeline and follow through on commitments.
  • The self-motivation and resilience to work effectively remotely while contributing to a collaborative sales team.

Desirable

Interpersonal Fit

This person will play a crucial role in advancing our analytics team to the next phase of development to help implement a best in class analytics practice.

You will lead by example, building analytical models yourself while developing the talent around you to turn complex subscriber and product data into high-leverage business decisions.

Contract type: Full Time (37 hours per week), Permanent

Closing date: 2 November 2026, Midday

Interviews: We will be interviewing on a rolling basis. Please apply as soon as possible

Who we are

Futures For All is the largest social mobility charity in the UK. We help to level the playing field between state and independent schools by giving all young people access to the same prestigious networks available to the top fee-paying schools.

We believe that by inspiring young people to explore their ambitions through our speaker programme, facilitating access to multi-day experiences of the world of work, and supporting young people to successfully seize opportunities available to them, then we can make a profound difference to the lives of young people, their future happiness and prosperity.

By 2028, our ambition is that every young person in the UK has access to high quality work experience. Yet today, less than half of young people leave secondary school having had any work experience whatsoever.

Role Summary

The primary purpose of the Senior Partnership Manager is to drive the expansion of the Work Experience Finder through the recruitment, onboarding and ongoing management of strategic partners across the UK. This will include, but is not limited to, Careers Hubs, Combined Authorities, Local Authorities, Employer Representative Bodies, Chambers of Commerce, employer associations and other strategic organisations.

The role requires extensive travel across the UK to build strong relationships with prospective and existing partners, confidently presenting the Futures For All offer to senior stakeholders and securing long-term partnerships that generate sustainable project income and flow of employer engagement.

Working closely with the Director of Development, the Senior Partnership Manager will build and maintain a strong partnership pipeline, negotiate partnership agreements and contracts, and ensure the successful operational onboarding and ongoing management of partners.

The Senior Partnership Manager will play a key role in enabling employer engagement at scale through partner networks, ensuring high-quality delivery and contributing to the continued growth of WEX Finder and the wider organisational strategy.

Key Duties / Responsibilities

Strategic Purpose

  • Develop and manage strategic relationships with regional and national partners, with the primary objective of securing new WEX Finder partnerships and delivering against Futures for All's strategic growth.
  • Build, manage and convert a strong partnership pipeline, working closely with the Director of Development to achieve agreed partnership targets.
  • Identify and secure new partnership opportunities that expand organisational reach.
  • Negotiate partnership agreements, contracts and funding arrangements with prospective strategic partners, managing strategic partner relationships.
  • Represent Futures For All at regional and national events, conferences and stakeholder meetings to raise awareness, develop new opportunities and promote WEX Finder.
  • Work with partners to develop regional employer engagement strategies that increase the number of employers offering high-quality work experience opportunities.

Engagement

  • Deliver engaging presentations, demonstrations and proposals to senior stakeholders and decision-makers, both virtually and in person.
  • Develop trusted relationships with Careers Hubs, Combined Authorities, Local Authorities, Employer Representative Bodies, Chambers of Commerce and other strategic organisations.
  • Work collaboratively with the Director of Development, Marketing, Programme, Delivery and Technology teams to ensure partnership opportunities are successfully developed and implemented.
  • Drive employer engagement through partner networks, increasing employer participation in work experience and careers programmes at scale.
  • Act as a trusted adviser to partners, maintaining regular communication and identifying opportunities to strengthen and grow relationships.
  • Represent Futures For All externally, promoting the organisation's mission, impact and services.

Delivery

  • Lead the onboarding of new partners, ensuring a seamless transition from contract agreement through to operational delivery.
  • Monitor partnership performance against agreed KPIs, producing regular reports on performance, risks and opportunities.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, partnership forecasts and pipeline reporting.
  • Represent and work to our values, fostering a culture of positivity, collaboration, respect and inclusivity, while taking personal responsibility for performance and continuous development.
  • Ensure safeguarding best practice is embedded throughout all organisational activity.
  • Confidently communicate Futures For All's mission, services and impact through written communication, presentations, virtual meetings and face-to-face engagement.
  • Work closely with Programme, Delivery and Employer Engagement teams to ensure successful implementation and continuous improvement of partnerships.
  • Manage the ongoing operational relationship with strategic partners, ensuring contractual commitments, service standards and agreed outcomes are achieved.

Skills / Experience / Knowledge:

Essential:

  • Proven experience in partnership development, business development, account management or stakeholder engagement.
  • Experience developing and managing strategic partnerships with public sector organisations, education providers, employers or membership organisations.
  • Demonstrable experience of generating income, developing commercial opportunities and achieving partnership or sales targets.
  • Excellent presentation, communication and influencing skills, with confidence presenting to senior leaders and external stakeholders.

  • Experience building, managing and reporting on a sales or partnership pipeline using a CRM.
  • Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously.

Medical Communications & Medical Writing

Education & Professional Affairs

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a science or technical field required; advanced degree (PharmD, PhD, MSc, OD) desirable.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3–4 years of relevant experience in medical affairs, medical communications, or a medical communications agency.
  • Prior hands-on experience in Medico-Legal Review (MLR) is required.
  • Demonstrated strength in scientific/medical writing, referencing, and content fact checking.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, analytical, and interpersonal skills; fluency in English.
  • Demonstrated ability to understand the science and clinical aspects of a product portfolio.

Desirable

As an Architectural Visualization & AI Automation Specialist, you will join a high-end architecture and interior design studio specializing in fully customized residential environments and operating across major international markets. The firm develops bespoke architectural elements, custom interiors, and furniture, while also operating an in-studio gallery. To support its continued expansion across its international locations, leadership is looking to establish an end-to-end automation infrastructure from scratch to improve operational efficiency across all studio functions.

In this role, you will be responsible for identifying, developing, and implementing practical AI-driven automation tools across the firm's architectural and business workflows. Combining hands-on expertise in SketchUp and AutoCAD with practical AI automation skills, you will initially focus on streamlining 3D-to-photorealistic rendering pipelines and converting 3D models into precise 2D design development sets. Over time, you will extend automation solutions across procurement, vendor outreach, client presentations, photography reports, gallery inventory tracking, and administrative workflows.

Accountability

As an Architectural Visualization & AI Automation Specialist, your success will be defined by your ability to independently build, test, and deploy functional AI automation solutions that reduce manual drafting and visualization time while maintaining millimeter-level precision and studio quality standards. Here’s how you’ll make an impact:

Architectural Visualization & Rendering Automation

    • Analyze existing visualization workflows and work directly with 3D models created in SketchUp and AutoCAD.
    • Identify opportunities to automate the conversion of 3D models into photorealistic renderings by configuring AI-assisted visualization tools and workflows.
    • Evaluate AI platforms, test generated outputs against studio design standards, and document repeatable workflows to ensure visual consistency and production efficiency.

3D-to-2D Design Development Drawing Automation

    • Review the current 2D design development set production process in AutoCAD and identify repetitive drafting tasks.
    • Develop and implement automation solutions to convert approved 3D designs into detailed, highly precise 2D documentation sets.
    • Ensure all automated drawing outputs strictly preserve millimeter-level dimensional accuracy and technical standards, establishing required human-in-the-loop validation checkpoints.

AI Automation Infrastructure & Custom Tool Development

    • Design, build, test, and maintain custom AI agents, automated scripts, and integration workflows from scratch.
    • Evaluate AI platforms and technologies (building upon initial studio experiments with tools like Claude and Astra) to select the most suitable tools for each department.

Quality Assurance, SOPs & Team Adoption

    • Author comprehensive SOPs and documentation for every implemented tool and workflow.
    • Lead training and support team adoption across both international studio locations (Los Angeles and Milan), gathering ongoing user feedback for continuous improvement.

In your first year, you’ll…

  • Build a dependable Business Operations foundation for the full customer journey, with clear ownership from contract signature through implementation and billing to the Customer Success handoff.

  • Give leadership timely, decision-ready visibility into revenue quality and sales margin, connecting commercial terms and service costs to operational choices, while continuing to improve and grow the customer support/CX team by evolving from purely inbound to more outbound and proactive support.

  • Create repeatable cross-functional ways of working with Sales, Product, Engineering, CX, and CS while keeping responsibilities clear across teams.

  • Expand your ownership as Endear grows by spotting the next operational constraint, proposing a practical solution, and delivering results within the direction and budget approved by Leigh.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If…

You Have Experience With

  • Experience in Business Operations, Strategy & Operations, Customer Operations, or a broad adjacent role at a Series A company or a similarly early-stage, venture-backed startup.

  • A record of inheriting operating systems, finding what needs to improve, and implementing changes that make the business work better.

Align With What We Value

At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role:

Customer First:

Connects operational choices to merchants’ and sales associates’ experience. Builds reliable contracting, implementation, billing, and live-chat support practices, with smooth handoffs to Customer Success.

Take Ownership:

Enable Autonomy:

Creates clear workflows, documentation, and ownership so CX, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success can do their work with confidence while keeping CRM ownership with its designated team.

Under Promise, Over Deliver:

Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly:

No entras a mantener campañas que ya existen. Entras a construir un área.

Tareas

Captación de pago

  • Estrategia, montaje y optimización de campañas en Google Ads y Meta Ads, con presupuesto propio desde el primer mes y libertad para decidir dónde se invierte.
  • Supervisión de la agencia externa que hoy lleva redes sociales.

Embudos y medición

  • Diseño de los embudos completos: anuncio, landing, formulario, seguimiento y cierre en HubSpot.
  • Medición seria de principio a fin: GA4, Google Tag Manager (incluido server-side), consent mode, conversiones mejoradas, API de conversiones de Meta y envío de conversiones offline desde el CRM.
  • Un informe mensual con las cifras que importan: coste por oportunidad, coste de adquisición y retorno. Nada de impresiones ni de capturas de pantalla.

Visibilidad en buscadores y en IA

  • Conseguir que AIT aparezca cuando alguien pregunta por nuestros servicios, tanto en Google como en ChatGPT, Gemini o Perplexity.
  • Contenido, datos estructurados y presencia en las fuentes que los modelos citan. Y un método para medirlo.

Automatización con agentes de IA

  • Detectar qué partes del trabajo de marketing y preventa pueden ejecutarse solas, especificarlas y medir las horas que ahorran.
  • No las programas tú: las construye nuestro equipo técnico contigo. Tienes 40 personas para hacer realidad lo que diseñes.

De AIT a nuestros clientes

  • Los primeros meses trabajas puertas adentro. Después empaquetas lo aprendido (alcance, precios, plantillas e informes) y lo llevas a las primeras cuentas de cliente.

Lo que este puesto NO es

  • No es cerrar ventas: para eso está el equipo comercial.
  • No es coordinar a una agencia y reenviar sus informes.

Requisitos

Imprescindible

  • Experiencia real gestionando presupuesto propio o de cliente en Google Ads y Meta Ads, con resultados que puedas explicar con números.
  • Dominio técnico de la medición: GA4, Google Tag Manager (incluido server-side), consent mode, conversiones mejoradas y API de conversiones.
  • Haber trabajado con un CRM como parte del embudo, no como un archivo aparte. Nosotros usamos HubSpot.
  • Criterio para venta B2B de ciclo largo y ticket alto, no solo e-commerce de compra impulsiva.
  • Mentalidad de construir sistemas, no de apagar fuegos.

Muy valorable

  • Trabajo hecho en posicionamiento en motores generativos (GEO/AEO) y capacidad de explicar cómo lo mides.
  • Automatización con herramientas de flujos y uso serio de IA en tu día a día, con ahorros medidos.
  • Experiencia previa entregando servicio a clientes, no solo in-house.
  • Conocimiento de industria, retail o e-commerce con ERP detrás.

Qué esperamos de ti y cuándo

  • A los 90 días: medición limpia y validada, campañas encendidas y un coste por oportunidad de referencia sobre el que trabajar.
  • A los 6 meses: un flujo estable de oportunidades cualificadas entrantes, con su coste conocido y bajando.
  • A los 12 meses: una parte relevante del pipeline con origen digital y el servicio funcionando en las primeras cuentas de cliente.

No te vamos a pedir retorno en el mes dos. Te vamos a pedir que a los 90 días podamos confiar en los números.

Beneficios

  • Presupuesto de medios propio desde el primer mes. No vas a tener que pelear cada euro.
  • Un equipo técnico de 40 personas que construye lo que diseñes: integraciones, agentes de IA, landings y conexiones con ERP. En una agencia eso no lo tienes.
  • Una cartera de más de 1.000 clientes a la que ofrecer el servicio cuando esté listo.
  • Acceso directo al CEO y autonomía real: las decisiones se toman en la misma conversación, no en tres comités.
  • Contrato indefinido y salario acorde a experiencia demostrable, más variable ligado a resultados.

- Formación y herramientas cubiertas.

  • Recorrido real: este puesto está pensado para acabar dirigiendo un área con equipo propio.

Si has llegado hasta aquí y te reconoces en el puesto, escríbenos con un caso concreto: una cuenta que mejoraste, qué medías antes, qué mediste después y qué cambió en el negocio. Un párrafo con un número real nos dice más que tres páginas de currículum.

Nuestro proceso son cinco pasos y unas dos semanas: primer contacto, entrevista técnica, una prueba práctica sobre un caso real nuestro (que pagamos, porque tu tiempo vale), defensa de la prueba con nuestro equipo y conversación final de encaje y condiciones.

Te responderemos en todos los casos, tanto si avanzamos como si no.

Location: United States (Remote, Eastern Coast)

About LemonEdge

LemonEdge is a next-generation accounting platform purpose-built for private capital markets. Our technology gives fund administrators and asset managers the tools to automate complexity, improve transparency, build trust, and scale faster. With strong early traction in North America and EMEA, we are now entering our next phase of growth focused on customer expansion, operational discipline, and world-class client experience.

About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer at LemonEdge, you’ll own meaningful parts of our accounting platform, from data model to production. You’ll design and ship the features and services that move fund operations from manual and fragile to automated and dependable, and you’ll have the latitude to fix what’s in the way, whether that’s a performance bottleneck, a test gap, or architecture that has outlived its usefulness.

You’ll be building alongside a market in the middle of real change. Private capital is growing fast, and the way funds are created, administered, and managed is being rebuilt around modern software rather than spreadsheets and systems designed for a different era. LemonEdge is purpose-built for that shift, and what you ship goes straight to the fund administrators and asset managers who run on it. The engineering is hard and the impact is visible: your work changes how an entire industry operates.

The financial logic must be exactly right, the platform needs to hold up at real scale, and customers feel every improvement you make. You’ll be trusted to keep a living codebase healthy, not just to build on it. We use AI-assisted development pragmatically and with clear guardrails, and you’ll help shape how the team puts it to work.

LemonEdge is a remote-first company. This role is open to candidates based in the United States who can work core Eastern Time hours. Expect occasional travel for team and customer onsites, typically up to four times per year. The role participates in an engineering on-call rotation, which is light and infrequent.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and ship features and services on the LemonEdge platform end-to-end — from data model and API design through testing, deployment, and production operation.
  • Identify and implement high-impact improvements: performance baselines, reliability hardening, refactoring of high-traffic paths, and optimizing data-access patterns the rest of the platform sits on.
  • Partner with Product, Client Success, and peer engineering teams to scope work, own delivery of committed customer-visible milestones across the quarterly roadmap, and surface trade-offs and risks early rather than late.
  • Work directly with technical and subject-matter accounting experts both internally and from our clients to shape the solution and rapidly iterate on their feedback.

jobs.description:
Cavallo is looking for a Product Designer to create intuitive, high-impact experiences for distributors navigating complex operational challenges. You will partner closely with product managers, engineers, customers, and fellow designers to turn ambiguity into clear, useful, and scalable product experiences.

This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong product thinking with exceptional craft. You are curious about how emerging technologies can improve both the products we build and the way design work gets done. You will help shape intelligent, trustworthy experiences that make complex workflows feel simple, fast, and actionable.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead design work across the full product development lifecycle, from early discovery and concept exploration through detailed interaction design and implementation.
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers to define problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and shape solutions together.
  • Engage directly with customers and customer-facing teams to uncover pain points, validate concepts, and identify opportunities.
  • Use qualitative research, product data, and business insights to inform decisions and measure the impact of design improvements.
  • Leverage AI tools to streamline research, generate and test ideas, and move from concept to validated design more quickly.
  • Explore opportunities to introduce AI-powered capabilities that are useful, explainable, and grounded in real customer needs.
  • Contribute to and evolve Cavallo’s design system, interaction patterns, and product standards for greater consistency and scalability.
  • Collaborate with engineering throughout implementation to preserve the intent, quality, and usability of the final experience.
  • Help raise the quality bar for product thinking, visual design, usability, and accessibility across the organization.
  • Make complex B2B workflows feel clear, efficient, and intuitive without oversimplifying the work our customers need to accomplish.

What You Bring

  • 5 years of experience in product design, UX/UI design, or a related discipline, preferably within B2B, SaaS, enterprise software, or data-rich products.
  • A strong portfolio that demonstrates your process, product thinking, interaction design, visual craft, and ability to solve complex problems.
  • Experience designing end-to-end product experiences, from research and problem definition through prototyping, validation, and polished UI.
  • Strong systems thinking and the ability to understand how individual features fit within a broader product ecosystem.
  • A high level of proficiency in Figma and modern prototyping workflows.
  • Experience using AI tools to improve the speed or quality of your design process, paired with the judgment to evaluate their outputs critically.
  • Curiosity about AI-native product experiences and how intelligent systems can support, rather than complicate, customer decision-making.
  • The ability to create prototypes at the appropriate level of fidelity, from rapid concept models to realistic, interactive experiences.
  • A strong foundation in human-computer interaction, with the ability to apply behavioral principles, usability heuristics, and user-centered design methods to complex product experiences.
  • Comfort navigating ambiguity, asking strong questions, and bringing structure to loosely defined problems.

Nice to Have

  • Degree in Human-Computer Interaction, UX Design, Interaction Design, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience designing enterprise, analytics, financial, operational, or workflow-heavy software.
  • Familiarity with distribution, order management, ERP, inventory, supply chain, or related business systems.
  • Experience designing AI-powered features, conversational interfaces, decision-support tools, or human-in-the-loop workflows.
  • Experience with data visualization and translating complex information into clear, actionable insights.
  • A foundational understanding of front-end technologies and how design decisions affect implementation.
  • Experience with motion design, interaction animation, or advanced prototyping.
  • Familiarity with product analytics, experimentation, or measuring the impact of design changes.

Why Join Cavallo?

  • Help solve meaningful operational challenges for distributors and the people who keep their businesses running.
  • Work on complex product problems where thoughtful design can create visible, measurable customer value.
  • Join a product-first team where designers are involved in shaping problems, not simply producing interfaces.
  • Collaborate with colleagues who value curiosity, constructive feedback, and shared ownership.
  • Help define how Cavallo thoughtfully incorporates AI into its products and product-development practices.
  • Contribute to the evolution of a growing SaaS platform, design system, and product organization.
  • Work with leaders who believe great design is essential to creating trustworthy, useful, and differentiated products.
  • Grow your skills while having meaningful influence over the direction and quality of the customer experience.

About Cavallo

Cavallo is at the forefront of developing cutting-edge profit technologies for product-centric brands and wholesale distributors. . We’re seeking the self-motivated, the hard-working, the problem solvers, and the dedicated to join our team of experts. We're focused on helping businesses grow, expand, or reshape how they do things by approaching each and every problem with energy, creativity, and confidence. Ingenuity, adaptation, and evolution are at the core for us at Cavallo.

Our Grand Rapids-based headquarters is focused on helping change the way organizations do business through our software products, customizations, expertise, and support. Our enterprise software solutions work with leading business applications, including multiple leading ERP platforms, and integrate with a wide range of apps and other technologies. Cavallo has been in the business of helping manufacturing and distribution companies increase productivity and efficiency since 2003. We got our start when a small business owner tasked a software developer with transforming a pile of clipboards and legal pads into a streamlined, efficient inventory management system. We have been sharing ideas and innovating ever since.

Join Cavallo and help shape the next generation of data-driven enterprise solutions. If you are passionate about innovation, execution, and scaling world-class products, we’d love to hear from you!

jobs.description:
Company Summary:

Slang AI is redefining customer engagement through conversational AI, making every interaction seamless and efficient. Our mission is to transform the restaurant industry by providing the ultimate voice AI solution for consistently outstanding customer experiences. At Slang AI, we foster a culture of innovation, inclusivity, and growth, ensuring that every "Slangsta" (employee) feels valued and connected to our broader AI driven impact.

What Your Experience Will Be:

As a Client Experience Manager at Slang AI, you’ll own the end-to-end customer journey for our SMB clients — from onboarding through long-term success and day-to-day support. You’ll guide customers through their initial rollout, transition seamlessly into serving as their long-term success manager, and directly manage the support inbox during business hours, where many of their most important interactions occur.
Because support volume is currently low (fewer than 60 inquiries per month across 1,500+ customers), this role offers the opportunity to both deliver excellent frontline support and help design how support scales as we grow. You’ll gain unique visibility into customer needs in real time while influencing the tools, processes, and standards that will shape support as the business expands.
This unique scope means you’ll be both a strategic advisor and a hands-on partner, ensuring customers launch smoothly, adopt key features, resolve challenges quickly, and realize the full value of Slang. By owning these critical touch points, you’ll have a large sphere of influence over customer outcomes, shaping retention, adoption, and satisfaction across a significant segment of the business.
In addition, you’ll play a key role in our digital customer success program — helping define and refine automated success sequences to ensure accuracy, consistency, and strong adoption results. This work ensures customers experience the same hospitality-first service at scale, while giving you a direct impact on how Slang drives measurable results for our clients.

Why You Belong Here & How You Will Grow:

At Slang, we believe success starts with great execution and great service. In this role, you’ll gain valuable experience managing full customer lifecycles and working with hospitality operators in a fast-paced environment. You’ll learn how to onboard, support, and grow a book of business with autonomy, while contributing to scalable processes that improve outcomes across the team. We offer training, feedback, and growth opportunities to help you level up in customer success, technical product fluency, and strategic account management.

What Success Looks Like

  • Driving Long-Term Success: You are responsible for the health and success of your assigned accounts. You ensure customers are seeing clear outcomes, meeting their goals, and staying on track for renewal.
  • Building Trusted Relationship: You build strong relationships with a range of customer stakeholders — from General Managers to Operations Leaders — and know how to tailor your approach depending on their needs.
  • Renewals & Retention: You own the renewal process and are accountable for maintaining and growing account revenue. You identify risks early, take action to resolve issues, and keep customers satisfied and committed.
  • Surfacing Growth Opportunity: You surface expansion opportunities (e.g. additional locations or use cases) and work with Sales to execute. You contribute to the team’s Net Revenue Retention (NRR) goal.
  • Feature Adoption & Product Fluency: You guide customers through product updates, encourage usage of key features, and tie adoption back to business outcomes. You’re expected to understand and explain Slang’s value.
  • Onboarding and Success Planning: You create simple account plans to track customer goals, key contacts, risks, and growth potential. You align internal teams around each plan to support execution.
  • Voice of the Customer: You escalate customer feedback internally and contribute insights that improve product and service. You partner with Product and Support to advocate for customer needs.
  • Hospitality-First Service: You respond quickly, handle challenges with professionalism, and make interactions easy for customers. You aim to create a positive experience in every conversation.

What You Will Bring

  • Customer Focus: You care about helping customers succeed. You’re responsive, thoughtful, and proactive.
  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or client-facing roles. Background in restaurants or hospitality tech is strongly preferred.
  • Business Acumen: You understand restaurant operations and how to align Slang’s value with business goals. You’re comfortable working with executives and frontline staff alike.
  • Communication: You’re clear and concise in both written and verbal communication. You know how to explain ideas, give updates, and lead customer conversations.
  • Ownership: You manage your book of business with attention to detail. You’re accountable for renewals, engagement, and outcomes.
  • Adaptability: You’re comfortable in a fast-changing environment and open to feedback. You handle ambiguity and know how to prioritize.
  • Preferred: Experience with restaurant operations, phone systems, or reservation platforms is a plus.

How Work Affects My Life:

As a Client Experience Manager for SMBs, you’ll directly contribute to the success of hospitality teams. Your work helps restaurant staff be more productive, improve guest service, and hit their business goals. In return, Slang supports you with competitive pay, benefits, and a culture that values performance and teamwork. You’ll have clear goals, a meaningful role, and the opportunity to grow.

Our Vision

Calling a business shouldn’t feel like a robot-hostage situation, where you’re forced to listen to horrible music and can't reach a human, while enduring a soulless voice uttering "I'm sorry I didn't quite get that" on repeat for eternity. (shudder) That’s why we started Slang.ai. We use the latest AI and audio wizardry to make transacting via voice so enjoyable it’s more human than human. By 2030, we will save businesses and consumers 1 billion minutes of precious time while transforming voice channels into the preferred mode of communication (it's faster and easier than text).
We have backgrounds building product at companies like Spotify, Buzzfeed, the New York Times, and OpenTable —shipping experiences that have reached hundreds of millions of users. Now, we’re using our backgrounds to start a new culture, one that puts product and human-centered design above all else while fostering constant learning and growth. Sound like something you’d like to be part of? Get on board.

Our Values

Overachiever Fever. We’re overachievers (we don’t know any other way)
Learner Fervor. We take every opportunity to learn (especially when it’s hard)
Humility Ability. We approach each other with curiosity and openness (know-it-alls not welcome!)
SMB MVP. We’re an expert member of our customers’ teams (we earn their trust)

It means being immersed in a supportive culture that recognizes you as a key player in Armstrong's future. We are a large company with a local feel, where you will get to know and collaborate with leadership and your colleagues across the company. Arktura LLC is a widely published company headquartered in a fast-paced design office and manufacturing facility in Los Angeles, CA. We design, develop, and manufacture a variety of façade systems, interior wall and ceiling systems, custom art installations on a full range of state-of-the-art equipment, in our 100,000 sf facility.

Working at Arktura is the best! Benefits include 401k with employee match, robust health care options, paid time off and professional development. We have a casual dress code, free snacks, and quarterly events! As a company, we love to engage in community service activities with our local organizations. We provide access to 100’s of discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through LifeMart such as car and hotel rentals and auto, home, and pet insurance, legal services, and childcare We support Employee Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion and provide perspective.

As National Sales Director, you’ll lead Arktura’s sales strategy and performance across the United States and Canada. Reporting to the General Manager, Arktura, you’ll drive profitable growth, lead the East, West, and Central Regional Sales Managers, and strengthen alignment between Sales and Marketing to advance the company’s business objectives and growth strategy.

What’s in It for You

  • Make a measurable impact on revenue growth, profitability, market expansion, and overall business performance.
  • Build and develop a high-performing sales organization that includes regional sales leaders and a network of independent sales representatives.
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and other business functions to shape strategy and strengthen Arktura’s position in the architecture and design industry.

What You’ll Do

  • Own national sales performance, including revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, growth, and project profitability.
