Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct production support experience with Tecsys Elite WMS and Elite Distribution ERP.
  • Experience with Tecsys Itopia and/or additional Tecsys modules such as:
    • Transportation Management (TMS)
    • Delivery Management
    • TecsysIQ / Analytics
    • Order Management
  • Experience with relational databases, Oracle, Linux/Unix, Windows, scripting, job scheduling, monitoring tools, or cloud/SaaS environments.
  • Experience supporting upgrades, releases, implementations, go-lives, cutovers, and hypercare.
  • Experience in large-scale warehouse, distribution, logistics, or supply chain environments.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you'll help ensure stable, reliable warehouse and distribution operations by:

  • Resolving critical production issues quickly.
  • Reducing recurring incidents and manual workarounds.
  • Improving transaction reliability and system performance.
  • Maintaining accurate and reconciled WMS, ERP, and shipping transactions.
  • Supporting successful Tecsys releases, upgrades, and enhancements.
  • Improving support processes, documentation, and knowledge across the organization.

The Ideal Candidate

You are a hands-on application support professional who understands both technology and warehouse operations. You can quickly diagnose complex problems, work calmly during production incidents, communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders, and collaborate effectively with developers, infrastructure teams, vendors, and business users.

If you have strong Tecsys Elite, WMS, distribution, integration, and production support experience, this is an opportunity to play a key role in keeping critical supply chain operations running reliably.

This position is eligible for company benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance with an employer contribution, flexible spending or health savings account, life and AD&D insurance, short- and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program with company match, and additional voluntary or legally-required benefits.

ProSidian Seeks a Business Support Analyst - Virtual Assistant (Part-Time | Contract Contingent). The Business Support Analyst - Virtual Assistant provides Business Support for the firm's daily business activities.

The Business Support Analyst - Virtual Assistant requires professionalism and technical capabilities to serve as a responsible and resourceful virtual assistant for our team. Working remotely, the Business Support Analyst - Virtual Assistant will organize and update files, create marketing materials, support business development, assist with operations and related activities, draft/formal policies and guidelines, perform research, assist in creating presentations and sales materials, etc.

The ideal candidate should be tech-savvy, able to communicate through multiple channels, and super organized. The Virtual Assistant may also support the arrangement of travel itineraries, flights, and rooms, as well as the tracking and management of expenses and payments.

While every employer is different, and each will have unique qualifications for a Virtual Assistant position, all activities required for success include tactics to support and enhance the organization's success. With our wide range of services, we provide tailored solutions that meet unique needs across Risk Management, Compliance, Business Process, IT Effectiveness, Energy & Sustainability, and Human Capital.

These activities require a depth of technical and strategic thought and actions, accuracy, attention to detail, and consistency in deliverables. This is a blended position requiring MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook/email, and MS Access skills, with both marketing and administrative acumen.

As a Business Support Analyst - Virtual Assistant, your tasks will vary based on client and Firm needs and your skills, including performing general executive assistant duties; formatting and typing documents; making travel arrangements; managing calendars; arranging meetings and appointments; performing research and setting up opportunity pipelines; updating social media; writing articles and content.

NOTE: Internet research, generating simple reports in Excel, occasional PowerPoint presentations, and various other administrative tasks as needed. Experience in MS Office, Google Apps, and Outlook is a must. Marketing responsibilities would include setting up and sending client newsletters, updating and publishing blog posts, and creating and monitoring social media accounts. Basic WordPress experience is a must. Experience in LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter, Hootsuite, and Instagram. Experience in Mailchimp or Constant Contact is also preferred, but not required.

Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

Are you passionate about Privacy Protections and the Open Web? Do you want to ship software to a large user base? Do you want your contributions to have a positive impact on the world? Do you want to advance current browser architecture to make the web a safer place for users?

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and restricted. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to support the Privacy Team to advance the Firefox Web Platform.

What you'll do:
  • Implement Privacy-improving, anti-tracking and threat intelligence protection into the Firefox web browser to mitigate user tracking and phishing.
  • Implement architectural improvements into Gecko, the browser engine underlying Firefox.
  • Build performant, low-latency, and maintainable C++, JavaScript and Rust code
  • Work as part of a geographically distributed team in an asynchronous manner (mostly Europe and US-East).

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. You can validate your progress and decisions and communicate them clearly.

When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

    • Apply LLMs and AI models to automate tasks such as document processing, data extraction from unstructured sources, and natural-language querying of enterprise data to support decision-making.
    • Integrate AI APIs and orchestration tools into existing enterprise architecture using middleware/iPaaS platforms.
    • Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to identify and implement automation opportunities.
    • Ensure AI solutions meet security, governance, and compliance standards.
    • Monitor, optimize, and maintain AI agent performance and reliability.
    • Document architectures, workflows, and integration specifications.

Requirements

jobs.description:
Senior Account Manager

Company Overview

Join a dynamic team that's redefining consumer data analytics. We empower top investment firms and global brands with cutting-edge insights into consumer spending, leveraging privacy-compliant data across geographies. Our real-time intelligence and merchant-level data give clients a competitive edge—and you'll be at the forefront of it all.

Role Summary

We're hiring a Senior Account Manager to own and grow our CPG and Grocery client portfolio. This isn't a renewals-only role. You'll be expected to identify whitespace within existing accounts and actively sell into it: new product lines, new teams, new use cases.

You'll work directly with client stakeholders who use our data for real decisions like where to expand, how to price, and how to read competitive share shifts. The role reports into Corporate Account Management and is fully remote, working standard East Coast hours.

What you'll own

  • Full lifecycle management of a CPG, grocery, retail and restaurant account book, with direct accountability for net revenue retention across renewals, upsells, and cross-sells
  • Building and executing against a defensible expansion plan for each account: mapping new buyers, identifying underused product lines, and proactively pitching them before the client asks
  • Serving as the senior point of contact for key accounts, developing relationships with executives beyond your original buyer, so the relationship survives champion turnover
  • Running contract negotiations and renewal conversations with a clear read on where there's room to expand scope, not just hold flat
  • Staying sharp on our product roadmap and translating new capabilities into specific pitches for specific clients, rather than generic feature updates
  • Keeping CRM and account records accurate so that leadership can trust the pipeline numbers
  • Partnering with Product, Marketing, Ops, and Customer Success to solve client problems fast and use those wins as expansion leverage
  • Feeding client and market intelligence back to AM leadership and Product so we're building what CPG, grocery, retail and restaurant clients actually need next

What we're looking for

  • 6+ years in account management or client-facing roles at a data, SaaS, or research company, ideally with CPG, Grocery, Retail or Restaurant clients. Bonus points for Commerce Media experience
  • A track record of growing accounts, not just retaining them. If you've carried an expansion or upsell number, we want to hear the specifics
  • Comfort selling to and negotiating with senior stakeholders (VP and above) inside large organizations
  • Working knowledge of Excel, PowerPoint, and Salesforce
  • Strong analytical instincts. You should be able to look at category or share data and immediately see the story and the pitch inside it
  • Sharp written and verbal communication. You listen well enough to catch what a client didn't say
  • A self-starter who doesn't need to be told to chase whitespace

Why join Consumer Edge

Competitive salary, 401(k) match, full remote flexibility, and subsidized health benefits. You'll have real ownership over a strategic vertical and direct input into how we build our commerce and CPG product roadmap.

Salary

Annual base salary for this role is $140,000–$150,000 based on experience, plus commissions, 401(k) match, and subsidized health benefits.

Note: Consumer Edge is currently hiring employees who reside in the following states or in Washington, DC: CA, CO, CT, FL, ID, IL, LA, MA, MD, NC, NJ, NY, PA, RI, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI.

  • 定义钱包与交易产品逻辑，包括跨链交易结构、交易语义化展示、资产流转、签名链路和交互体验

  • 推动 Solana、EVM、BTC、Layer2 等生态的标准化接入与中台能力交付

Non-negotiables

  • 你交付过 Web3、数据平台、API、钱包、交易或基础设施产品，并被多条业务线真实依赖
  • 你理解链上资产、交易行为、协议机制、钱包流程和风险场景，能抽象出可复用的产品逻辑
  • 你能清楚定义数据字段、API 行为、标签规则、权限流程、异常场景、版本治理和多链差异
  • 你能推动产品、研发、数据、安全和运营团队完成架构取舍、交付推进、上线验证和效果复盘

jobs.excerpt: 【公司简介】我们是全球最早也是最成熟的数字资产平台之一，服务于全球数千万用户。我们始终位列全球Top交易所之列，提供涵盖数千种数字资产的全面交易和财富管理产品。我们拥有遍布全球主要金融中心的数千名员工，秉持远程优先、高度自主的企业文化，吸引着那些在快节奏、高挑战性环境中蓬勃发展的优秀人才。 【岗位职责】一、行情与实时数据系统1.
jobs.description:
【公司简介】

我们是全球最早也是最成熟的数字资产平台之一，服务于全球数千万用户。我们始终位列全球Top交易所之列，提供涵盖数千种数字资产的全面交易和财富管理产品。我们拥有遍布全球主要金融中心的数千名员工，秉持远程优先、高度自主的企业文化，吸引着那些在快节奏、高挑战性环境中蓬勃发展的优秀人才。

【岗位职责】

一、行情与实时数据系统

1.负责 Web3 行情系统的后端架构设计与开发，覆盖链上行情、DEX 池子数据、订单簿、成交流、K 线等多类实时数据的采集、清洗、聚合、存储与分发。

2.构建低延迟、高吞吐、可水平扩展的实时计算链路，保障行情数据在高并发场景下的稳定性、一致性与时效性。

3.设计并实现实时数据推送服务（WebSocket / gRPC Streaming 等），支撑前端、策略、交易等下游业务对实时行情的消费需求。

二、链上数据中台建设

1.负责链上数据中台的整体设计与落地，构建从节点接入、区块解析、事件解码到结构化存储的完整数据链路。

2.负责区块、交易、事件日志的解析与解码（Log Decode、Trace 解析、内部交易还原等），将原始链上数据转化为业务可消费的结构化数据。

3.抽象多链数据模型，沉淀通用的解析框架与数据资产，支撑行情、交易、钱包、预测市场等上层业务。

4.构建实时数据监控与报警机制，覆盖节点健康度、数据延迟、数据完整性、解析异常等关键指标。

【任职要求】

一、技术基础

1.5 年以上后端开发经验，语言 Java 或 Go 均可，熟悉 Java 者更佳

Java 方向：3 年以上 Java 实战经验，熟悉 JVM 调优、并发编程，掌握 Spring 生态。

Go 方向：3 年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine / Channel）、标准库及主流框架（Gin / Go-zero / Gorm）。

2.熟练掌握微服务架构与分布式系统设计（消息队列、分布式锁、熔断限流、幂等设计等）。

3.精通 SQL / NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理。

4.具备实时计算系统的落地经验，熟悉状态管理、背压、容错、Exactly-Once 等机制；使用过 Akka 或 Pekko、Reactor（或 Project Reactor / RxJava）、Redis Stream。

5.至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理（共识、P2P、Gas / 手续费模型等），熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。

6.熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Move / Sui 者优先。

7.具备链上数据中台、行情系统或类似数据平台的项目经验，熟悉 Log Decode、ABI 解析、Trace / Internal Tx 处理等，主导过多链数据模型抽象或通用解析框架的建设。

8.主导过中大型后端系统或数据平台从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地。

具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。

2.负责做市商接入协议的设计与实现，覆盖报价订阅、更新、成交确认与风控校验。

3.构建报价质量评估与做市商分级机制，动态调整路由权重。

三、高并发与低延迟

1.优化询价、路由、交易链路的端到端延迟与吞吐能力。

2.设计交易风控与限流机制，覆盖滑点保护、价格偏离、重放保护、Gas 异常等场景。

【任职要求】

一、技术基础

1.5 年以上后端开发经验，3 年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine / Channel）、标准库及主流框架（Gin / Go-zero / Gorm）。

2.熟练掌握微服务架构与分布式系统设计（消息队列、分布式锁、熔断限流、幂等设计等）。

3.精通 SQL / NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理。

具备低延迟、高并发系统的设计与优化经验。

4.至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理，熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。

5.熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Sui / Ton 者优先。

熟悉交易构造、签名、广播、Nonce 管理、Gas 策略等链上交易全链路，具备主网交易系统的实战经验。

6.熟悉主流 DEX（Uniswap V2 / V3、Curve、Raydium、Orca 等）的池子模型、价格计算与状态维护。

7.具备聚合器（如 1inch、Jupiter、OKX 等）的实际开发经验，主导或深度参与过路由算法、报价聚合或交易执行链路的设计与落地。

8.主导过中大型后端系统从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地。

9.具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。

2.有 MEV、Mempool 监听、Bundle 提交（如 Flashbots、Jito）等相关经验。

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.
Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs.
We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.
We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

Avalere Health is seeking a Consultant to join our Policy practice. We rely on deep subject matter expertise and a sophisticated understanding of the business challenges facing our clients to assess how the evolving policy landscape impacts pharmaceutical manufacturers, health plans, providers, and patients.

Our team provides strategic advisory services and analytic support across regulatory analysis, health policy strategy, evidence generation and review, legislative analysis, and policy modeling using qualitative and quantitative research methods.

Consultants are critical members of the Policy practice, leading complex workstreams, managing multiple client engagements, and translating policy developments into actionable business strategies. They collaborate closely with project leaders and multidisciplinary experts to deliver high-quality client solutions while contributing to account growth, practice development, and the mentorship of junior team members.

A candidate's experience, expertise, and demonstrated consulting capabilities will determine whether they are hired at the Consultant I or Consultant II level.

What you'll do

    Healthcare & Policy Expertise

    • Serve as a trusted subject matter expert on federal and state healthcare policy issues affecting pharmaceutical manufacturers, biotechnology companies, health plans, providers, and other healthcare stakeholders.
    • Monitor and analyze legislative, regulatory, and market developments, translating policy changes into meaningful business implications and strategic recommendations for clients.
    • Develop expertise across key policy areas including Medicare Part B and Part D, the Medicare Drug Price Negotiation Program under the Inflation Reduction Act, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and the 340B Drug Pricing Program.

      • Strategic Problem Solving & Client Advisory

      • Frame complex client challenges, synthesize diverse information sources, and develop practical, evidence-based strategic recommendations.
      • Apply qualitative and quantitative analyses to generate actionable insights that address client business and/or policy objectives.
      • Anticipate client needs and proactively identify areas in which Avalere can support such clients.

        • Client Management

        • Manage day-to-day client relationships across multiple engagements, serving as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact for designated workstreams and/or accounts.
        • Present complex analyses and recommendations confidently to client audiences, including senior executives.
        • Build long-term client relationships by delivering exceptional service, managing expectations, and identifying opportunities to expand engagements.

          • Project Management & Delivery

          • Manage project workstreams or project teams to successfully deliver high-quality work products on time and within budget while balancing competing priorities across multiple engagements.
          • Coordinate cross-functional teams and collaborate effectively with subject matter experts across Avalere Health.
          • Review and guide the work of Associates and other project team members by providing initial guidance on project tasks and feedback on draft materials and integrating SME and project leads input into final deliverables.

            • Storytelling & Communication

            • Translate complex policy analyses, research findings, and data into compelling, client-ready deliverables and executive-level presentations.
            • Ensure recommendations are supported by rigorous evidence and communicated through clear, concise, and persuasive narratives.
            • Distill complex and multi-faceted topics into clear and relevant points that can be conveyed to clients verbally and in writing

              • Leadership & Talent Development

              • Mentor, coach, and provide ongoing feedback to Associates and other junior team members.
              • Review work products to ensure analytical rigor and high-quality client deliverables.
              • Foster a collaborative, inclusive team environment and contribute to the continued growth of the Policy practice.

                • Data & Digital Innovation

                • Incorporate data-driven approaches and technology-enabled ways of working, including responsible use of AI and advanced analytical tools, to improve client outcomes and team efficiency.
                • Identify innovative methods, products, or analytical approaches that enhance project delivery and client impact.

About you

    Minimum Requirements

    • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Health Policy, Public Policy, Law, Public Health, Health Economics, Healthcare Management, Public Administration, Business Administration, or a related field.
    • 4+ years of relevant experience in healthcare consulting, pharmaceutical or biotechnology companies, health plans, advocacy organizations, government agencies, think tanks, or similar organizations.
    • Strong knowledge of the U.S. healthcare policy landscape and its commercial implications, particularly Medicare Part B and Part D, Medicare Drug Price Negotiation under the Inflation Reduction Act, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and the 340B Drug Pricing Program.
    • Demonstrated ability to translate complex policy analysis, research findings, and data into actionable business recommendations.
    • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects, including budgets, timelines, scope, and client expectations.
    • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to technical and executive audiences.
    • Strong analytical and strategic problem-solving capabilities with the ability to work independently with limited oversight.

      • Preferred Qualifications

      • Experience developing client proposals, statements of work, or supporting business development activities.
      • Experience leading client-facing presentations and executive discussions.
      • Experience leveraging advanced Excel, visualization tools, AI-enabled workflows, or other analytical technologies to improve project outcomes

What we can offer

You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August.
Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.

  • 持续跟踪全球主要市场的数字货币合规政策与法规变化，评估与分析对公司业务的合规风险影响。

  • 设计并优化合规功能模块，如用户身份认证、反洗钱（AML）、了解客户（KYC）等，提升平台合规性与安全性。

  • 与技术、法务、风控、运营等团队紧密协作，平衡合规要求与业务需求，推动合规性优化。
  • 独立撰写合规产品需求文档（PRD），并协调各方资源完成设计、开发与上线。
  • 5. 分站本地化与市场适配

jobs.excerpt: About:Veda is the DeFi engine powering financial apps enabling platforms to seamlessly create on-chain yield products.
jobs.description:
About:

Veda is the DeFi engine powering financial apps enabling platforms to seamlessly create on-chain yield products. Our mission is to unlock DeFi for the world by providing seamless, enterprise-grade integrations for modern finance. Veda's technology powers many of DeFi's largest vault products, including Liquid, PlasmaUSD Vault, Lombard DeFi Vault, and Mantle cmETH.
At $6B in TVL and 100k+ users, Veda is one of the fastest growing DeFi protocols with a team passionate about DeFi and dedicated to our work. This role will be high impact and have the opportunity to directly shape some of the most critical infrastructure in DeFi.

Role:

As a Smart Contract Engineer, you will contribute to our Solidity engineering organization — architecture, delivery, and security for all on-chain code. You will help to uphold world-class security and reliability standards for contracts securing ten-figure TVL.
We seek individuals with high agency to join us in defining the next phase of DeFi growth and adoption. The ideal candidate takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and adapts swiftly to evolving demands.

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to all Solidity codebases, including upgrade patterns, proxy architecture, account abstraction, and cross-chain messaging.
  • Drive rigorous design reviews, threat modeling, fuzz testing, and formal verification to achieve “audit-by-design” security
  • Continuous deployment, maintenance, and upgrades of existing vaults
  • Own end-to-end delivery of new protocol features
  • Manage external auditors and bug-bounty programs; implement on-chain monitoring and incident-response playbooks
  • Represent Veda in client integrations, conferences, and the broader open-source community

What you'll bring:

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience
  • 2-3+ years writing production Solidity (ERC-20/4626, custom libraries, proxy & upgrade patterns)
  • Track record of creating or maintaining a contract suite without critical incidents
  • Knowledge of EVM internals, gas optimization, storage layout, and common smart-contract exploits (re-entrancy, oracle manipulation, MEV)
  • Fluency with Foundry and/or Hardhat,
  • Excellent written and verbal English; comfortable presenting to executives, auditors, and the wider community

Preferred Skills & Experience:

  • Familiarity with multi-chain DeFi interactions and cross-chain messaging standards
  • Professional experience using Rust
  • Experience using Move-based smart-contract platforms (Aptos) would be a huge plus also.
  • Background in traditional finance, risk, credit, or derivatives a plus
  • Active contributor to open-source security research, EIPs, or protocol governance
  • Formal-verification expertise
  • Experience with audit cycles with top-tier firms (e.g., Trail of Bits, Spearbit)

Benefits at Veda

We’re a small, tight-knit team building the infrastructure that powers a new generation of financial products - on-chain, composable, and accessible to anyone. We believe the full potential of DeFi is still ahead of us, and we’re here to help unlock it.
We also believe that great work comes from people who feel trusted, supported, and aligned with the mission. Here’s how we try to make that happen:

Health Coverage

We offer medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees. For international contractors, we work closely to ensure access to appropriate local or global health coverage.

Flexible Time Off

We don’t track vacation days. Take the time you need to rest and recharge—we trust you to manage your schedule.

Remote-First by Design

Our team spans time zones and geographies. We work async, with a focus on autonomy over micromanagement.

Parental Leave

Paid leave is available for new parents, whether you’re the primary or secondary caregiver.

Learning & Development

We offer stipends to support ongoing learning - whether it’s a course, a conference, or something else that helps you grow.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Investigations
jobs.excerpt: SpyCloud is on a mission to make the internet a safer place by disrupting the criminal underground.
jobs.description:
SpyCloud is on a mission to make the internet a safer place by disrupting the criminal underground. SpyCloud’s solutions thwart cyberattacks and protect more than 4 billion accounts worldwide. Cybersecurity is an exciting, evolving space, and being at the forefront of the fight to disrupt cybercrime makes SpyCloud a special place to work. If you’re driven to align your career with a fantastic mission, look no further!

As the Principal Product Manager, Investigations, you will define and drive the AI-forward product strategy for SpyCloud's investigations capabilities. You will enable security teams, fraud analysts, investigators, and threat intelligence professionals to uncover, understand, and act on cybercriminal activity using intelligent, automated, and scalable workflows. Reporting to the Director of Product, Enterprise & Investigations, you will own a strategic product portfolio that transforms complex cybercrime data into AI-powered investigative insights and decision-making tools.

This is a highly cross-functional leadership role requiring close partnership with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Threat Intelligence, Go-to-Market teams, Customer Success, and Sales. You will balance long-term product vision with customer needs, market opportunities, and business priorities while delivering innovative, AI-driven capabilities that help customers investigate threats faster, reduce manual effort, and make more informed security decisions.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for SpyCloud's AI-powered Investigations product portfolio.
  • Identify and drive opportunities to embed AI, machine learning, and automation into investigative workflows.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer investigative workflows, threat intelligence use cases, and evolving cybercrime trends.
  • Translate customer problems, market opportunities, and business objectives into clear product requirements and prioritized roadmaps.
  • Lead product discovery through customer interviews, usability research, competitive analysis, and market validation, with a focus on AI-enabled solutions.
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Design, and Data Science throughout the product development lifecycle to deliver intelligent, high-impact capabilities.
  • Define success metrics and leverage product analytics, model performance data, and customer feedback to continuously improve the product.
  • Collaborate with SpyCloud Labs and Investigations teams to operationalize SpyCloud's unique cybercrime data, analytics, and AI models into customer-facing capabilities.
  • Partner with Sales, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering to ensure successful product launches and customer adoption of AI-driven features.
  • Serve as the product subject matter expert for investigations and AI capabilities with customers, prospects, analysts, and internal stakeholders.
  • Balance customer requests, technical investments, and strategic AI initiatives while making data-driven prioritization decisions.
  • Mentor other product managers in AI product strategy, roadmap planning, and modern product management best practices.
  • Stay on the leading edge of AI, cybersecurity, fraud, identity, threat intelligence, and digital investigations trends to identify emerging opportunities.
  • Be responsible for advancing and maintaining portfolio cohesion across graphical and programmatic (MCP, API, A2A) interfaces.

Requirements:

  • Educational Background:
    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Professional Experience:
    • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of enterprise SaaS products.
    • 5+ years of cyber threat intelligence experience, using OSINT and darknet data to investigate and respond to cybersecurity incidents.
    • Demonstrated experience leading product strategy and roadmap development for complex technical platforms.
    • Product launch and evangelism experience in leadership role alongside GTM.
    • Experience building products for cybersecurity, fraud prevention, digital identity, threat intelligence, investigations, or adjacent security domains.
    • Experience delivering AI/ML-powered products or features, including working with data science teams and model-driven capabilities.
    • Proven success partnering with engineering and data science organizations to deliver customer-centric products from concept through launch.
    • Experience working directly with enterprise and government customers to understand workflows and validate product direction.
    • Strong track record influencing executive stakeholders and driving cross-functional alignment without direct authority.
  • Technical Proficiency:
    • Working knowledge of cybersecurity concepts, digital investigations, identity intelligence, or threat intelligence platforms is required.
    • Experience with cybercrime investigations, digital forensics, fraud operations, or security operations center (SOC) workflows.
    • Hands-on experience applying AI or machine learning to investigative, security, or analytics workflows.
    • Knowledge of identity security, account takeover, malware ecosystems, credential theft, or criminal underground marketplaces.
    • Working knowledge of APIs, MCPs, data platforms, search technologies, analytics, and AI-assisted workflows.
    • Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS architecture and modern software development practices.
    • Experience using product management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Productboard, Figma, or similar platforms.
    • Ability to interpret product analytics, model performance data, and customer usage data to guide investment decisions.
  • Skills:
    • Exceptional strategic thinking with the ability to translate vision into executable, AI-enabled roadmaps.
    • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills with executive-level presentation capabilities.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a customer-first mindset.
    • Ability to navigate ambiguity and make informed prioritization decisions in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment.
    • Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills across technical, data science, and business organizations.
    • Demonstrated leadership, influence, and mentoring capabilities.
    • Strong familiarity with AI/ML technology concepts, including model lifecycle, data pipelines, and evaluation metrics.
  • Work Environment:
    • Ability to work effectively in a remote-first, highly collaborative environment.
    • Occasional travel for customer meetings, industry events, and internal planning sessions.

Nice to Have:

  • Currently holds or is capable of obtaining top secret security clearance from the US federal government
  • Strong familiarity with AI/ML technology concepts, including model lifecycle, data pipelines, and evaluation metrics.
  • Background working with enterprise security practitioners, fraud teams, or intelligence analysts.
  • Experience bringing AI-driven platform capabilities from concept through successful market adoption.
  • Familiarity with generative AI, LLMs, or AI-assisted user experiences in enterprise products.

Base Salary Range: $162,000 – $210,000

The salary range reflects the expected base compensation for a fully qualified candidate at this level based on experience, qualifications, and market data at the time of posting.

U.S.-Based Benefits + Perks (for Full Time Employees):

At SpyCloud, we are committed to working alongside individuals who are equally passionate about preventing cybercrime, regardless of their department or role. Guided by our core values in all business decisions, we prioritize unity in our mission and ensure all SpyCloud employees have the support and benefits they need to stay focused on our goals. In addition to our engaging workspace in South Austin, flexible and remote-friendly work options, and competitive salary package, we offer our employees a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

  • 401(k) with Employer Contribution
  • Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance
    • Health Savings Account (HSA) available with Employer Contribution
  • Employer Paid Life, Short-term, and Long-term Disability Insurance
  • Generous PTO Plan and 16 paid holidays per year

U.K.-Based Benefits + Perks (for Full Time Employees):

  • Retirement Savings Plan with Employer Contribution
  • Employer Provided Private Health Insurance and Healthcare Cashplan
  • Employer Paid Life Insurance and Income Replacement
  • Generous Holiday Plan and 14 paid holidays per year

About SpyCloud:

SpyCloud transforms recaptured darknet data to disrupt cybercrime. Its automated identity threat protection solutions use advanced analytics and AI to accelerate investigations and protect workforce, consumer, and supplier identities from the threats that matter most: authentication bypass, session hijacking, malicious insiders, account takeover, ransomware, and fraud. Its data from malware-infected devices, successful phishes, combolists, and third-party breaches also powers many popular dark web monitoring and identity theft protection offerings. Customers include 7 of the Fortune 10, along with hundreds of global enterprises, mid-sized companies, and government agencies worldwide. Headquartered in Austin, TX, SpyCloud is home to more than 250 cybersecurity experts whose mission is to protect businesses and consumers from the stolen identity data criminals are using to target them now.

To learn more and see insights on your company's exposed data, visit.

Our Mission:

Our mission is to make the internet a safer place by disrupting the criminal underground. Together with our customers and partners, we aim to end criminals’ ability to profit from stolen information.

Who We Are:

SpyCloud is a place for innovative, collaborative, and problem-solvers to thrive. Individually, we’re amazing, but together, we’re unstoppable. We celebrate diversity and various perspectives and aim to create an inclusive and supportive environment for all. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer of choice. All aspects of employment decisions will be based on merit, performance, and business needs. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

jobs.description:
工作内容：
1. 核心系统开发 - 负责Web3产品（如聚合器、数据服务、钱包管理等）的后端架构设计与开发，提升系统高并发、低延迟及稳定性。 - 负责链上数据抓取、解析与结构化存储（支持主流链），构建实时数据监控与报警机制。 - 设计并实现高性能 API（RESTful/gRPC/WebSocket），优化链上链下交互流程（如交易签名、状态追踪）。 2. 智能合约与区块集成 - 开发链下服务与智能合约的交互模块（如调用合约），处理多链事件聚合与交易路由。 - 实现多链数据解析、事件监听及结构化存储，支持链下业务逻辑。 3. 基础设施与性能优化 - 设计微服务架构，利用 Docker/Kubernetes 实现容器化部署，提升系统可扩展性。 - 设计并实现微服务架构，优化数据库（SQL/NoSQL）、缓存（Redis）、消息队列（Kafka）等技术方案，保障系统高可用性。
任职要求：
1. 技术基础
  • 5年以上后端开发经验，3年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine/Channel）、标准库及框架（Gin/Go-zero/Gorm）。
  • 熟练掌握微服务架构，有分布式系统设计经验（消息队列/Kafka、分布式锁、熔断限流）。
2. 区块专项
  • 至少2年 Web3 开发经验，深入理解区块原理及主流链的交互机制。
  • 熟悉区块链交易流程和合约交互机制，具备链上数据解析、交易构造等实战经验。
3. 工具链
  • 精通 SQL/NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理。
  • 熟练使用 Docker/Kubernetes 部署生产环境，掌握 CI/CD 自动化流程。

jobs.description:
【岗位职责】

一、钱包账户体系

1.负责钱包账户系统的架构设计与演进，统一管理助记词、私钥、硬件、MPC、托管（Turnkey 等）、机器人钱包、保险箱等多类账户形态。

2.主导异构账户体系的融合与抽象，沉淀统一的账户模型与 Web3 ID 能力，支撑钱包及其他业务方的接入需求。

3.设计对外可接入的钱包能力，对其他业务线开放标准化的账户、签名、交易接口，避免业务方重复自建。

二、钱包核心服务

1.负责钱包核心后端服务的设计与开发，覆盖资产管理、代币列表、交易历史、上链广播、Gas 策略等关键链路。

2.负责大规模钱包数据（账户、资产、交易历史等亿级数据量）的存储设计、查询性能与版本兼容性。

3.负责钱包与中台基础能力（行情、Token、节点 RPC、资产）的集成与解耦，推动公共能力下沉、钱包业务上浮。

三、多链支持与上链

1.负责钱包多链支持的接入与维护，覆盖 EVM、Solana 及其他主流公链。

2.负责交易构造、签名、广播、状态追踪的完整链路，保障在网络拥堵、Nonce 冲突等场景下的稳定性。

【任职要求】

一、技术基础

1.5 年以上后端开发经验，3 年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine / Channel）、标准库及主流框架（Gin / Go-zero / Gorm）。

2.熟练掌握微服务架构与分布式系统设计（消息队列、分布式锁、熔断限流、幂等设计等）。

3.精通 SQL / NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理；具备亿级数据量场景下的存储设计与查询优化经验。

4.主导过中大型后端系统从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地，具备账户、订单、资产等核心域的建模经验。

5.至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理，熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。

6.熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Move / Sui 者优先。

7.熟悉交易构造、签名、广播、Nonce 管理、Gas 策略等链上交易全链路，具备主网钱包或交易系统的实战经验。

8.具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。

二、钱包专项

1.熟悉主流钱包账户体系，包括助记词 / 私钥 / 硬件钱包 / MPC / 托管钱包等的原理与差异，理解各类账户的安全模型与使用场景。

2.具备钱包后端的实际开发经验，主导或深度参与过账户系统、资产模块、交易历史等核心模块的设计与落地。

3.具备多账户体系融合、抽象与对外开放能力建设的经验，或对此方向有清晰的方法论。

三、AI 工程能力

1.日常使用 AI Coding Agent 开发，并有相应工程沉淀。

2.具备搭建 Agent Harness、编写 Skills / Prompts 的实践经验。

3.了解 MCP、Tool Use、RAG、Eval 等概念及其工程落地边界。

【加分项】

1.有 MPC / TSS 钱包后端的开发经验，或熟悉 Turnkey、Fireblocks、Privy 等托管钱包方案。

2.有 AA 智能合约钱包（EIP-4337 / EIP-7702、Safe、Biconomy 等）相关的开发经验。

3.有亿级数据量下的数据迁移、版本兼容、双写切换等实战经验。

4.有钱包安全相关经验（密钥管理、签名风控、欺诈检测等）。

5.有围绕 AI Coding 的内部工具、Skill 库、Agent 工作流等沉淀经验。

6.有开源社区贡献或技术博客输出。

  • Integrity – We are relatable and trustworthy; steadfast in our commitment to our colleagues, clients, and partners
  • Accountability – We show up and deliver measurable, meaningful business value. Consistently.
  • Passion – We have a shared enthusiasm for transforming our clients’ supply chain

What’s In It For You?

  • Customer-centric work
  • Cutting-edge supply chain technology and innovation
  • Flexible work locations
  • Competitive compensation packages
  • Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents and careers
  • Personal and pet insurance options
  • Flexible time off and paid holidays
  • 401k and bonus program
  • Wellness and mental health initiatives
  • Generous employee referral bonus program
  • Fun work environment

Responsibilities & Objectives


Elemica is seeking a Vice President of Marketing to lead our global marketing strategy and execution, strengthen our market positioning, and generate demand that supports sustainable revenue growth.

Reporting to the Chief Commercial Officer, you will translate Elemica’s business priorities and commercial objectives into a clear and focused marketing strategy that connects our solutions to customer needs. You will lead brand, product, AI, digital, and customer marketing, and demand generation and corporate communications.


This role requires a leader who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will build and continue to develop the marketing team, prioritize investment, and partner closely with Sales, Product, Client Service, Revenue Operations, and Human Resources to improve how Elemica attracts, wins, grows, and retains close customer relationships.


What You’ll Do


Demand Generation & Pipeline Growth

  • Own the marketing plan for generating qualified demand and contributing to sales pipeline
  • Develop integrated campaigns across digital channels, content, events, webinars, partners, and targeted account programs
  • Partner with Sales on account-based marketing for priority enterprise accounts and buying groups
  • Work with Revenue Operations to establish clear lead qualification, routing, follow-up, and measurement standards
  • Use funnel performance and sales feedback to improve lead quality, conversion, and marketing effectiveness
  • Balance near-term pipeline needs with longer-term market awareness and demand creation

Marketing Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and execute a global marketing strategy aligned with Elemica’s growth priorities, target markets, and commercial plans
  • Translate business objectives into clear marketing goals, investment priorities, and measurable outcomes
  • Define target audiences and ideal customer profiles with Sales, Product, and Revenue Operations
  • Balance brand development, demand generation, and customer engagement across regions and industries
  • Provide executive leadership with clear recommendations on market opportunities, investment trade-offs, and performance

Positioning & Product Marketing

  • Articulate Elemica’s value proposition and differentiate its solutions in the enterprise supply chain technology market
  • Translate complex capabilities into clear messaging focused on customer challenges and business outcomes
  • Lead customer and market research, competitive intelligence, segmentation, and buyer insights
  • Partner with Product and commercial leadership on launches, market readiness, and adoption
  • Equip the sales team with compelling use cases, competitive positioning, customer evidence, and messaging
  • Work with Sales Enablement on delivery and adoption

Brand, Content, & Communications

  • Strengthen Elemica’s brand and ensure consistent messaging across customer touchpoints
  • Lead the content strategy, including thought leadership, customer stories, industry perspectives, and executive communications
  • Oversee the website and digital experience to improve engagement and conversion
  • Manage external communications, public relations, and relevant industry and analyst relationships
  • Establish clear quality standards for marketing materials and external communications

Customer & Partner Marketing

  • Partner with Customer Success and Sales on customer engagement, advocacy, references, and expansion campaigns
  • Develop customer case studies and evidence that demonstrate measurable business value
  • Build marketing programs that help customers understand and adopt additional Elemica capabilities
  • Work with partner leaders on joint campaigns, events, and other opportunities to reach relevant audiences

Performance, Budget, & Operational Alignment

  • Own the marketing budget and allocate resources based on strategic priorities and evidence of effectiveness
  • Establish performance measures with Finance and Revenue Operations, including qualified pipeline contribution, funnel conversion, and campaign efficiency
  • Review results regularly, explain performance gaps, and adjust investment and execution
  • Partner with Revenue Operations on reporting, attribution, data quality, and marketing processes
  • Work with GTM Technology on the capabilities needed to support marketing execution and measurement
  • Manage agencies and vendors against clear deliverables, quality expectations, and budgets

Team Development & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop an existing and growing global marketing team with clear responsibilities and performance expectations
  • Assess team capabilities and determine the appropriate balance of internal expertise and external support
  • Establish a practical planning and review cadence that supports prioritization and accountability
  • Build strong working relationships across Sales, Product, Client Service, Revenue Operations, and Finance
  • Create a culture of customer understanding, experimentation, collaboration, and consistent follow-through

What You’ll Need

  • Typically 12 or more years of progressive B2B marketing experience, including significant leadership responsibility within enterprise software or SaaS
  • Experience in supply chain technology, enterprise integration, manufacturing, or logistics is very highly preferred
  • A track record of building and executing marketing strategies that contribute to qualified pipeline and revenue growth
  • Experience leading multiple marketing disciplines, including demand generation, product marketing, brand, and digital marketing
  • Strong understanding of complex enterprise buying processes, long sales cycles, and buying groups involving business and technology stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to position technical solutions in terms of customer value and business outcomes
  • Experience leading teams, managing budgets, and prioritizing investment across competing needs
  • Strong analytical judgment and the ability to evaluate marketing performance without overstating attribution
  • Experience partnering effectively with senior Sales, Product, Finance, and Client Service leaders
  • Familiarity with CRM, marketing automation, and analytics platforms, including Salesforce
  • Clear communication skills, executive presence, and a hands-on approach to delivering results
  • Experience working across international markets and distributed teams

What Success Looks Like


Objective: First 90 Days

  • Assess the marketing strategy, team capabilities, budget, campaigns, positioning, and pipeline contribution
  • Meet key internal stakeholders and customers to understand business priorities and buying needs
  • Ensure continuity of critical campaigns, commitments, and agency relationships
  • Align with commercial leadership on target audiences, priorities, and measures of success
  • Present a focused marketing plan with clear investment choices, owners, and timelines
  • Clarify responsibilities and handoffs across Marketing, Revenue Operations, GTM Technology, and Sales Enablement

First Year Expected Deliverables

  • Enhanced clarity and consistent global branding and positioning across Elemica’s solutions and target markets
  • Measurable progress against agreed marketing pipeline and conversion targets
  • Improved and effective collaboration between Marketing and Sales with the objective of serving and retaining strategic accounts
  • Stronger customer evidence, advocacy, and market visibility
  • Greater transparency into marketing performance and investment decisions
  • Retain a capable, accountable marketing team and guide with a clear operating plan

Who We Are

Elemica is a leading provider of Digital Supply Chain Management solutions and the premier multi-enterprise collaboration network for global process manufacturing industries. Its portfolio of SaaS-based, network-powered digitization and visibility solutions automate critical information flows, enable multi-channel data strategies, and improve end-to-end supply chain performance. Elemica solutions connect many of the world’s largest manufacturers to their direct material suppliers, logistics service providers and end customers, helping them realize the promise of, and return on, their investments in supply chain digitization. Today, global leaders—including Arkema, BASF, Continental, Dow, Goodyear, Michelin, and Shell—use Elemica, driving over $1 trillion in commerce annually.


It is the responsibility of all Elemica employees to ensure the security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy of Elemica systems and data and the data of our customers. Using best practices in these areas, all Elemica employees will observe a ‘security first’ approach to their daily responsibilities. All employees are accountable for securing their work devices, work areas, and communications in the execution of their daily duties.


Our use of artificial intelligence in hiring

We use AI-assisted tools to support parts of our recruitment process. These tools help us manage application volume, but no hiring decision is made by AI alone. Your rights: You have the right to request human review of any AI-assisted assessment of your application. You may also request information about how AI was used in evaluating your candidacy and contest any decision that was influenced by automated processing. 我们是全球最早也是最成熟的数字资产平台之一，服务于全球数千万用户。我们始终位列全球Top交易所之列，提供涵盖数千种数字资产的全面交易和财富管理产品。我们拥有遍布全球主要金融中心的数千名员工，秉持远程优先、高度自主的企业文化，吸引着那些在快节奏、高挑战性环境中蓬勃发展的优秀人才。

2、高并发与性能调优：深入代码逻辑、内存管理、并发模型（线程/协程）、网络 IO 及操作系统行为，攻克高吞吐与极低延迟场景下的性能瓶颈。

1、熟悉无锁（Lock-Free）结构、NUMA 架构、用户态网络栈（DPDK/Kernel Bypass）或硬件加速。

jobs.title: 交易风控策略专家
jobs.excerpt: 岗位描述1、负责核心交易产品的风控模型与策略体系建设，覆盖事前预警、事中拦截、事后分析全链路 2、针对交易场景设计并迭代风控策略，利用高频数据识别并实时对抗价格操纵、洗单、虚假挂单、跨市场套利滥用等异常交易行为 3、基于订单簿数据、成交流水、用户持仓、资金划转等多维交易数据，进行特征工程与变量挖掘，构建交易行为风险画像 4、参与保证金风控模型建设，包括强平模型优化、爆仓预警阈值优化、穿仓风险控制等保证金风控核心模块 5、运用图计算与社区发现算法，识别协同操盘团伙、关联账户刷量等群体，结合链上资金追踪形成完整风险闭环 6、建立交易风控指标监控体系，持续跟踪市场异常信号，输出可解释的风险评估结论，支撑业务与合规决策 7、探索 AI/LLM 技术在交易风控场景的落地应用，如异常订单行为智能检测、策略规则自动推荐、风险事件归因分析 任职要求1、全日制本科及以上学历，计算机科学、统计学、数学、金融工程或相关专业；3 年以上风控模型/策略开发经验，有交易所或券商交易风控背景者优先 2、熟练掌握至少一种编程语言Python、Java、Go，具备扎实的数据处理与建模能力，能独立完成从数据清洗、特征工程到模型上线的全流程工作 3、熟悉主流机器学习模型（XGBoost、LightGBM、逻辑回归、时序异常检测等）及其在高频交易数据场景下的工程化落地 4、熟悉图数据库（Neo4j、NebulaGraph 等）及社区发现算法（Louvain、LPA 等），有关联账户识别或团伙挖掘实战经验 5、熟悉实时流处理技术（Flink、Kafka 等），具备生产级别的毫秒级风控策略落地能力，覆盖从数据预处理、特征工程、模型训练到策略应用的全流程，能够保障在极端行情或高频交易场景下实现实时风险阻断 加分项 1、熟悉TradFi 品种金融规则：熟悉股票、ETF、外汇市场的交易规则，能有效将传统合规风控模型迁移至 TradFi 风控场景。 2、AI/LLM 应用经验：有将 LLM 实际用于风控场景的真实案例（用户异常行为识别、策略自动生成、风险报告自动化）。
jobs.description:
岗位描述

1、负责核心交易产品的风控模型与策略体系建设，覆盖事前预警、事中拦截、事后分析全链路
2、针对交易场景设计并迭代风控策略，利用高频数据识别并实时对抗价格操纵、洗单、虚假挂单、跨市场套利滥用等异常交易行为
3、基于订单簿数据、成交流水、用户持仓、资金划转等多维交易数据，进行特征工程与变量挖掘，构建交易行为风险画像
4、参与保证金风控模型建设，包括强平模型优化、爆仓预警阈值优化、穿仓风险控制等保证金风控核心模块
5、运用图计算与社区发现算法，识别协同操盘团伙、关联账户刷量等群体，结合链上资金追踪形成完整风险闭环
6、建立交易风控指标监控体系，持续跟踪市场异常信号，输出可解释的风险评估结论，支撑业务与合规决策
7、探索 AI/LLM 技术在交易风控场景的落地应用，如异常订单行为智能检测、策略规则自动推荐、风险事件归因分析

任职要求

1、全日制本科及以上学历，计算机科学、统计学、数学、金融工程或相关专业；3 年以上风控模型/策略开发经验，有交易所或券商交易风控背景者优先
2、熟练掌握至少一种编程语言Python、Java、Go，具备扎实的数据处理与建模能力，能独立完成从数据清洗、特征工程到模型上线的全流程工作
3、熟悉主流机器学习模型（XGBoost、LightGBM、逻辑回归、时序异常检测等）及其在高频交易数据场景下的工程化落地
4、熟悉图数据库（Neo4j、NebulaGraph 等）及社区发现算法（Louvain、LPA 等），有关联账户识别或团伙挖掘实战经验
5、熟悉实时流处理技术（Flink、Kafka 等），具备生产级别的毫秒级风控策略落地能力，覆盖从数据预处理、特征工程、模型训练到策略应用的全流程，能够保障在极端行情或高频交易场景下实现实时风险阻断

加分项

1、熟悉TradFi 品种金融规则：熟悉股票、ETF、外汇市场的交易规则，能有效将传统合规风控模型迁移至 TradFi 风控场景。
2、AI/LLM 应用经验：有将 LLM 实际用于风控场景的真实案例（用户异常行为识别、策略自动生成、风险报告自动化）。

  • Strong phone presence and written communication skills
  • Excellent organizational and time management abilities
  • Comfortable using CRM systems and sales tools

  • Conversion rates

jobs.description:
Meet Yubico

Yubico is a global leader in identity security and creator of the YubiKey, the original hardware-backed passkey. We are publicly traded on Nasdaq Stockholm; our global footprint includes headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, Silicon Valley, California; and Singapore.

Why Join Our Mission?

At Yubico, we are guided by a shared belief that your work matters. We operate under a cultural philosophy of Speed with Integrity, pushing the boundaries of technology to secure the AI frontier—protecting both human and agentic AI interactions—and leading the transition to post-quantum cryptography. In everything we do, we live by our core values:

  • Battle Friction: We constantly look for new ways to simplify our products, our work, and the user experience.
  • Inspire Higher: We think big, champion the open internet, and strive to do the right thing even when it is difficult.
  • One Team: We are open, responsive, and collaborative, overcoming challenges and celebrating our successes together.

Aligned with our commitment to open standards, we foster a thriving builder ecosystem through theYubico Developer Program, offering free open-source repositories, libraries, and SDKs to help developers rapidly integrate strong hardware authentication into any application. Through close collaborations with technical partners like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon, as well as newer frontiers like OpenAI, we continue to shape a safer digital world while donating security keys to protect vulnerable communities, journalists, and humanitarian groups worldwide through our Secure it Forward program.

At Yubico, we offer:

Freedom and Flexibility: At Yubico, we want you to be your most productive selves whether you decide to work 100% from home or choose to work hybrid/onsite. The way we balance the fast-paced demands of a high-growth company and sustainability is making rest a priority.

Yubico Values: We work to ensure that our employees have an open space to have their voices amplified to create a workplace where everyone feels like they belong. In support of this, our employees have created some pretty cool Employee Resource Groups that foster inclusion, help build community and connection across Yubico which all employees are welcome to join. Additionally, Yubico donates YubiKeys to organizations in need all over the world (you can read more about our work here).

Social Connection: Relationships and connectedness matter, and we love spending time with our team! Our virtual workspace keeps us connected day-to-day whether it's through Yubico celebrating wins or our buzzing Slack communities. Check out our Life at Yubico Page on LinkedIn and our awards here.

The Role:

Yubico is seeking a Channel Manager to manage and expand relationships with key cybersecurity resellers and strategic partners, including GuidePoint, SHI, Zones, and Insight. This individual will be responsible for driving revenue growth through partner enablement, joint business planning, and strategic execution. The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of the cybersecurity VAR ecosystem, thrives in a collaborative environment, and can translate strategy into measurable results.

Tasks & Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Relationship Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned partners, building trusted relationships and ensuring alignment on joint business objectives.
  • Joint Business Planning: Develop and execute annual business plans with assigned partners to drive growth, enablement, and solution adoption.
  • Sales Enablement: Deliver targeted training and enablement programs to partner sales teams, equipping them with the knowledge and tools to effectively position Yubico’s security solutions.
  • Deal Acceleration: Collaborate with partner sellers to identify, qualify, and close opportunities, supporting forecast accuracy and accelerating sales cycles.
  • Performance Management: Track partner performance against revenue and engagement KPIs, identifying gaps and implementing improvement plans.
  • Market & Competitive Insight: Monitor market trends and competitor activity to inform go-to-market strategies and strengthen Yubico’s channel value proposition.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field (MBA a plus)
  • 5+ years of experience in channel management, partner development, or sales within cybersecurity or enterprise technology
  • Demonstrated success driving revenue growth through strategic initiatives and partner collaboration
  • Strong understanding of VAR, MSP, and distributor business models
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills with experience engaging senior-level stakeholders
  • Data-driven, with the ability to analyze performance metrics and translate them into actionable insights
  • Self-starter with strong organizational skills and a results-oriented mindset
  • Travel up to 40-50% required

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Direct experience managing GuidePoint, SHI, Zones, or Insight (or similar large cybersecurity resellers)
  • Familiarity with identity and access management (IAM), multi-factor authentication (MFA), or broader cybersecurity markets

Our U. S. benefits are designed for your overall well-being:

Health coverage. We’ve got you covered with top of the line health plans, including dental and vision. We pay 100% of your premium and 85% for your family.

Retirement plan. Our retirement plan includes a 401K dollar per dollar match up to 6% with a cap of $6K/year. Immediate vesting.

Wellness reimbursement. We offer $1,200.00 in wellness earnings (prorated based on start date) that you can use on your gym membership, a massage, or your favorite online fitness classes. This is a taxable benefit if you choose to participate.

Learning and development. We encourage your professional growth and offer a yearly development stipend of $3,000 and mentorship program.

Time off. We offer a total of 15 vacation days plus 10 holidays, and 7 sick days a year.

Paid parental leave. We love welcoming new family members to our YubiTeam! All parents receive 8 weeks of paid leave. Birthing parents receive an additional 8 weeks of paid leave (16 weeks total).

Commuter Benefits. If you need to commute to the office, we offer commuter benefits.

Strong mission & company values. We’re a global team on a global mission to make the internet more secure for everyone. We believe that every person’s work matters. That you should always be nice, stay humble, and have fun, and never take yourself too seriously.

At UpLift, we believe mental health is just as important as physical health — and we're rethinking the mental healthcare model. UpLift is a multi-sided marketplace, applying technology to empower patients to find Therapists and Psychiatric providers covered by their insurance plan.

While 1 in 5 Americans struggle with mental health issues, only 40% of this group received care in the last year. At the same time, only 30% of therapists accept insurance. UpLift acts as the bridge between patient, provider, and insurer — empowering patients to find the best care for their needs at a price they can afford.

Why Join UpLift

  • Estimated Effective Hourly Earnings*: Earnings between $73 to $160 per hour is based on a 60-minute session assumption that includes a combination of patient visits and hourly equivalent CPT codes. Compensation for CPT codes can vary based on clinician’s license and state of licensure. Compensation for CPT codes can vary based on clinician’s license and state of licensure.

  • Collaborative model: Work hand-in-hand with UpLift’s network of licensed therapists to deliver world-class, evidence-based care.
  • All-in-one virtual platform: Focus on your patients — UpLift handles credentialing, enrollment, and platform operations.

  • Flexible commitment: Part-time, 1099 contract position

What You’ll Do

  • Conduct video consultations and message with patients via telemedicine.
  • Assess, screen, diagnose, and prescribe medication as clinically appropriate.
  • Coordinate treatment planning and care delivery with UpLift’s network of therapists.
  • Provide empathetic, high-quality care and uphold UpLift’s clinical and service standards.
  • Share product and workflow feedback with UpLift’s engineering and operations teams to help improve care delivery.

Who We’re Looking For

  • At least one year of experience as a certified Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP).

  • Comfortable prescribing medication when clinically appropriate and permitted by state law.

jobs.title: Senior SVM Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Veda builds vault infrastructure for DeFi at scale.
jobs.description:
Veda builds vault infrastructure for DeFi at scale. We manage $2B+ in total value locked across 15+ blockchain networks, powering yield strategies for partners including Kraken, Etherfi, and Plasma. Our protocol turns complex multi-chain DeFi positions into simple vault interfaces that institutional and retail users can actually trust.

We seek individuals with high agency to join us in defining the next phase of DeFi growth and adoption. The ideal candidate takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and adapts swiftly to evolving demands.

The Role

As an SVM Engineer, you will design, implement, and optimize smart contracts and DeFi protocols on the Solana Virtual Machine. With a special focus on vault architecture and security, you'll be responsible for creating robust financial applications that maintain the highest standards of security while delivering exceptional performance.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop smart contracts and DeFi protocols on the Solana Virtual Machine

  • Build and optimize secure vault systems for asset management and yield strategies

  • Collaborate with security teams to ensure protocols are protected against exploits

  • Integrate with existing DeFi protocols and establish cross-protocol compatibility

  • Optimize code for Solana's parallel execution environment

  • Conduct thorough testing and debugging of smart contracts

  • Research and implement innovative solutions to improve scalability and reduce transaction costs

  • Stay current with the latest developments in the Solana ecosystem and DeFi space

  • Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing

You have

  • Experience building, deploying, and maintaining SVM smart contracts in production

  • Strong programming experience in Rust

  • Deep understanding of Solana and low-level SVM concepts

  • Thorough understanding of the Solana Virtual Machine architecture and its constraints

  • Experience building DeFi protocols (lending, trading, yield farming, etc.)

  • Knowledge of cryptographic principles and blockchain security best practices

  • Familiarity with Solana Program Library (SPL) and ecosystem tools

  • Understanding of vault architectures in DeFi contexts

  • Experience with on-chain security patterns and common vulnerabilities

  • Solid grasp of financial concepts as they apply to decentralized finance

  • Problem-solving attitude and ability to work in a fast-paced environment

Even better if you have

  • Track record of creating audited and battle-tested smart contracts

  • Strong systems engineering fundamentals. You’ve built event-driven architectures, data pipelines, caching layers, and API services that handle high throughput.

  • You’ve seen production at scale. You’ve lived through systems that scaled past their original design. You know what breaks first, what compromises are temporary, and what shortcuts become permanent regret.

  • Previous experience building vault protocols on Solana or other blockchains

  • Contributions to open-source Solana projects

  • Experience with Anchor framework for Solana development

  • Knowledge of other blockchain platforms (Ethereum, Near, etc.) for cross-chain compatibility

  • Familiarity with front-end frameworks for dApp development (React, etc.)

We’re a 35-person team that’s raised $18M at Series A. The infrastructure works — it’s running in production handling billions in TVL — but it was built for the company we were, not the company we’re becoming. We’re transitioning from founder-dependent operations to scalable engineering practices. You’ll be a key part of making that real.

Compensation

Competitive base salary plus equity. We’re a Series A company heading toward Series B — early enough that your equity is meaningful, late enough that the business is real.

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

If you are in the United States, you may also receive access to comprehensive medical, dental, and life insurance in the US

Opportunity Overview:

We are seeking a Senior Forward-Deployed Engineer to join our Forward Deployed Engineering team at Cohere Health. In this highly technical, customer-facing role, you will own end-to-end technical integration work with enterprise customers and partners—from pre-sales through production deployment—bridging complex healthcare systems with Cohere’s AI-first platform. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Product, Solutions Architecture, and Customer Success teams to design and execute sophisticated integrations that improve access to care for millions of members.

What you’ll do:

  • Own end-to-end technical integration design and execution for enterprise customers, from initial scoping through production deployment, serving as the primary technical authority throughout
  • Lead technical discovery, scoping, and proof-of-concept work during pre-sales cycles, creating technical proposals and estimates to validate feasibility for prospective customers
  • Design system architectures that bridge customer IT environments with Cohere’s platform, making key architectural decisions that balance customer constraints with platform capabilities
  • Work hands-on with AI/ML-enabled healthcare features—including clinical decision support, automated review, and intelligent routing—ensuring they meet regulatory requirements and clinical safety standards
  • Produce high-quality technical artifacts including integration designs, architecture diagrams, data mappings, API implementation guides, and operational runbooks
  • Build reusable integration patterns and templates that scale across customers, and continuously identify opportunities to improve platform capabilities based on implementation learnings
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Solutions Architecture, and Customer Success teams to drive successful go-live outcomes and mentor junior team members

What you’ll need:

  • 6–10+ years of software engineering experience with a strong backend/systems focus
  • Healthcare industry experience, particularly on the payer side (health plans, managed care organizations), including familiarity with healthcare workflows, data standards, and regulatory requirements
  • Deep expertise in data architecture and integration patterns: data modeling, transformation logic, schema design, and enterprise integration patterns (middleware, message queues, event-driven architectures)
  • Hands-on experience with AWS cloud platforms (Lambda, ECS, RDS, S3, API Gateway, EventBridge)
  • Strong API integration and authentication experience: RESTful APIs, webhooks, OAuth2/OIDC, SAML 2.0, JWT, mTLS, and API key management
  • Production coding skills in modern languages (Python, Node.js, Java, Go, or similar)
  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers in technical implementation roles (not just internal teams)
  • Comfort with ambiguity and high agency: ability to define problems, propose solutions, and execute independently
  • Direct experience with payer-side technology: prior authorization platforms, utilization management systems, or claims processing is a plus
  • Familiarity with healthcare data standards: FHIR, X12 (837, 278, 275), HL7v2, or similar specifications is a plus
  • AI/ML integration experience: working with LLMs, embedding AI capabilities into production systems, or ML model deployment is a plus
  • Infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar tools is a plus
  • Experience in regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC2, HITRUST) is a plus
  • Database expertise: SQL and NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB), query optimization, and data modeling is a plus
  • Identity and access management (IAM) experience: SSO implementations, federated identity, RBAC, and multi-tenancy security patterns is a plus

Pay & Perks:

💻 Fully remote opportunity with about 5% travel

🩺 Medical, dental, vision, life, disability insurance, and Employee Assistance Program

📈 401K retirement plan with company match; flexible spending and health savings account

🏝️ Flex Time Off + company holidays

👶 Up to 14 weeks of paid parental leave

🐶 Pet insurance 

The salary range for this position is $135,000 to $155,000 annually; as part of a total benefits package which includes health insurance, 401k and bonus. In accordance with state applicable laws, Cohere is required to provide a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. Individual pay decisions are ultimately based on a number of factors, including but not limited to qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and internal alignment.

Interview Process*:

  1. Connect with Talent Acquisition for a Preliminary Phone Screening
  2. Meet your Hiring Manager!

About Cohere Health:

Cohere Health’s clinical intelligence platform delivers AI-powered solutions that streamline access to quality care by improving payer-provider collaboration, cost containment, and healthcare economics. Cohere Health works with over 660,000 providers and handles over 12 million prior authorization requests annually. Its responsible AI auto-approves up to 90% of requests for millions of health plan members.

With the acquisition of ZignaAI, we’ve further enhanced our platform by launching our Payment Integrity Suite, anchored by Cohere Validate™, an AI-driven clinical and coding validation solution that operates in near real-time. By unifying pre-service authorization data with post-service claims validation, we’re creating a transparent healthcare ecosystem that reduces waste, improves payer-provider collaboration and patient outcomes, and ensures providers are paid promptly and accurately.

Cohere Health’s innovations continue to receive industry wide recognition. We’ve been named to the 2025 Inc. 5000 list and in the Gartner® Hype Cycle™ for U.S. Healthcare Payers (2022-2025), and ranked as a Top 5 LinkedIn™ Startup for 2023 & 2024. Backed by leading investors such as Deerfield Management, Define Ventures, Flare Capital Partners, Longitude Capital, and Polaris Partners, Cohere Health drives more transparent, streamlined healthcare processes, helping patients receive faster, more appropriate care and higher-quality outcomes.

The Coherenauts, as we call ourselves, who succeed here are empathetic teammates who are candid, kind, caring, and embody our core values and principles. We believe that diverse, inclusive teams make the most impactful work. Cohere is deeply invested in ensuring that we have a supportive, growth-oriented environment that works for everyone.

We can’t wait to learn more about you and meet you at Cohere Health!

jobs.title: Security Engineering Lead
jobs.excerpt: Espresso Systems builds foundational infrastructure to power tomorrow’s internet, where digital assets are able to move across chains as easily as info flows across the web.
jobs.description:
Espresso Systems builds foundational infrastructure to power tomorrow’s internet, where digital assets are able to move across chains as easily as info flows across the web. It’s the lead developer of the Espresso Network, the first base layer built from the ground up to provide rollups with the functionality they’ve always needed but never had: fast, secure finality for users’ transactions and seamless composability with other rollups.
Rollups today rely on infrastructure that wasn’t built with them in mind, resulting in their isolation and the fragmentation of users, developers and liquidity within the Ethereum ecosystem. This prevents rollups from achieving the seamless composability that’s essential to web3's vision. Espresso solves this by providing rollups with secure, real-time visibility into what’s happening on all integrated chains, including their own, empowering the apps to execute crosschain interactions immediately without waiting for slow settlement or trusting centralized sequencers.
The Espresso Network is currently live on mainnet in its initial release. In addition to fast confirmations and data availability, rollups seeking further decentralization can also opt to use the Espresso Network as a decentralized sequencer. As the first purpose-built base layer for rollups, Espresso supports a fast-growing ecosystem of interconnected chains regardless of tech stack, VM, or settlement layer—from established chains like Celo and ApeChain to emerging app-specific chains attracting their first users.
At Espresso Systems, we work with leading teams developing rollups and innovating around interoperability, including Offchain Labs, Polygon, Caldera, AltLayer, Cartesi, Across, Hyperlane, and beyond—all united in our mission to build a unified, composable ecosystem where rollups are free to achieve their full potential regardless of where they choose to settle.
The Espresso team comprises a diverse and passionate group of contributors from around the world. We are developers, designers, and researchers who have contributed in academia, open-source communities, policymaking, and beyond. We have raised roughly $60 million from leading investors in technology and crypto, including a16z, Greylock Partners, Electric Capital, Sequoia Capital, and Polychain Capital.
As a Security Engineering Lead on our team, you'll be leading the security and auditing efforts for Espresso's codebase leading up to, and beyond, launch. We are looking for an experienced security engineering and software auditing professional who can lead review processes of our design and codebase. Experience in the domains of EVM smart contracts and/or Rust distributed systems is preferred for this role.

Responsibilities

  • Lead security audits of (a subset of) the Espresso codebase
  • As a project leader, you will have mobility in how you choose to organize security and audit efforts
  • Dive into the code of a fairly complex distributed system, learning and developing an understanding of the system on the fly (with help from the engineering team that built it, of course)
  • Coordinate with several engineering teams to aid in your audit, raise concerns and communicate results, and guide the effort to harden the system based on your findings
  • Coordinate with, manage, and review the work of external security auditing teams, in certain cases
  • Suggest improvements to testing and engineering practices to promote more secure and maintainable code

Requirements

  • Solid grasp of software engineering principles, both low-level (e.g. language-specific best practices) and high-level (e.g. reliable software architecture, particularly in distributed systems)
  • If focused on Rust: ≥ 1 year experience writing Rust, particularly with async Rust.
  • If focused on Solidity: Multiple years experience writing smart contracts; experience with smart contract security audits or formal verification of smart contracts
  • Experience as an engineer or software architect in a security-critical industry
  • Be capable of describing the stakes, the challenges you've faced in building secure software, and the steps/processes you've taken to mitigate risk
  • Experience as an auditor, pentester, QA tester, etc.
  • Have a well thought-out approach to testing software and designing it to be testable/auditable
  • Ability to think adversarially, and identify potential reliability or security vulnerabilities even in software that is correct in common or “happy path” scenarios
  • Experience on the design and/or testing of distributed systems
  • Comfort diving into unknowns and asking questions

Preferred

  • Knowledge of relevant testing and static analysis tools (e.g. Foundry, Slither) is a plus
  • Blockchain knowledge/experience is preferred, but could also be include IoT, automotive, finance, etc.
  • Ideally, the candidate should have a general philosophy of software design that has been molded by experience working on security-critical systems

Benefits

  • Fully remote with flexible hours
  • Work alongside the brightest minds in the crypto space
  • Competitive salary + equity package
  • Regular team off-sites to international locations
  • Unlimited vacation policy
  • Top-tier health, dental, and vision coverage for US employees

As a Coding Validation Specialist on the Complex Payment Solutions Team, you will play a critical role in performing comprehensive outpatient payment validation reviews. In this role, you will review medical records to validate the accuracy of coding, billing, and supporting documentation for outpatient services, including APCs, EAPGs, CPT, and HCPCS Level II codes.
