jobs.description:
Espresso Systems builds foundational infrastructure to power tomorrow’s internet, where digital assets are able to move across chains as easily as info flows across the web. It’s the lead developer of the Espresso Network, the first base layer built from the ground up to provide rollups with the functionality they’ve always needed but never had: fast, secure finality for users’ transactions and seamless composability with other rollups.
Rollups today rely on infrastructure that wasn’t built with them in mind, resulting in their isolation and the fragmentation of users, developers and liquidity within the Ethereum ecosystem. This prevents rollups from achieving the seamless composability that’s essential to web3's vision. Espresso solves this by providing rollups with secure, real-time visibility into what’s happening on all integrated chains, including their own, empowering the apps to execute crosschain interactions immediately without waiting for slow settlement or trusting centralized sequencers.
The Espresso Network is currently live on mainnet in its initial release. In addition to fast confirmations and data availability, rollups seeking further decentralization can also opt to use the Espresso Network as a decentralized sequencer. As the first purpose-built base layer for rollups, Espresso supports a fast-growing ecosystem of interconnected chains regardless of tech stack, VM, or settlement layer—from established chains like Celo and ApeChain to emerging app-specific chains attracting their first users.
At Espresso Systems, we work with leading teams developing rollups and innovating around interoperability, including Offchain Labs, Polygon, Caldera, AltLayer, Cartesi, Across, Hyperlane, and beyond—all united in our mission to build a unified, composable ecosystem where rollups are free to achieve their full potential regardless of where they choose to settle.
The Espresso team comprises a diverse and passionate group of contributors from around the world. We are developers, designers, and researchers who have contributed in academia, open-source communities, policymaking, and beyond. We have raised roughly $60 million from leading investors in technology and crypto, including a16z, Greylock Partners, Electric Capital, Sequoia Capital, and Polychain Capital.
We’re looking for regional ambassadors to help grow and strengthen local communities while expanding Espresso's global presence. As an ambassador, you'll introduce Espresso to new audiences and energize our existing local communities.

  • Managing local channels, such as local TG and X channels

  • Ensure adherence of your community to Espresso’s norms, culture, and community guidelines

What our ideal ambassador looks like:

  • A driven, solutions-oriented individual
  • Excellent communication skills in both native language and English
  • A real hands-on mentality

May Mobility is transforming cities through autonomous technology to create a safer, greener, more accessible world. Based in Ann Arbor, Michigan, May develops and deploys autonomous vehicles (AVs) powered by our innovative Multi-Policy Decision Making (MPDM) technology that literally reimagines the way AVs think.

Our vehicles do more than just drive themselves - they provide value to communities, bridge public transit gaps and move people where they need to go safely, easily and with a lot more fun. We’re building the world’s best autonomy system to reimagine transit by minimizing congestion, expanding access and encouraging better land use in order to foster more green, vibrant and livable spaces. Since our founding in 2017, we’ve given more than 500,000 autonomous rides to real people around the globe. And we’re just getting started. We’re hiring people who share our passion for building the future, today, solving real-world problems and seeing the impact of their work. Join us.

The Autonomy Mapping & Localization group's mission is to provide our vehicles with world-class spatial intelligence, semantic and topological mapping, and state estimation to model and navigate complex urban, suburban, and rural environments. We are looking for a Lead ML Engineer to join our team and architect the next generation of our mapping and localization stack. As the Lead ML Engineer for Lane & Route Network Mapping, you will be at the forefront of this mission, building the production-grade semantic and topological foundation that allows our vehicles to understand and navigate the world's most challenging roads at scale.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Lead the research, design, architecture, training and validation of advanced neural networks for vectorized mapping (e.g., MapTR), multi-camera BEV transformers, and multimodal fusion models to extract and model lane and route networks for both high-fidelity offline pipelines and real-time online mapping.
  • Architect, design, and implement a production-grade lane and route network mapping stack, ensuring high-performance integration with upstream and downstream modules like Perception, Behavior, Policy, and Prediction.
  • Drive major feature development from inception to deployment. This includes high-level architecture design, rigorous code reviews, automated testing, mentorship of junior engineers, and technical resolution.
  • Own the end-to-end data strategy for the mapping domain, specifically focusing on lane and route networks. You will define data curation, auto-labeling, synthetic data, and active learning pipelines to capture and resolve long-tail scenarios.
  • Develop robust metrics and evaluation frameworks for lane and route network accuracy, temporal consistency, and scaling across diverse Operational Design Domains (ODDs).
  • Work independently with cross-functional teams to translate complex autonomy goals into clear software and system requirements.
  • Collaborate with ML and Autonomy engineers to ensure the seamless deployment and validation of mapping features to the vehicle fleet.
  • Stay at the research frontier by evaluating, adapting, and innovating cutting-edge techniques, including online vectorized HD map construction, end-to-end mapping models, and vision/fusion Foundation Models to deliver production-ready solutions.

Qualifications and Experience

Candidates most successful in this role typically hold the following qualifications or comparable knowledge or experience:

Required

  • Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field with a strong mathematical and engineering foundation.
  • 7+ years of industry experience developing and deploying ML/DL models for mapping or computer vision at scale.
  • Deep expertise in several of the following areas:
    • Vectorized mapping networks (e.g., MapTR), BEV-based scene representation, and temporal modeling.
    • Cross-modal calibration and fusion (e.g., Camera-to-LiDAR) within Bird’s-Eye-View (BEV) unified representation spaces.
    • Transformers or Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) applied to structured lane geometry and topological connectivity.
    • Lane-level topology and connectivity, intersection modeling, and lane/road network graph construction.
    • Computer Vision Foundations: Object detection, classification, segmentation, tracking, depth estimation, and 3D reconstruction.
  • Strong understanding of HD maps, including lane and road network geometry modeling, connectivity, and semantic attributes.
  • Expertise in ML/DL development using PyTorch or TensorFlow, including experience with distributed training, synthetic data generation, large-scale dataset handling, and data curation strategies.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++ with experience in modular software design and Linux-based development.
  • Proven leadership in guiding technical roadmaps, mentoring engineers, and driving measurable improvements in model performance and system reliability.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to lead technical discussions and align with cross-functional teams.

Desirable

  • 10+ years of experience in ML/DL for autonomous driving or ADAS systems.
  • Experience with self-supervised and/or semi-supervised learning for large-scale representation learning.
  • Experience utilizing Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and/or Foundation Models for auto-labeling and long-tail (edge-case) detection.
  • Expertise in ML optimization for real-time products with limited compute, such as quantization, pruning, or distillation of large transformer models.
  • A proven record of inventions and/or publication record at top-tier conferences (e.g., CVPR, NeurIPS, ICCV, ECCV, ICLR).

Physical Requirements

  • Standard office working conditions which includes but is not limited to:
    • Prolonged sitting

  • Travel required? - Moderate: 11%-25%

  • Health Savings and Flexible Spending Healthcare and Dependent Care Accounts available.
  • Rich retirement benefits, including an immediately vested employer safe harbor match.
  • Generous paid parental leave as well as a phased return to work.
  • Flexible vacation policy in addition to paid company holidays.
  • Total Wellness Program providing numerous resources for overall wellbeing

jobs.description:
Espresso Systems builds foundational infrastructure to power tomorrow’s internet, where digital assets are able to move across chains as easily as info flows across the web. It’s the lead developer of the Espresso Network, the first base layer built from the ground up to provide rollups with the functionality they’ve always needed but never had: fast, secure finality for users’ transactions and seamless composability with other rollups.
Rollups today rely on infrastructure that wasn’t built with them in mind, resulting in their isolation and the fragmentation of users, developers and liquidity within the Ethereum ecosystem. This prevents rollups from achieving the seamless composability that’s essential to web3's vision. Espresso solves this by providing rollups with secure, real-time visibility into what’s happening on all integrated chains, including their own, empowering the apps to execute crosschain interactions immediately without waiting for slow settlement or trusting centralized sequencers.
The Espresso Network is currently live on mainnet in its initial release. In addition to fast confirmations and data availability, rollups seeking further decentralization can also opt to use the Espresso Network as a decentralized sequencer. As the first purpose-built base layer for rollups, Espresso supports a fast-growing ecosystem of interconnected chains regardless of tech stack, VM, or settlement layer—from established chains like Celo and ApeChain to emerging app-specific chains attracting their first users.
At Espresso Systems, we work with leading teams developing rollups and innovating around interoperability, including Offchain Labs, Polygon, Caldera, AltLayer, Cartesi, Across, Hyperlane, and beyond—all united in our mission to build a unified, composable ecosystem where rollups are free to achieve their full potential regardless of where they choose to settle.
The Espresso team comprises a diverse and passionate group of contributors from around the world. We are developers, designers, and researchers who have contributed in academia, open-source communities, policymaking, and beyond. We have raised roughly $60 million from leading investors in technology and crypto, including a16z, Greylock Partners, Electric Capital, Sequoia Capital, and Polychain Capital.
As a DevOps Engineer, you will assist the development team in building infrastructure to support production of the sequencer software, as well as build tooling for the deployment of test networks.

  • Assisting with CI/CD pipelines and general code management practices

Preferred

At Colibri Group, culture is at the heart of everything we do. Our values Love, Joy, Boldness, Teamwork, and Curiosity guide how we work together, support our customers, and make a difference in the communities we serve.

Our Healthcare B2B business supports organizations and professionals across a growing portfolio of education products and solutions, including offerings under TRC. As we expand beyond pharmacy into a broader, multiprofessional healthcare audience, strong product marketing will help us bring a clearer, more connected story to market.

Come Build What’s Next

We’re looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to define how Colibri positions, launches, and grows its Healthcare B2B products and solutions. You’ll turn customer and market insight into compelling product stories, focused go-to-market plans, and practical tools that help our teams connect with the right buyers.

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Head of B2B Marketing. You’ll own positioning and messaging, competitive intelligence, launch readiness, and sales enablement across a growing portfolio. You’ll partner closely with Product, Sales, Marketing, Client Success, and other teams to move work forward and build alignment—without needing direct reporting authority.

We’re looking for a hands-on product marketer who understands complex B2B buying decisions, is comfortable asking thoughtful questions, and can bring people together to solve problems. You should enjoy shaping strategy, digging into research, pushing launches forward, and making technical or multifaceted solutions easy to understand.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the Healthcare B2B product marketing approach, including priorities, positioning, messaging, and go-to-market plans across a growing product portfolio
  • Build clear value propositions, buyer personas, segmentation, and customer journeys that reflect how healthcare organizations evaluate and purchase solutions
  • Lead customer and competitive research, develop competitive frameworks, and turn market intelligence into useful recommendations for Marketing, Sales, and Product
  • Partner with Product Managers to bring customer needs and market opportunities into product planning and roadmap discussions
  • Lead product launches from planning through market readiness, aligning narratives, messaging, customer-facing content, and cross-functional deliverables
  • Equip Sales and go-to-market teams with practical resources, competitive insights, and consistent messages that help them tell the broader portfolio story
  • Bring together Product, Engineering, Sales, Client Success, Marketing, and Content partners to resolve challenges, align priorities, and keep initiatives moving
  • Define and track meaningful measures of launch performance, customer adoption, engagement, and business impact; use insights to improve future plans

What You’ll Bring

  • 6+ years of hands-on product marketing experience in B2B or enterprise software, with the judgment to operate at a senior level
  • Current or recent ownership of core product marketing work, including go-to-market strategy, product launches, positioning, and messaging—not simply campaign support
  • A demonstrated track record of bringing complex products, platforms, or product portfolios to market and translating customer needs into compelling value propositions
  • Experience working directly with Product Managers, Sales, and Marketing teams throughout the product lifecycle, including building alignment without direct authority
  • Strong customer and competitive research skills, including the ability to develop frameworks and communicate actionable market insights
  • Clear, confident communication, strong interpersonal skills, a proactive problem-solving approach, and comfort asking questions and driving decisions
  • A data-informed mindset, with experience using performance metrics and customer feedback to evaluate impact and refine strategy

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with clinical healthcare audiences or solutions, such as pharmacy, nursing, behavioral health, healthcare organizations, or healthcare professionals
  • Experience in continuing education, workforce development, or a multi-brand or portfolio business

Tools, Platforms, and Methodologies You May Use

Experience with every tool, platform, or methodology below is not required. We care most about how you turn research and market knowledge into effective positioning, launch decisions, and measurable outcomes.

  • Go-to-market planning, product launch and readiness frameworks
  • Customer research, buyer personas, segmentation, and journey mapping
  • Competitive intelligence, battlecards, and positioning frameworks
  • Product usage, adoption, engagement, and performance reporting
  • Sales enablement, collaboration, and project management tools

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Own meaningful product marketing work with visibility across our Healthcare B2B business
  • Help shape the story behind a growing portfolio serving healthcare organizations and professionals
  • Work directly with Product, Sales, Marketing, and Client Success partners to solve challenging business problems
  • Have room to bring ideas, build stronger processes, and influence how we go to market
  • Join a growing team where future leadership paths may develop as business needs evolve
  • Join a mission-driven organization where your expertise and judgment can have a visible impact

We Encourage You to Apply

You may not check every preferred box, and that is okay! We welcome experienced product marketers from B2B software, enterprise technology, education technology, workforce development, and related complex business environments. Prior healthcare experience is a plus, not a requirement.

This role does require hands-on product marketing experience, ownership of go-to-market and positioning work, and the ability to partner effectively across Product, Sales, and Marketing. If your background has primarily focused on general brand marketing, digital campaigns, or product management without direct product marketing ownership, this may not be the right opportunity.

What You Can Expect From Our Hiring Process

We want our interview process to give you a clear picture of the role, the team, and what it’s like to work at Colibri while giving us the opportunity to understand your experience, how you approach your work, and what you’re looking for next. We do not use AI to review applications; applications are reviewed by a human member of our Talent Acquisition team. While the exact process may vary slightly by role, you can generally expect:

1. Recruiter Conversation

An introductory conversation with a member of our Talent Acquisition team to learn more about your experience, career goals, and interest in Colibri. We’ll also share more about the role, team, compensation, and what to expect throughout the process.

2. Hiring Manager Conversation

A deeper discussion with the hiring manager focused on your relevant experience, how you approach the work, and the priorities and challenges this person will own.

3. Team and/or Cross-Functional Interviews

Depending on the role, you may meet with future teammates, partners, or leaders you would work closely with. These conversations are designed to explore the skills most relevant to the position while giving you the opportunity to learn more about how the team works together.

4. Final Conversation and Decision

For some roles, there may be a final conversation with an additional leader or stakeholder. Our Talent Acquisition team will keep you informed about next steps and timing throughout the process.

Application deadline: October 22nd, 2026

Our goal is to make the experience thoughtful, respectful, and transparent. We encourage you to ask questions throughout the process—we’re evaluating the opportunity together.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Colibri Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We encourage qualified candidates from all backgrounds, experiences, and career paths to apply.

Bellese is a mission-driven Digital Services Company committed to pioneering innovative technology solutions in civic healthcare. Our dedication lies in making a meaningful impact on public health outcomes.
Driven by service design, we strive to know the “Why” to understand the healthcare journey for patients, caregivers, providers, payers, and policymakers. Our goal is to design and build solutions that reduce confusion, provide clarity, support decision making, and streamline the process so that we and our partners can focus on providing better health outcomes by improving patient care and reducing costs and burden.

Primary Responsibilities:

As a Program Manager, you will be responsible for leading efforts to lead teams focused on both company growth and client delivery. You will employ structured project management/process methodologies in order to meet goals and targets. You will effectively communicate and execute against program and company objectives. A Program Manager must exhibit strong communication skills, with the ability to lead and resolve conflict in order to meet revenue and growth goals, while ensuring quality.

Primary expectations of a Program Director include:

  • Exhibits stakeholder management skills, with the ability to develop and maintain strong relationships

  • Effective communication skills, collaborating with stakeholders for changes to program scope, timeline, or budget.

  • Utilizes influential skills to translate client vision and drive project activities to successful outcomes, with the ability to shape client success outcomes and metrics

  • Serves as a trusted partner, and advises client on strategic vision and direction

  • Recognizes issues and conflicts and problem solves solutions, strategically turning barriers into opportunities.

  • Negotiates outcomes and agreements that benefit the project and company

  • Advanced ability to partner with technical and growth leaders to identify and drive organic and new growth opportunities.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience managing technology service delivery projects

  • Working knowledge of Federal program execution

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex technology or data projects

Security Clearance Requirements

  • US Citizenship or Green Card only - we do not offer Sponsorship
  • US Residency for at least the past 3 years
  • Able to meet the requirements to hold a position of Public Trust, including successful completion of a US Government background investigation
  • Disclaimer: Medical or recreational marijuana use is considered illegal at the federal level, regardless of state laws allowing such, and may affect your ability to obtain Public Trust. See article

Work that matters, with perks that deliver. Discover how Bellese Technologies invests in you through a benefits suite that makes every day better

  • Company paid short and long term life insurance

You will like it here if

You’re an out of the box thinker, always striving to know the “why” when it comes to building solutions. You excel in a team-oriented, remote-first environment characterized by mutual respect and open communication. jobs.title: Cybersecurity Presales Intern - GPSU/Heartland (Tulsa)
jobs.excerpt: GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk.
jobs.description:
GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

Overview

As part of the GPSU program, we are seeking a Cybersecurity Presales Intern to support GuidePoint Security's Heartland region. In this role, you will get hands-on experience in three core areas: certification and technical foundations, presales and client engagement, technical delivery and writing, and vendor knowledge. Experienced practitioners will mentor you directly on real work, not simulations. You don't need prior experience in this exact role, but you do need technical aptitude, a habit of learning on your own, and real curiosity about cybersecurity.

You must be pursuing or have recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field. We will also consider Associate's degree candidates who show self-study and lab work. Non-traditional backgrounds are welcome to apply, including career changers, military veterans, and self-taught candidates, as long as they show equivalent knowledge. You will work with the Heartland presales team, shadowing senior consultants on client engagements and attending internal presales and delivery meetings to learn the business. This internship is a pathway to full-time employment. Candidates who show competence and cultural fit may receive a full-time offer, with a growth path to Pre-Sales Cybersecurity Technical Advisor and a long-term path toward CISSP-level certifications and senior advisory roles.

Responsibilities

  • Certification & Technical Foundation
    • Build a certification foundation with company-sponsored exam vouchers, including Security+, Network+, CySA+, and cloud certifications
    • Complete hands-on lab work to strengthen skills in networking, operating systems, cloud, and security
    • Take part in CTF platforms such as HackTheBox and TryHackMe to build practical offensive and defensive skills
    • Gain exposure to SIEM, vulnerability scanning, and endpoint security tools in lab and real-world settings under mentorship
  • Presales & Client Engagement
    • Shadow senior consultants on real client engagements, gaining early exposure to professional security consulting
    • Attend internal presales and delivery meetings to learn how GuidePoint scopes, sells, and delivers solutions
    • Practice explaining technical concepts to non-technical audiences in client-facing settings under mentorship
    • Support the preparation of presales materials, demos, and technical discussions alongside the Heartland team
  • Technical Writing & Vendor Knowledge
    • Practice technical writing, including executive summaries and findings reports
    • Build vendor-specific product knowledge aligned to GuidePoint's technology partnerships
    • Research and document how partner solutions map to common client security challenges
    • Document lab work, engagement observations, and lessons learned to support your own growth and the team's knowledge base

Qualifications

  • Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field. Associate's degree candidates with self-study and lab work, and non-traditional backgrounds with equivalent knowledge, will be considered
  • Foundational knowledge of networking, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/S, subnetting, VLANs, firewalls, and routing basics
  • Exemplifying leadership tendencies, such as leading student organizations or industry clubs
  • Comfort navigating both Windows and Linux, with command-line proficiency
  • Understanding of core security concepts, including the CIA triad, authentication vs. authorization, encryption basics, and common attack vectors (phishing, malware, ransomware, social engineering)
  • Basic understanding of at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and the shared responsibility model
  • A habit of self-directed learning, shown through home labs, CTFs, blogs, or personal projects
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Coachable and open to feedback. You don't need to be right, you need to get it right.
  • A self-starter who looks for work without being told, and has a collaborative, team-oriented mindset
  • Professional maturity: punctual, reliable, responsive, and presentable in client-facing settings

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active participation in cybersecurity communities (meetups, BSides, DEFCON, Discord/Slack groups)
  • Any existing certifications (CompTIA ITF+, A+, Network+, Security+)
  • Exposure to a SIEM, vulnerability scanner, or endpoint security tool, even in a lab environment
  • Basic scripting ability (Python, PowerShell, or Bash)
  • Previous customer-facing experience of any kind (retail, help desk, tutoring, etc.)

Internship Details and Expectations

This is a part-time, remote paid internship ($20/hr) that runs for 12 weeks from January 11 - April 2, 2027, with an optional in-person onboarding in Tampa FL during the first week. There is the potential for full-time employment at the end of the internship. During this internship, interns are expected to:

  • Be located near Tulsa, OK, or be willing to relocate there for follow-on full-time hire
  • Be physically located within the United States for the entire internship
  • Work 20-29 hrs/wk during standard business hours supporting the Central Time Zone
  • Have a personal computing device and high-speed internet access during working hours

This position is not available for candidates living in the following states: Alaska, California, Hawaii, New Mexico, New York, Oregon, Washington and Wyoming.

The below perks are for those that join GuidePoint Security for full-time employment only.

We use Greenhouse Software as our applicant tracking system and Zoom Scheduler for HR screen request scheduling. At times, your email may block our communication with you. Please be sure to check your SPAM folder so that you don't miss updates on your application.

Why GuidePoint?

GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security. Since its inception in 2011, GuidePoint has grown to over 1,300 employees, established strategic partnerships with leading security vendors, and serves as a trusted advisor to more than 6,200 customers.

Firmly-defined core values drive all aspects of the business, which have been paramount to the company’s success and establishment of an enjoyable workplace atmosphere. At GuidePoint, your colleagues are knowledgeable, skilled, and experienced and will seek to collaborate and provide mentorship and guidance at every opportunity.

This is a unique and rare opportunity to grow your career along with one of the fastest growing companies in the nation.

Some added perks….

  • Remote workforce primarily (U.S. based only, some travel may be required for certain positions, working on-site may be required for Federal positions)
  • Group Medical Insurance options: Zero Deductible PPO Plan (GuidePoint pays 90% of the premium for employees and 70% for family plans (spouse/children/family) or High Deductible Health Plan with HSA (GuidePoint pays 100% of the employees premiums and 75% for family plans (spouse/children/family). If you choose the High Deductible / HSA plan, GPS will contribute in 4 equal quarterly installments: ($850 per EE annually / $1750 per family annually (includes spouse/children/family options)
  • Group Dental Insurance: GuidePoint pays 100% of the premium for employees and 75% of family plans
  • 12 corporate holidays and a Flexible Time Off (FTO) program
  • Healthy mobile phone and home internet allowance
  • Eligibility for retirement plan after 2 months at open enrollment
  • Pet Benefit Option

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant
jobs.excerpt: Canvas Medical is accelerating everyday medicine with an EMR platform built for healthcare automation.
jobs.description:
Canvas Medical is accelerating everyday medicine with an EMR platform built for healthcare automation. We create modern, elegant front- and back-end tooling to enable new ways for developers and clinicians to integrate data, automate workflows, and collaborate to solve healthcare's toughest challenges. In doing so we advance our mission to give care teams superpowers with software.
Canvas is institutionally backed by some of the greatest technology investors in the world (funded notable health tech companies such as GoodRx, Oscar Health, and Hims & Hers Health).
Role Description
We're hiring a Solutions Consultant to join our GTM Operations team and bridge the gap between customer needs and platform capabilities. This role sits at the intersection of customer empathy, product strategy, and technical execution—helping providers and care teams unlock real value from Canvas Medical's EMR by transforming their workflows into actionable, high-quality solutions.
As a Solutions Consultant, you'll engage directly with customers, prospects, and internal stakeholders to understand complex healthcare delivery challenges. You'll translate these insights into clear product requirements, prototype solutions using the Canvas SDK, and help evolve our platform by identifying strategic enhancement opportunities. This is a high-leverage role where you'll act as a multiplier—accelerating how Canvas delivers value to customers while shaping how our platform scales.
The ideal candidate brings deep curiosity about healthcare technology, comfort with modern development tools, and exceptional ability to bridge business and technical contexts. You'll thrive in ambiguity, balance short-term customer needs with long-term platform health, and collaborate seamlessly across operational and technical teams. We're looking for someone with a growth mindset who can rapidly iterate, experiment with new approaches, and build from the ground up with agility.

Responsibilities

  • Customer Discovery & Solution Design
  • Engage directly with customers, prospects, and internal partners to understand clinical workflows, pain points, and desired outcomes
  • Translate healthcare delivery insights into clear, structured Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) that drive solution design
  • Balance immediate customer needs with long-term platform evolution to create sustainable, scalable solutions
  • Document learnings and contribute to internal knowledge-sharing to elevate team effectiveness
  • Technical Prototyping & Platform Development
  • Build and validate solutions using the Canvas SDK, demonstrating fluency in event-driven design, handlers, and effects
  • Partner with engineers to prototype elegant solutions that showcase platform capabilities
  • Strategically evaluate when to deliver within existing SDK capabilities versus advocating for platform enhancements
  • Create and maintain reusable solution patterns and playbooks that accelerate future engagements
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Delivery
  • Collaborate across sales, customer success, implementation, engineering, and product teams to align on delivery and feedback loops
  • Bridge operational and technical contexts to move solutions forward effectively
  • Surface and track quality signals (demo-to-production flow, SDK adoption, customer feedback) to inform iteration
  • Shadow senior team members while progressively owning lower-complexity engagements independently

Qualifications

  • Required Experience & Background
  • Recent graduate or early-career candidate in Computer Science, Health Informatics, Engineering, UX, Applied Data, or related discipline
  • Deep interest in healthcare technology and EMR systems with desire to improve provider and patient workflows
  • Demonstrated ability to learn quickly and adapt in ambiguous environments
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with ability to distill complex contexts into crisp requirements
  • Technical Skills & Capabilities
  • Comfort learning and working with modern SDKs, APIs, and plugin-based architectures
  • Willingness to ramp into concepts like event-driven design, handlers, and effects
  • Strategic mindset to balance short-term deliverables with long-term platform health
  • Ability to identify leverage points and scalable solution patterns
  • Healthcare & Domain Expertise
  • Understanding of healthcare delivery challenges and provider workflow pain points
  • Interest in healthcare automation and improving clinical operations through software
  • Ability to engage with clinical, operational, and financial stakeholders
  • Personal Attributes
  • Collaborative by default—thrives working across operations and technical teams
  • Growth mindset with rapid learning velocity
  • Productive tension management—comfortable wrestling with trade-offs
  • AI-native and pragmatic—uses modern tooling to accelerate discovery while respecting real-world constraints
  • Nice-to-Have Qualifications
  • Exposure to building or working with SDKs, frontend/backend integrations, or plugin architectures
  • Familiarity with healthcare data workflows, standards, or provider-facing tooling
  • Experience drafting product requirements, specs, or mockups for technical systems
  • Comfort with basic scripting (Python, JavaScript) or building demonstrable prototypes
  • Prior customer-facing experience in technical capacity (internships, support, technical project work)

What Success Looks Like at 90 Days

  • Own parts of the solution lifecycle—writing PRDs and delivering SDK-based prototypes independently
  • Successfully translate 3-5 customer engagements into actionable solutions using the Canvas platform
  • Identify and document at least 2 platform enhancement opportunities that enable scalable solutions
  • Build strong working relationships across GTM operations and engineering teams

Growth Path

  • In your first 6-12 months, you'll begin owning significant portions of the solution lifecycle—from customer discovery through prototype delivery. High performers evolve into senior solution consultants who lead small pods, shape customer delivery strategies, and drive platform capability expansion.
  • This role offers a unique opportunity to influence both how Canvas delivers immediate customer value and how our platform scales to meet future healthcare automation challenges.

Location

  • Remote/San Francisco/Washington DC We are a fully remote, distributed team but encourage in-person collaboration in our office in San Francisco, or one of our satellite locations which for this role is in Washington DC. We encourage people to do their work when and where they perform at their best. Because of this structure, strong written communication skills, time management skills, and personal accountability are very important to us.
Canvas Medical provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.description:
2Brains es una consultora tecnológica que impulsa el crecimiento y la evolución de organizaciones líderes en Latinoamérica. Diseñamos y construimos el futuro digital de nuestros clientes a través de una integración profunda y estratégica de negocio, experiencia y tecnología, convirtiendo desafíos complejos en impacto real.
Hoy, 2Brains forma parte de Acid Labs, uno de los principales grupos de consultoría tech e innovación de la región. Esta adquisición fortalece nuestra propuesta de valor, ampliando nuestra escala, capacidades tecnológicas y presencia regional, y nos permite acompañar a nuestros clientes con soluciones más robustas, ágiles y de alto impacto en todo su ciclo de transformación.
Contamos con un equipo multidisciplinario de más de 250 especialistas en estrategia, diseño, tecnología, datos e inteligencia artificial. Combinamos visión estratégica con ejecución de excelencia para crear plataformas tecnológicas, productos digitales y experiencias omnicanal que escalan, generan eficiencia y mejoran la relación entre las organizaciones y sus usuarios.
En 2Brains no solo asesoramos: diseñamos, prototipamos, implementamos y escalamos. Trabajamos como socios estratégicos de nuestros clientes, ayudándolos a acelerar la toma de decisiones, reducir riesgos y capturar valor tangible a través de la innovación digital.
El Engineering Team Lead de 2Brains debe liderar técnicamente un squad, asegurando excelencia en ingeniería, confiabilidad de los sistemas y una ejecución alineada con el impacto en el negocio.
Este rol es clave en la construcción de un squad nuevo (Hoteles), estableciendo estándares técnicos, cultura de trabajo y una colaboración sólida con Producto y Diseño.
El ETL actúa como referente técnico, facilitador del desarrollo de personas y socio estratégico de la tríada (Product Manager, Product Designer), equilibrando calidad, velocidad y sostenibilidad.

¿Qué desafíos tendrá el/la Engineering Team Lead?

  • Liderar la arquitectura y decisiones técnicas del squad, alineadas con estándares de ingeniería de LATAM.
  • Diseñar e implementar soluciones robustas, escalables y seguras, desde una mirada cloud-native.
  • Asegurar clean code, buenas prácticas de CI/CD y control de deuda técnica.
  • Guiar al equipo en contextos de ambigüedad, equilibrando trade-offs entre rapidez, calidad y escalabilidad.
  • Definir y promover prácticas de testing (unitarias, integración, contrato y E2E).
  • Garantizar confiabilidad operativa, observabilidad (logs, métricas, trazas) y respuesta a incidentes.
  • Liderar post-mortems sin culpa, impulsando mejoras técnicas medibles.
  • Trabajar hombro a hombro con Product Manager y Product Designer en discovery y delivery.
  • Traducir necesidades de negocio y usuarios en criterios técnicos claros y medibles.
  • Mentorear al equipo mediante 1:1, feedback continuo y planes de desarrollo.
  • Construir un entorno de seguridad psicológica, autonomía y accountability.

¿Qué conocimientos buscamos en el/la Engineering Team Lead?

    Conocimientos técnicos (must have)

  • Experiencia liderando técnicamente equipos de desarrollo.
  • Sólidos fundamentos en arquitectura de software y diseño de sistemas escalables.
  • Experiencia en:
  • Arquitecturas distribuidas (microservicios y/o event-driven).
  • Diseño y consumo de APIs y contratos de servicio.
  • CI/CD y automatización de despliegues.
  • Experiencia trabajando en cloud (AWS, GCP o Azure).
  • Manejo de bases de datos SQL y/o NoSQL.
  • Conocimientos en observabilidad (logs, métricas, tracing).
  • Prácticas de seguridad aplicada al desarrollo.

    • Conocimientos deseables (nice to have)

  • Experiencia aplicando prácticas SRE.
  • Uso de métricas DORA para mejora continua.
  • Experiencia en Kubernetes y entornos containerizados.
  • Experiencia en sistemas de mediana o alta complejidad.
  • Exposición a IA aplicada cuando aporta valor real al producto.

¿Qué competencias buscamos en el/la Engineering Team Lead?

  • Liderazgo técnico basado en criterio e influencia, no en jerarquía.
  • Capacidad de desarrollar personas y construir equipos de alto desempeño.
  • Pensamiento crítico y toma de decisiones bajo incertidumbre.
  • Mentalidad de producto y entendimiento del impacto en negocio.
  • Comunicación clara con perfiles técnicos y no técnicos.
  • Colaboración efectiva con producto, diseño y stakeholders.
  • Orientación a la mejora continua y aprendizaje constante.

Te ofrecemos

  • Trabajar con un equipo de alto rendimiento, aprendemos y nos desarrollamos juntos
  • Acceso a grandes clientes y proyectos desafiantes
  • Aprendizaje y crecimiento permanente, organizamos meetups, capacitaciones y actividades culturales
  • Un entorno de trabajo flexible y dinámico.

jobs.excerpt: About Canvas Medical: Canvas Medical is on a mission to reimagine healthcare technology.
jobs.description:
About Canvas Medical: Canvas Medical is on a mission to reimagine healthcare technology. Our platform provides a modern, developer-friendly electronic medical records (EMR) system, enabling better patient care and empowering healthcare innovators. By combining cutting-edge technology with a deep understanding of clinical workflows, we’re transforming how healthcare is delivered.
Role Overview: As a Developer Advocate at Canvas Medical, you will be the voice of the developer community and a bridge between external developers and our internal product teams. Your primary goal will be to champion the needs of developers integrating with Canvas Medical’s API, provide technical guidance, and ensure our developer tools and documentation empower users to build impactful healthcare applications. This role is ideal for a technical communicator passionate about healthcare innovation and developer enablement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Community Engagement: Build and nurture relationships with the developer community through forums, social media, webinars, and meetups. Act as the primary point of contact for external developers, collecting feedback and sharing insights with internal teams.
  • Technical Advocacy: Create and maintain high-quality documentation, tutorials, sample code, and SDKs to support developers using Canvas Medical’s API. Collaborate with the product and engineering teams to enhance API usability based on developer feedback.

See what life is about at BCD M&E at

About the Role

If you love keeping moving pieces organized and making complex event logistics feel seamless, this could be your kind of role. As a Congress Specialist, Registration, you’ll support Life Sciences congress activity in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment where accuracy, compliance, and great communication really matter. You’ll be the go-to for attendee registration, housing coordination, confirmations, and client support across multiple congresses at once. It’s a great fit for someone who’s detail-obsessed, solution-oriented, and enjoys working with both data and people.

You’re Good At

  • Managing attendee registration, rooming lists, visa letter requests, and final confirmations with accuracy and care
  • Working in a structured, compliance-focused environment where documentation, audit readiness, and deadlines are essential
  • Using Cvent attendee, hotel, and reporting modules to maintain clean data, reporting, and communication workflows
  • Handling client questions and logistical details with professionalism, responsiveness, and a strong customer-service mindset
  • Juggling multiple congresses at once while staying organized, collaborative, and focused on delivering quality work

You Might Also Have

  • 5+ years of congress or convention planning and management experience
  • 3+ years of client management experience and 3+ years of attendee management experience
  • Experience supporting Life Sciences or pharmaceutical programs in a highly regulated, detail-oriented setting
  • International attendee experience and confidence working across cultures on a global team
  • A college degree and/or CMP certification

You Should Know

  • This role is virtual and is open to US and Canadian applicants.

If you’re ready to bring precision, energy, and great client service to exciting congress programs, apply now!

THE PERKS

Flexible Working
We believe that a flexible working environment is key to getting the best out of our teams. We will support you to work where you need to and when you need to, depending on how you work best.

Room to Grow
Our line of work and business structure challenge our people in a way that inspires growth, with learning and development built into every role. We give individuals ownership over the direction and speed in which they grow.

Everyone has a voice
We thrive on conversations that spark curiosity and empathy. No matter how big or how small, every voice is heard, considered and respected.

Make your move
The diversity of roles across BCD M&E’s global locations means that our people often find new adventures during their time with us. Join us as a meeting planner role in the UK, stay for a global marketing career — there’s always room to move.

We’ve got you covered
Our extensive benefits include comprehensive healthcare, retirement plans, continued education support, diverse work locations, travel and hotel discounts, volunteer and sustainability opportunities and a successful employee recognition program.

We’re positive. You’ll love it.
It starts from the top. Our leaders lead with positivity, believe in our people and trust us to do the right thing. There will always be support along your journey, in little and big ways.

Travel requirements for this role are as follows:Less than 25%

The salary range for candidates in applicable jurisdictions in the US for the position of Congress Registration Manager is between $52,500 - $65,000 USD. The actual pay depends on your skills, qualifications, experience, geographical location, and project budget.

Jeeves is a groundbreaking financial operating system built for global businesses that provides corporate cards, cross-border payments, and spend management software within one unified platform. The company operates across 20+ countries including Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Mexico, the United Kingdom, across Europe, and the United States, and serves over 5,000 clients ranging from venture-backed startups to SMBs around the world. With a mission to empower businesses with more efficient and cost-effective financial solutions worldwide, Jeeves combines cutting-edge financial technology with exceptional team expertise to transform the business financial landscape. Jeeves has been recognized as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2023, as well as a Y Combinator Top Company 2021-2023 and won “Fintech of the Year" at the European Fintech Awards.
Since graduating from Y Combinator in 2020, Jeeves has successfully raised over $380 million and is backed by top world-class investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Tencent, Stanford University, Clocktower Ventures, and founders of more than 15 unicorns including David Velez (Nubank), Carlos Garcia (Kavak) and Sebastián Mejía (Rappi).

Job Responsibilities:

  • Acquire high-quality new clients through efficient outbound strategies (Hunting) + cross-sell & upsell existing clients by providing top-notch consultative sales.
  • Identify business opportunities targeting mid- to large-sized businesses, and later-stage venture-backed startups; consistently meet and exceed sales targets and deliver revenue growth as an individual contributor.
  • Manage full sales cycle and executive effective pipeline strategy: lead generation, prospecting, qualifying, discovery, objection handling, development, negotiating, and closing.
  • Provide timely, detailed, and actionable feedback to management. product and engineering teams to constantly improve Jeeves’ platform features and financial services offerings.
  • Collaborate with marketing and customer success to develop your own materials and increase conversion rates
  • Build an effortless and value-driven client experience while working directly with a versatile portfolio of business owners to help support their financial goals
  • Work with our Country & Regional Managers to develop, track, and exceed quota targets.
  • Build an effortless and value-driven client experience while working directly with a versatile portfolio of business owners to help support their financial goals

Requirements:

  • 6+ years of experience in sales B2B or business development (SAAS or Financial Services)
  • An existing network of transferable B2B relationships preferably with mid- to large-sized businesses is a must
  • Demonstrated ability to garner attention, present professionally, and communicate at all levels of an organization - focus on CFOs, Partners, and Business Owners
  • Successful track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales targets
  • Keen interest in developing a career in a high-performing Sales team and learning the inputs of a sales machine; willingness to put in the work necessary to be successful
  • Hands-on experience using CRM software (ex. Salesforce, Hubspot or Pipedrive) and AI tools.
  • Expertise in sales methodologies — MEDDPICC, SPIN, Challenger, or similar — and demonstrated ability to embed them into how a team operates day-to-day. You have a point of view on qualification and you enforce it.
  • Demonstrated success negotiating and closing complex, high-impact deals with C-level executives (CFOs, founders, partners).
  • Strong executive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate value to financial decision-makers.

    Nice to Have:

  • Prior experience working within a fast-growing startup, fintech, payments, cross border experience is strongly preferred but not required
  • Familiarity with stablecoins or emerging financial technologies

What will set you up for success:

  • Hunter DNA: You're not waiting for inbound leads. You know how to find opportunities, open doors, and build relationships from zero — using every tool and strategy available.
  • CFO Fluency: You're comfortable in the room with finance leadership. You understand their priorities, speak their language, and know how to build trust at the executive level.
  • AI-First Mindset: You actively use AI tools to work smarter — from prospecting to follow-ups. You're curious, adaptive, and always looking for ways to improve your craft.
  • Builder Profile: We're a lean, fast-moving team. You thrive with independence, make decisions quickly, and bring a "get things done" attitude every day.
  • Results Focused: You're energized by numbers. If the metrics don't exist yet, you're the one defining them and figuring out how to hit them.

jobs.title: Director of Revenue Operations
jobs.excerpt: Ready to make a real impact on global health and wellness care?
jobs.description:
Ready to make a real impact on global health and wellness care?

Practice Better is an all-in-one platform helping health and wellness practitioners run their businesses, care for their clients, and scale their impact. Founded by practitioners in 2016, we’re now the leading EHR and practice management platform in the wellness industry, trusted by tens of thousands of practitioners across 70+ countries.

In 2023, we expanded our whole-practice care offering through the acquisition of That Clean Life, bringing nutrition planning into our platform.

We’re a remote-first team headquartered in Toronto, made up of curious, driven, and empathetic people building tools that help practitioners create sustainable, independent practices; and do the most meaningful work of their careers. While most of our work happens remotely, we come together regularly for off-sites and team events to stay connected and build together.

Important notice to our applicants and job seekers:

We've become aware of fraudulent messages impersonating Practice Better's recruitment team.

Please note:

  • Practice Better will never ask for payment, banking details, or personal financial information at any stage of the hiring process
  • All official communication comes from @practicebetter.io email addresses
  • We will never ask you to purchase equipment, software, or gift cards
  • We will never conduct interviews solely via text message or WhatsApp

If something feels off, trust your instincts. Verify any suspicious outreach by contacting us directly at before taking any action.

Thank you for helping us keep our hiring process safe and transparent.

Position Summary

We are looking for a Director of Revenue Operations to join our growing team.

In this role, you will own the systems, data, and processes that power our go-to-market engine, from instrumenting our PLG-to-sales-assist funnel end-to-end in HubSpot to connecting
Marketing, Sales-assist, Customer Success, and Payments into a single, insight-driven revenue motion. This role will be reporting directly to the President.

The ideal candidate is a structured systems thinker who is equally comfortable building a board-ready forecast and rolling up their sleeves in our HubSpot-based CRM to clean attribution logic or rationalize a bloated tech stack.

Note: Practice Better is a remote-first company with team members across North America. However, this particular role is currently open to Canadian-based candidates only, and preference will be given to applicants legally authorized to work in Canada.

What You’ll Be Doing

Revenue Architecture & Forecasting

  • Own the integrated GTM plan, quota models, and annual budgeting process in close partnership with the VP, Finance
  • Build and maintain board-level forecasting for Subscription, Payments, and Add-On products, tying marketing pipeline and churn drivers to ARR
  • Deliver blended revenue forecasts with ≤±5% variance and produce scenario-based models that inform decisions to scale toward 2–3x current ARR

Tech Stack & Data Operations

  • Audit the full revenue tech stack (HubSpot, marketing-automation, payments platform, product analytics, BI) and maintain a rolling optimization roadmap
  • Automate lead-to-cash, renewal, and expansion workflows; own data cleanliness, attribution logic, and compensation engines
  • Rationalize GTM tool spend and lead consolidation initiatives that reduce cost without sacrificing capability

Funnel & Pipeline Management

  • Map and instrument the PLG → sales-assist → expansion funnel; create common definitions, SLAs, and stage-conversion dashboards
  • Stand up and maintain PQL scoring models, routing highest-intent signals to SDRs with a PQL → SDR SLA of under 5 minutes
  • Drive MQL → SQL and SQL → Closed-Won conversion rate improvements of ≥3 percentage points each year

Insights & Experimentation

  • Partner with Marketing on pricing and packaging tests, with Product on usage-to-revenue insights, and with Payments on take-rate optimization
  • Roll out self-serve dashboards across GTM functions, targeting >80% weekly active usage by GTM leaders
  • Define OKRs, reporting cadences, and playbooks so Growth, Marketing, and CX operate from a single source of truth

What You Bring

  • 5–8+ years in Revenue Operations roles at SaaS companies currently operating between $30–100M ARR, with experience scaling through this stage. - and experience at companies with 250–300 employees or fewer (We're looking for people in SaaS companies, not consultancies or RevOps agencies).
  • Direct, hands-on experience running RevOps in a PLG / self-serve-to-paid motion.
  • Mastery of modern GTM stacks: HubSpot, marketing-automation, product-led analytics, BI, CPQ, and subscription billing
  • Experience in a PLG or product-assisted sales motion
  • Proven track record of turning noisy data into board-quality forecasts and unlocking double-digit efficiency gains across funnel stages
  • Experience supporting pricing and packaging migrations and new revenue streams (embedded payments, usage-based, or add-ons)
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a bias for clarity and action
  • Analytical, curious, and adaptable—you seek solutions, not perfection
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, remote, growth-stage environment

jobs.excerpt: Time commitment: Between 3-5 days per week (0. 6-1 FTE) - our preference is for this to be an Employed position, but we will also consider Self-employed arrangements Location: Remote Reporting to: NeurodevelopmentalTeam Manager About PalomaIn 2024, our founders, Mark and Darshak, were shocked to find that children needing an NHS autism or ADHD assessment were waiting 4-10 years for these assessments.
jobs.description:
Time commitment: Between 3-5 days per week (0.6-1 FTE) - our preference is for this to be an Employed position, but we will also consider Self-employed arrangements

Location: Remote

Reporting to: NeurodevelopmentalTeam Manager

About Paloma

In 2024, our founders, Mark and Darshak, were shocked to find that children needing an NHS autism or ADHD assessment were waiting 4-10 years for these assessments. Delayed assessments result in children being more likely to develop mental health conditions and fall behind in education. Furthermore, the much-needed pre/post-assessment support (outside of ADHD medications) is typically not funded by the NHS.

These long waits have built up due to increased recognition and understanding of neurodevelopmental conditions and a lack of investment and innovation within the NHS to meet the growing demand.

Mark and Darshak, with their 25 years of combined NHS experience, including building services that have treated over 1,000,000 patients in obesity & ophthalmology, founded Paloma to change this. Our mission is to make NHS autism and ADHD assessments and care accessible within 4 weeks of a GP referral, and, in turn, help every child achieve their potential.

As of May 2026, we have successfully reduced waits to 3 months by;

  • Taking a product-first approach to redesign the care pathway to give families a more consumer-like experience of care
  • Our in-house product, engineering and AI team building our own autism and ADHD specific electronic patient record and AI documentation tool to free clinicians from their significant documentation burden to re-focus on supporting families
  • Investing in expanding the clinician workforce and upskilling them in new ways of working.

We are proud that Paloma is:

  • Loved by families, with 4.9 out of 5 Trustpilot and Google ratings
  • Care Quality Commission (CQC) registered and quality-focused
  • Clinically-led, with a team of 130 people, including over 80 clinicians supporting families through their assessment journey. We are hiring 100+ more roles over the next 12 months.
  • A community of passionate, mission-driven and innovative team members who challenge the status quo and test and learn from new ideas and approaches.
  • Backed by leading healthcare investors Triple Point and Heal Capital

What’s next?

  • Whilst we have reduced wait times, it is estimated that up to 500,000 children are still waiting for an NHS autism or ADHD assessment. We won’t rest until this comes down.
  • We want to build new services to support families and children diagnosed with autism or ADHD who feel lost after their assessments when the NHS is no longer there for them.

The Opportunity

Are you an innovative clinician working in children’s ADHD assessments, excited to use software tools that enhance the prescriber and patient experience of care? This role is for you!

We are not a standard ADHD assessment service; we:

  • Have built our own technology & AI tools to gather the required information from families, and support your documentation, so you can focus on children’s needs
  • Have a Clinical Specialist, who is a senior clinician who works alongside you to ensure all of our ADHD assessments are multidisciplinary in line with NICE guidance.
  • Offer an integrated prescribing service led by our Prescribing Team, ensuring families can get fast access to ADHD medications where required

This role will ensure we deliver a fantastic Children’s ADHD assessment service to families. If you have the appropriate skills, you can work across our Children’s Autism and Children's Dual Autism and ADHD Assessment pathways.

We commit to supporting your development and well-being, including:

  • The Paloma Clinical Academy programme supports all clinicians at all stages of their careers to develop (e.g. to our Senior Assessor role) and cross-skill (e.g. in autism)
  • Regular clinical supervision
  • 1 protected day per month for assessor team training, Continuing Professional Development (CPD), and reflection.
  • Quarterly development conversations with clear career progression pathways.
  • Clear weekly timetables that support a role mix across appointments, administration, development, and team building.

About you

You are a registered nurse, speech and language therapist, occupational therapist, social worker or practitioner psychologist skilled in ADHD assessments.

You want to be part of an always-learning environment that embraces software and AI tools, and you will help us go further and faster with your positive and collaborative attitude.

Responsibilities:

  • Deliver high-quality Children’s ADHD Neurodevelopmental Assessments
  • Act in accordance with our Safeguarding Policy, including conducting a risk assessment where necessary.
  • Keep up to date with the mandatory training, Continuing Professional Development and professional registration requirements of your professional background.
  • Share ideas for continuing to improve Paloma’s software tools that ensure high-quality, safe, and efficient assessments

Qualifications and experience:

Required:

  • By background, you are either a:
    • NMC-registered Nurse
    • HCPC Registered Speech and Language Therapist, Occupational Therapist, Arts Therapist, or Practitioner Psychologist (including Clinical Psychologists, Educational Psychologists and Counselling Psychologists)
    • Social Work England Registered Social Worker
  • You ideally have at least 1 year of experience in delivering Children’s ADHD assessments. At a minimum, we will consider 6 months of experience within a children’s ADHD assessment pathway. For Clinical Psychologists, we include pre-graduation experience within the 6 months of experience.
  • Your children’s ADHD experience should include:
    • Having a sound understanding of typical development through life stages, co-occurring conditions, and differentials.
    • Have a good understanding of normal levels of attention, impulsivity, and hyperactivity in typically developing children and young people, and consider this within the cultural background of the individual being assessed.
    • The ability to present findings which are client-centred and include strengths and needs.
  • You can demonstrate good time management skills, including caseload management, and good parent and child communication skills
  • Passing an enhanced DBS with barred list check, as you will be working with children

Desirable:

  • Experience in conducting risk assessments within Neurodevelopmental assessments
  • Safeguarding training to Level 3 and above
  • Experience in Children’s Autism Assessments and Dual Assessments

Why join Paloma?

You will be part of a mission-driven organisation that’s transforming access to autism and ADHD care in England.

We offer:

  • A strong and positive culture that prioritises staff well-being, transparency, and career development.
  • £350 per completed assessment and family feedback.

Equality & Diversity

Paloma Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and throughout the application process. We do not discriminate based on any protected characteristic.

Accommodations

We’re glad to accommodate candidates who need adjustments throughout the hiring process. We encourage you to be open about the adjustments you need, so we can adapt our interview process accordingly.

Safer Recruitment & Pre-Employment Checks

Paloma Health ensures that supporting people to be safe is at the heart of our work and a key priority across all areas of the organisation. As part of our pre-employment checks, you will be asked to complete a Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check. Depending on your role within the business, this will be at either an Enhanced, Standard, or Basic level. We are committed to safer recruitment practices and expect all applicants to share our dedication to safeguarding. Our recruitment processes are designed to ensure we appoint individuals who align with our values and will help maintain a safe and supportive environment for everyone we work with.

Application process

Please apply via our website. We understand that applying for a new job requires significant effort, and we appreciate your time. We look forward to reviewing your application.

Join us and be part of our journey to revolutionise access to NHS autism and ADHD care!

This is a builder role where you'll directly impact how healthcare providers leverage our EMR platform while contributing to the evolution of our developer tools and SDK.
The ideal candidate brings strong engineering fundamentals, passion for healthcare technology, and exceptional ability to navigate between rapid prototyping and production-quality code. You'll thrive in collaborative environments, balance customer urgency with engineering excellence, and drive technical decisions that scale. We're looking for someone who experiments fearlessly, iterates quickly, and can build elegant solutions from the ground up while maintaining the robustness required for healthcare systems.

Responsibilities

  • Technical Solution Development
  • Build production-ready solutions using the Canvas SDK, demonstrating mastery of event-driven architectures, handlers, and effects
  • Transform PRDs from Solutions Consultants into elegant, maintainable code that solves real healthcare workflow challenges
  • Create robust plugins and integrations that extend platform capabilities while maintaining HIPAA compliance and clinical documentation standards
  • Develop and maintain a library of reusable components and patterns that accelerate future solution delivery
  • Platform Enhancement & Innovation
  • Identify gaps in SDK capabilities and contribute directly to platform improvements through pull requests and feature development
  • Design and implement new SDK features that enable broader solution patterns across the customer base
  • Build developer tools and utilities that improve the efficiency of both internal teams and external developers
  • Create technical documentation, integration guides, and reference implementations for complex solutions
  • Cross-Functional Technical Leadership
  • Partner with Solutions Consultants to validate technical feasibility and architect optimal approaches
  • Collaborate with core engineering teams to align custom solutions with platform roadmap and architectural standards
  • Enable customer success through technical workshops, debugging sessions, and solution handoffs
  • Mentor Solutions Consultants on technical concepts and best practices for SDK usage

Qualifications

  • Required Experience & Background
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
  • 2+ years of professional software development experience with modern web stacks
  • Demonstrated ability to build end-to-end solutions from requirements to production deployment
  • Strong problem-solving skills with ability to navigate ambiguous technical challenges
  • Technical Skills & Capabilities
  • Proficiency in Python is mandatory.
  • JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks (React preferred) are a bonus.
  • Experience with API design, event-driven architectures, and plugin-based systems
  • Strong understanding of software design patterns, testing practices, and code maintainability
  • Comfort with rapid prototyping while maintaining production-quality standards
  • Experience with version control, CI/CD pipelines, and modern development workflows
  • Healthcare & Domain Expertise
  • Interest in healthcare technology and improving clinical workflows through automation
  • Understanding of healthcare data standards (FHIR, HL7) or willingness to learn quickly
  • Ability to translate clinical requirements into technical architecture decisions
  • Appreciation for the complexity and criticality of healthcare systems
  • Personal Attributes
  • Builder mentality—passionate about creating solutions that directly impact users
  • Collaborative approach to problem-solving with strong communication skills
  • Growth mindset with ability to learn new technologies and domains rapidly
  • Pragmatic engineering approach—knows when to build for today versus tomorrow
  • Customer empathy with drive to understand and solve real user problems
  • Nice-to-Have Qualifications
  • Experience building or maintaining SDKs, developer tools, or platform products
  • Background in healthcare IT, EMR integrations, or clinical systems
  • Familiarity with regulatory requirements (HIPAA, FDA guidelines) for healthcare software
  • Experience with Python for backend services or data processing
  • Prior experience in customer-facing engineering or solutions architecture roles
  • Contributions to open-source projects or technical community engagement

What Success Looks Like at 90 Days

  • Ship 5+ production-ready solutions that demonstrate deep understanding of the Canvas SDK and platform capabilities
  • Contribute at least 2 meaningful enhancements to the SDK or developer tools based on customer solution needs
  • Establish strong working relationships with Solutions Consultants and become go-to technical partner for complex implementations
  • Create technical documentation and reference implementations that enable self-service solution development

Growth Path

Solutions Engineers at Canvas have multiple growth trajectories. Within 12-18 months, high performers evolve into senior solutions engineers who architect our most complex customer implementations and drive platform strategy. Many transition into core platform engineering roles, bringing deep customer context to shape product development. Others grow into technical leadership positions, building and scaling our solutions engineering practice. This role offers unique exposure to both customer challenges and platform internals, positioning you to influence Canvas's technical direction and healthcare impact.

Location: Fully Remote

Duration: 3 – 6 Months

Pathways: Direct consideration for Full-Time & Paid Roles upon successful completion

About Wing

Wing is on a mission to redefine the Future of Work. We are a tech-enabled platform that combines sophisticated AI automation with elite human expertise to help businesses scale seamlessly and place operations on autopilot.

M32 AI (backed by top-tier Silicon Valley VCs), dedicated to building agentic AI for traditional service businesses. Think of it like a startup within a corporate: fast moving and agile, with the stability of a corporate, and zero bureaucracy.

We move fast, build ambitious products, and give high-performing individuals immediate ownership.

Our internship program is designed for ambitious, self-driven builders who want hands-on experience, direct mentorship from leadership, and a fast track to full-time career opportunities.

Available Internship Tracks

We are recruiting top talent across four core tracks:

  1. Software Engineering Intern (Full Stack or Mobile)

  2. Product Management Intern (Growth / AI Product)

  3. Customer Success & Operations Intern

  4. GTM & Marketing Intern (Growth, Content, Partnerships)

Track 1: Software Engineering Intern (Full Stack or Mobile)

    Overview

    As a Software Engineering Intern, you will work directly alongside our engineering and product teams to design, ship, and optimize core web and mobile applications powering Wing’s ecosystem. You’ll write production-ready code, deploy AI-driven features, and help solve complex engineering challenges.

    Key Responsibilities

    • Full Stack Development: Build and maintain scalable web apps using modern frameworks (React/Next.js, Node.js, Python/Django, or LAMP/PHP stacks).

    • Mobile Development: Support iOS/Android app features using React Native, Flutter, or native frameworks.

    • AI & Integration: Assist in integrating LLMs, REST APIs, and third-party automation tools into production workflows.

    • Quality & Performance: Participate in code reviews, debug technical issues, and optimize application speed and UI responsiveness.

Track 2: AI Product Management Intern (Growth / AI Product)

    Overview

    As an AI Product Management Intern, you will bridge technical execution and product strategy. You’ll coordinate cross-functional teams to bring AI-powered features, automation workflows, and product growth initiatives from concept to launch.

    Key Responsibilities

    • Product Execution: Define clear feature specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria for AI agents, web tools, and internal automation platforms.

    • Roadmap & Sprint Tracking: Assist engineering and design teams using Agile tools (Linear, Jira, Notion) to keep product releases on schedule.

    • Growth & Optimization: Analyze feature usage data, gather user feedback, and iterate on onboarding/growth funnels to improve adoption.

    • AI Feature Benchmarking: Test emerging AI models, tools, and workflows to identify immediate implementation opportunities for Wing.

Track 3: Customer Success & Operations Intern

    Overview

    As a Customer Success & Operations Intern, you will be at the heart of Wing’s business engine. You’ll help onboard new business clients, streamline operations, and ensure an exceptional user experience across our platform.

    Key Responsibilities

    • Client Onboarding & Retention: Support client kickoff processes, build knowledge base guides, and track customer feedback and churn risks.

    • Operational Process Automation: Identify bottlenecks in day-to-day operations and help automate repetitive workflows using tools like Zapier, Make, or CRM systems.

    • Support & Escalations: Monitor customer communication channels, resolve inquiries, and collaborate with technical teams to fix client-facing issues.

    • Reporting & Analytics: Track key operational metrics (CSAT, response times, task turnaround) to present actionable insights to leadership.

Track 4: Go-To-Market & Marketing Intern (Growth, Content, Partnerships)

    Overview

    As a GTM & Marketing Intern, you will fuel Wing’s growth funnel through creative storytelling, strategic partnerships, and performance-driven growth experiments across multiple channels.

    Key Responsibilities

    • Growth & Performance: Plan and execute micro-campaigns to drive lead generation across SEO, paid ads, and social channels (LinkedIn, X, YouTube).

    • Content Creation: Produce engaging posts, blog articles, newsletter copy, case studies, and visual assets highlighting Wing's AI capabilities.

    • Partnership Outreach: Research potential B2B partners, affiliates, and influencers; manage outreach pipelines and follow-ups.

    • Analytics & Attribution: Track campaign performance, click-through rates, and conversion metrics to double down on high-ROI channels.

Program Perks & What You’ll Gain

    • High Impact & Real Ownership: You will not be making coffee or doing filler tasks. You will build, launch, and manage real features, campaigns, and operations that directly impact our business.

    • Direct Leadership Mentorship: Work closely with product leads, senior engineers, and growth executives.

    • Fast-Track to Full-Time: High performers will be prioritized for paid, full-time offers upon completion of the program.

    • Flexible Work Environment: 100% remote with flexible working hours designed around learning and deliverables.

    • Portfolio & Network: Walk away with concrete projects, metrics, and reference letters to showcase your impact.

As a Sales Representative, SMB you will be part of a regional sales team and the overall face of Newsela in the small-medium business market.
