jobs.excerpt: Join beqom — where tech meets impactbeqom is a high-growth B2B SaaS company that provides industry-leading tools for pay equity and transparency, compensation, and performance management.
jobs.description:
Join beqom — where tech meets impact

beqom is a high-growth B2B SaaS company that provides industry-leading tools for pay equity and transparency, compensation, and performance management.

Trusted by some of the world’s most respected companies, beqom enables HR and business leaders to navigate global compliance and make smarter pay decisions that attract, retain, and motivate top talent.

Founded in Switzerland and serving clients worldwide, our powerful, enterprise-ready products are fuelled by beqom pay intelligence.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Agentic Backend Engineer to join our Data Platform Core team, which owns the services at the heart of beqom’s data architecture — multi-tenant data ingestion, schema management, snapshots, calculated fields, and the data contracts powering analytics and reporting across the product.

In this role you will not write the code. AI agents will. You will own the specifications that govern these services, the agentic pipeline that turns those specifications into production software, and the verification machinery that proves the output is correct — with the explicit goal of reaching fully AI-embedded development: no human-written code, no human line-by-line review, and external behavioural scenarios, not traditional test suites, as the quality gate.

You will collaborate closely with Data Platform and Analytics engineers, Support teams, and Product stakeholders — translating their needs into agent-executable specifications. Specs are our system of record; agents do the typing.

What you'll be doing

Agentic Delivery

  • Deliver features across multi-tenant data platform services — data ingestion, schema management, effective dating, snapshots, calculated fields, and exports — exclusively through AI agents working from your specifications.
  • Author structured, testable Product Requirement Prompts (PRPs) and spec files as the primary engineering artefact, and maintain the versioned spec library that governs the codebase.
  • Run multiple agents in parallel across workstreams; evaluate outcomes against specs; progress agent first-pass success rate, defect escape rate, and the share of changes merged without human review steadily upward.

Pipeline Engineering

  • Build and maintain the agentic pipeline: agent harness, blueprint engine interleaving deterministic steps (lint, build, git) with AI reasoning, MCP tool layer exposing internal APIs, warm sandbox pool, and retrieval over the codebase, tickets, and historical PRs.
  • Own the economics of the pipeline: observability over token usage, task latency, and cost per run; model-tier routing and cost-per-outcome gating.
  • Embed governance into the pipeline — machine-generated audit trails, named ownership per feature, data-classification gates keeping production secrets and PII out of agent context.

Verification Engineering

  • Engineer verification, not code: external behavioural scenario suites and holdout sets stored outside the codebase (agents never see the evaluation criteria), digital twins of the systems we integrate with, layered AI-reviews-AI gates, and automated remediation for self-healing services.
  • Set and enforce the constraints that keep agent output correct on performance-critical paths: bulk ingestion throughput, large export streaming, memory behaviour, and complex SQL — validated by scenario and load gates rather than line-by-line reading.

Production Ownership & Collaboration

  • Diagnose and resolve production data issues through agents — with deep enough functional understanding of every service you own to steer remediation quickly, in collaboration with Support and Engineering.
  • Document the specs, scenarios, and pipeline decisions that govern the platform — artefacts both humans and agents can act on — and help other engineers make the same shift.

Skills & Experience

What you'll bring

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience building production backend services — including .NET/C# and PostgreSQL systems — with a demonstrable shift from writing code to directing agents: the majority of your recent production output should be AI-generated under your direction.
  • Hands-on mastery of AI coding agents — Claude Code strongly preferred — including parallel agent sessions, custom skills and sub-agents, and structuring codebases and context so agents work reliably.
  • Excellence in specification writing — turning ambiguous business needs into precise, agent-executable PRPs and spec files. In this role, spec quality is the single most load-bearing skill.
  • Strong verification engineering: behavioural and scenario-based testing, holdout evaluation, quality gates, and validation frameworks — the ability to trust and judge output you did not write.
  • Strong architecture judgement: assessing whether an agent-proposed solution meets performance, scalability, and reliability requirements, and challenging designs that will not hold up under real workloads.
  • Experience building agent infrastructure: MCP servers and tool layers, sandboxed execution, and CI/CD adapted for agent-driven workflows.
  • Deep enough .NET/C# and SQL reading fluency to audit generated code when quality gates flag it — schema design, query plans, streaming vs. buffering, memory behaviour.
  • Excellent written communication: specs, scenario definitions, and design docs that both humans and agents can act on.

Bonus points if you have

  • Experience building digital twins or service virtualisations of external systems for agent evaluation environments.
  • Experience with LLM evaluation at scale: eval suites, red-teaming AI-generated code, benchmarking agent workflows.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS architecture experience, CDC/event-driven ingestion (Debezium, Kafka, RabbitMQ/MassTransit), or lakehouse exposure (Microsoft Fabric).
  • Azure services, Docker, Kubernetes/Helm.
  • Experience with legal, security, or compliance frameworks for AI-authored code.
  • Familiarity with compensation, HR, or pay transparency domains.

Why join us?

  • Your career, your design. Unleash your ambition in our dynamic, autonomous environment.
  • Drive meaningful change. Build a fairer future for every employee by joining a market leader that is improving the world of work.
  • Belong to something bigger. Collaborate with a passionate, diverse and talented team around the globe.

Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice before submitting your application.

jobs.description:
Facilities Management eXpress is looking for an Engineer Manager to join our team!

At FMX, our Engineering Managers have a direct impact on our product, our people, and our culture. As manager of a Core Team, you’ll coach and mentor a talented group of software engineers, give them clarity on priorities and expectations, and help them grow technically and professionally while delivering high-quality software for our customers. You’ll partner closely with product, design, QA, and other engineering leaders to align your team’s work with business goals and build a healthy, high-performing, inclusive engineering culture.

This is a player-coach role. We want a manager who still loves to build: someone who stays close to the code, picks up bugs and non-mission-critical work alongside the team, and leads by example. You’ll also help shape how FMX builds software in an AI-first world, setting the practices, tools, and standards that help our engineers ship faster without lowering the bar on quality.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead and grow your team: Give every engineer clarity on their role, responsibilities, goals, and the team’s processes, and clearly communicate changes to practices, priorities, and expectations. Provide regular coaching, feedback, and career guidance, and advocate for each person’s professional and technical growth.
  • Build a strong culture: Foster trust, accountability, and continuous improvement, where engineers feel valued, heard, and connected to FMX’s mission. Keep the team engaged with challenging, meaningful problems and help them see the customer impact of their work.
  • Clear the path: Actively remove blockers so the team works efficiently with minimal friction.
  • Stay technical: Keep a strong understanding of your team’s systems so you can guide architecture decisions and unblock engineers directly. Champion operational excellence, including observability, CI/CD health, and production readiness.
  • Drive AI-first development: Evaluate, adopt, and set standards for AI-assisted coding, code review, and testing tools.
  • Shape the bigger picture: Contribute to engineering leadership discussions, decisions, and process evolution; partner with product and design leads on priorities and long-term vision; and help hiring teams identify, recruit, and onboard top engineering talent.

Requirements

What we're looking for:

  • 2-4 years of engineering management or technical leadership experience, and prior experience as a software engineer, ideally in SaaS.
  • A builder’s mindset: you still enjoy writing code and will regularly contribute fixes, features, and triage work that isn’t mission-critical.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-first development (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, agentic workflows) and a point of view on best practices you can teach others.
  • This role requires working Eastern Time hours to join daily team meetings, so candidates should be based in or able to work on Eastern Time.
  • A proven ability to coach and grow engineers at every career stage, with strong, empathetic, and clear communication.
  • Experience improving engineering processes and development workflows, plus familiarity with agile practices and cross-functional collaboration.
  • The ability to think strategically while attending to the details of day-to-day execution.
  • A passion for building inclusive, psychologically safe teams that value continuous learning and an excellent developer experience.
  • Enthusiasm for FMX’s mission and alignment with our core pillars: Teamwork, Excellence, and Integrity.

Nice to Have:

  • Native mobile experience (Swift or Kotlin)
  • Cloud infrastructure experience (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
  • Infrastructure as code with Terraform
  • Containerization with Docker
  • CI/CD pipeline design and maintenance
  • Observability (logging, metrics, traces, and alerting) or SIEM experience

Our Tech Stack:

  • .NET / C#
  • React and TypeScript
  • React Native
  • Azure

The Hiring Process:

  • 1. Apply! Submit your resume and brief application questions directly through our Workable portal to get started.
  • 2. PeopleOps Phone Screen (30 min) A introductory conversation to dive into your background, introduce you to FMX culture, and clarify core role expectations. This is also your chance to ask about compensation, benefits, and life at FMX.
  • 3. Hiring Manager Conversation (60 min) An in-depth chat with our Chief Technology Officer (CTO). Come ready to discuss your experience, career goals, and ideal next steps, as well as to ask detailed questions about team dynamics and role expectations.
  • 4. Final Interview (60 min) A panel and peer interview designed to introduce you to key team members and explore technical alignment and collaborative fit.
  • 5. Offer & Onboarding Once an offer is extended, we’ll initiate a standard background check to complete your onboarding process.

Benefits

FMX Benefits & Life at FMX:

  • Make a big impact: You’ll have significant influence over the direction and future of our engineering teams, flagship product and company. We are scaling rapidly and there is a lot of room for advancement.
  • Enjoy a collaborative culture and a close-knit team: We're a team of hard-working, high-fiving, friendly folks. We take collaboration, transparency, continuous improvement, and work/life balance seriously.
  • Get to hire and work with the best: We believe in building high-quality, well-designed products and that requires the best talent. You’ll have the opportunity to work with and grow a highly-talented team.
  • Learn and grow in your role and outside it: At FMX, we’re committed to improving our professional and personal selves. We bring in industry-experts as our advisors, provide leadership training, invest in team-building activities, and have a training budget and incentive program. Our Engineering team also dedicates 10% of their time to learning or working on projects that interest them.
  • Enjoy flexible working hours: Have a dentist appointment at 8:30 AM? Need to tack on an extra 15 minutes at lunch to squeeze in that workout? As long as you're getting your work done then our working hours are flexible.
  • Work from home: At FMX we are remote first, but you’re welcome to use our office as you need. We have two all-company events a year to ensure that you can put a face to that name and establish high-trust relationships with your teammates and co-workers. When you’re in the office, you can take advantage of our free snacks, beverages, and office kegerator.

Company:

While FMX is formally founded and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, on the day-to-day, we like to think of ourselves as headquartered “in the cloud”. We develop a cloud-based, software-as-a-service facility maintenance and management product. JOB SUMMARY

We are looking for an experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Developer to join our team, with strong, hands-on expertise across the Sales and Field Service modules. This role is for someone who has genuinely built solutions from the ground up — architecting, coding, and deploying customizations independently — rather than someone whose experience is limited to supporting or modifying existing implementations. You will be responsible for designing and developing plugins, custom controls, integrations, and data migration solutions that power mission-critical Sales and Field Service processes for our clients.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, develop, and deploy custom plugins and custom actions within Dynamics 365 CE, including building and packaging Plugin Packages with dependent assemblies and third-party DLLs (e.g., Newtonsoft.Json, ILMerge).

  • Build integrations using Plugin Service Endpoints, including Azure Service Bus and Webhook-based integration patterns, as well as Power Automate and ground-up Azure-based integrations (incoming and outgoing).
  • Develop, test, and deploy PowerApps Component Framework (PCF) controls, including manifest configuration, local debugging via NPM, and deployment/authentication through the PAC CLI (pac pcf push, pac auth create).

  • Configure, customize, and extend the Sales module (Leads, Opportunities, Quotes, Orders, Sales Pipelines, Forecasting) and Field Service module (Work Orders, Scheduling & Resource Management, Inventory, Asset Management).
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps, manage Artifacts, handle environment-specific values (Client IDs, Secrets), and manage Connection References across deployments.
  • Partner with functional consultants, solution architects, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable, well-documented technical solutions.
  • Participate in technical screening and code reviews to help validate the quality and originality of development work across the team.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Proven, ground-up (build-from-scratch) hands-on development experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE — not limited to support, break-fix, or modification of existing solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with the Sales module and the Field Service module is required.
  • Strong command of C#, .NET, JavaScript, and the Dataverse/Dynamics 365 SDK.
  • Plugin / Custom Action Development.
  • Integration (Plugins, Power Automate, Azure-based).

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Solution Deployment / CI-CD (Azure DevOps).
  • Data Migration (SSIS / KingswaySoft).
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot CLI or Claude Code.
  • Experience building AI agents or automation bots.
  • Relevant Microsoft certifications (e.g., PL-400, MB-210, MB-240).

jobs.title: Professional Services - Canada
jobs.excerpt: Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data.
jobs.description:
Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

About the Role

Our customers with the most demanding deployments subscribe to Advanced Services. These are the enterprises where Solace is carrying something the business cannot do without, and where an outage is a business event rather than a support ticket. They pay for a higher standard of service, and the Service Owner is accountable.

You carry a portfolio of these customers and you own their experience of Solace: how well we understand their environment, how quickly problems get found, how clearly we explain what we are doing about them, and whether the platform keeps up with where their business is heading. This is a continuous relationship rather than a project, and it does not get handed off at the end of a phase. It is yours.

What You’ll Do

Own the customer relationship

  • Be the named technical contact for a portfolio of Advanced Services customers, and the person inside Solace who understands their environment best
  • Build the kind of relationship where their architects call you before they make a decision rather than after
  • Report on service quality and the health of their estate in a way both their engineers and their leadership can act on
  • Advise them on where the Solace platform is going and which parts of it are worth their attention
  • Maintain ownership of all open support tickets for your accounts, ensuring they are progressed, accurately documented, and closed promptly
  • Produce and deliver service status reports for every customer with different levels of detail and frequencies

Own the quality of the service

  • Keep your customers' environments under active watch so that problems are found by us and not reported by them
  • Take issues end to end: triage, resolution, documentation and follow-up, including the ones nobody else wants to pick up
  • Pull in Support, Engineering and the account team when an issue needs them, and stay accountable for the outcome until it is closed
  • Hold the line on the standard. If the service is falling short for one of your customers, you should be the first to know it and the first to say so

Get new customers to steady state

  • Lead onboarding for new Advanced Services customers and bring them to a stable, well-understood steady state
  • Keep onboarding on schedule and raise blockers early instead of letting a date slide quietly
  • Keep adjusting after go-live until the service fits how the customer actually operates

Keep customers ahead of their own growth

  • Watch capacity and growth trends and flag what is needed well before it becomes urgent
  • Keep deployments on supported, current versions and coordinate upgrades with as little disruption as possible
  • Track advisories and known issues, and tell each customer what, if anything, it means for them

Make the practice better

  • Improve the playbooks you work from, so the next customer and the next Service Owner both benefit
  • Feed product gaps, architecture problems and customer education needs back to Product, Account and Customer Success
  • teams
  • Give the account team the technical credibility they need at renewal, and speak up where a customer would genuinely benefit from more Solace. Growth here comes from running the service well and being straight about what you see, not from a pitch
  • Use and contribute to the team's operational tooling (Example, Python-based CLIs for monitoring management) to streamline day-to-day service delivery tasks

Location and travel

  • This role can be based anywhere in Canada, the United States or Mexico, and the work is mostly remote
  • Travel is light but not zero. Expect a handful of customer visits a year for onboarding, service reviews, and the situations where being in the room is worth more than being on the call

About You

  • You take ownership. You treat the customer's environment as yours to look after, and you follow up on things without being chased
  • You want to know why. Restarting the broker is not a root cause, and you are not satisfied until you can explain what actually happened
  • You can write and you can present. A report a director will read, and a troubleshooting call with their engineers, are both well within range
  • You work well without scaffolding. Several customer relationships at once, no two days the same, and nobody planning your week for you

What You’ll Bring to the Role

Required

  • 5+ years in professional services, technical consulting, managed services or enterprise infrastructure operations, in a customer facing role
  • Hands-on experience with event-driven architecture, messaging middleware or distributed systems (Solace, Kafka, IBM MQ,TIBCO, RabbitMQ or similar)
  • Strong troubleshooting instincts across the application, middleware, network and cloud layers, plus the discipline to write down what you found
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tooling
  • Scripting and automation ability, Python preferred
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes, containerized deployments and at least one of AWS, Azure or GCP
  • Excellent written and verbal communication with both technical and business audiences
  • Highly organized and self-directed, comfortable running several customer relationships at the same time

Preferred

  • Direct Solace Platform experience in any form factor: Solace Cloud, software broker or appliance
  • Familiarity with MQTT, AMQP, JMS, REST and SMF
  • Background in managed services, SRE or a NOC, somewhere you were close to the customer rather than behind a queue
  • ITIL or a similar service management framework
  • Data center and hardware appliance experience
  • Hands-on experience with Datadog or an equivalent enterprise observability platform (dashboards, alerting, monitors, notebooks), Datadog specifically is a strong advantage
  • Spanish or French, which comes in handy across our Americas customer base

What Success Looks Like

In 3 Months

  • You know your customers' environments, teams and priorities in detail
  • They treat you as their contact at Solace, and reach out to you first
  • Your reporting goes out reliably and says something worth reading

In 6 Months

  • Problems are getting found and addressed before your customers notice them
  • You run onboarding for new customers and land it on schedule
  • Support, Customer Success and Sales treat you as the authority on your accounts

In 12 Months

  • Service quality across your portfolio is consistent, and does not depend on heroics
  • Capacity and upgrade planning happens well ahead of need rather than in reaction to it
  • Your customers renew and expand because they can point at what the service did for them

Why You’ll Love Working at Solace

At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

  • Work with brilliance – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.
  • Balance matters – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around.
  • Hybrid-first – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered.
  • Values-driven – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience.
  • Growth mindset – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast.
  • Customer Obsessed – We’re proud of our world-class customer lineup (we’re not shy about it).
  • Keep it fun – We’re social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time.
  • Creative culture – We’ve got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like MITT and this (check them out!).

At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.
To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills.

Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening—including interviews and final hiring—are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions.

Let’s Talk

Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay — we’re more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we’re here to support you.

Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only those selected to move forward will be contacted.

At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us!

As the Information Security Manager, you will lead the strategic development and oversight of our organization’s cybersecurity program within a fast-paced software development environment. You will bridge the gap between technical engineering teams and executive leadership, translating complex security threats into actionable business risk assessments. This role is pivotal in maintaining our competitive edge by ensuring that security is a core component of our brand and customer trust.

Key Areas of Responsibility:

  • Security Program Leadership: Design and manage the enterprise-wide information security strategy, aligning security initiatives with software development lifecycles (SDLC) and business goals.
  • Risk Management & Governance: Lead comprehensive risk assessments and vendor security reviews to identify and mitigate vulnerabilities across third-party integrations and internal systems.
  • DevSecOps Integration: Collaborate with engineering leads to integrate security automation (SAST/DAST) into CI/CD pipelines, promoting a "shift-left" security culture.
  • Incident Response Management: Oversee the security incident response program, acting as the primary point of escalation and lead investigator during high-priority security events.
  • Regulatory & Compliance Oversight: Ensure continuous compliance with industry-standard frameworks such as SOC2, ISO 27001, and GDPR, managing external audits and certification processes.
  • Security Awareness & Culture: Develop and lead security training programs for non-technical staff and specialized secure-coding workshops for developers.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Present regular security posture reports to senior management and board members, providing data-driven recommendations for security investments.

Objectives:

  • Maintain the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of our SaaS platforms and customer data environments.
  • Minimize organizational risk by implementing robust security controls across the software development and deployment processes.
  • Achieve and maintain industry-leading security certifications (e.g., SOC2 Type II, ISO 27001, NIST) along with compliance with our parent company’s policies
  • Foster a proactive security-first mindset across all departments through education and transparent reporting.

Skills:

  • Strategic Leadership: Ability to lead technical teams and influence organizational change without direct authority.

jobs.excerpt: Senior Security EngineerReports To: Director of EngineeringSummaryAxisCare is hiring a full-time, fully remote Senior Security Engineer to own security and compliance across our SaaS platform, the market-leading product powering the home care industry.
jobs.description:
Senior Security Engineer

Reports To: Director of Engineering

Summary

AxisCare is hiring a full-time, fully remote Senior Security Engineer to own security and compliance across our SaaS platform, the market-leading product powering the home care industry.

This is not a job where you'll write policies that nobody reads. You'll work directly with product engineering teams, embedded in how we build software, shaping our security posture. You'll own engineering's side of our SOC 2 Type II compliance program, lead us toward HITRUST certification, and keep our AWS infrastructure, Docker pipelines, and PHP/React codebase hardened as we move fast.

We're also building AI-powered products on top of Amazon Bedrock and our own machine learning models, and we use AI heavily in how we develop software. That creates new kinds of risk that most security playbooks don't cover yet. We need someone who's thinking about this already and building the guardrails that agents need to write secure software.

Home care agencies trust us to run their business every day. Their data includes protected health information. We need someone who takes that personally.

What You'll Do

Own AxisCare Engineering's security program as an individual contributor. Continually improve our security standards as threats evolve, strengthen the systems that enforce them, and work directly with engineers to close gaps.

Own engineering's share of SOC 2 Type II compliance: control design, evidence collection, audit prep, and gap remediation. Chart the path toward HITRUST certification, mapping what we already have and building what we don't.

Threat-model our application and infrastructure. We run a PHP/React modular monolith on AWS, managed with Terraform, deployed in Docker containers, backed by MySQL in RDS. Raise the bar on this stack's security (IAM policies, VPC design, secrets management, container security, database access controls) and keep raising it as the architecture evolves.

Own and improve our security scanning program. Tune findings, cut false positives, and make sure scan results turn into developer action.

Assess and mitigate the security risks inherent in our AI products: prompt injection, data leakage, model output filtering, abuse scenarios. Set guardrails for AI-assisted development workflows so the team ships faster without opening new attack surface.

Strengthen our detection and response capabilities: logging, alerting, incident response playbooks. Coordinate penetration tests, track findings, and drive remediation.

Keep our security policies clear, current, and short. Train developers on secure practices without burying them in process.

What We're Looking For

A builder, not just an auditor. You've built or run a security program inside a product company, not just assessed one from the outside. You can point to systems, controls, and habits you put in place that made a real difference.

A technical peer to engineers. You read code, read Terraform, and talk to developers in their language. When you flag a vulnerability, you can explain the fix, not just the finding.

A pragmatist. You understand that we need to ship. You weigh tradeoffs, probability, and impact, not by saying no to everything.

A strong writer. Remote work demands it, and clear writing is clear thinking. You'll write policies, incident reports, audit narratives, and messages to engineers explaining why something matters. Clarity counts.

An AI-aware security thinker. You're already wrestling with what AI means for security: new attack surfaces, new tooling, new ways that development workflows create risk.

Experience required:

  • 5+ years in application security, infrastructure security, or security engineering at a SaaS company
  • Hands-on experience with AWS security (IAM, VPC, Security Groups, KMS, CloudTrail, GuardDuty)
  • Experience owning or heavily contributing to the engineering side of SOC 2 Type II compliance
  • Familiarity with container security (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform)
  • Solid grasp of web application security fundamentals (OWASP Top 10, secure SDLC)
  • Experience securing AI/ML systems or LLM-powered products
  • Concrete examples of how you've used AI to improve your own security work: automating compliance tasks, speeding up threat analysis, building detection rules faster, or something we haven't thought of
  • Able to work remotely from the Eastern, Central, or Mountain time zones
  • Qualified to work in the United States or Canada

What We'd Be Excited to Find

  • Experience building or maintaining HIPAA-compliant or HITRUST-certified environments
  • CISSP, OSCP, or AWS Security Specialty certification
  • Background in penetration testing or red team work

Working Conditions

  • Manual dexterity required to use desktop computer and peripherals.

Compensation and Equipment

  • Salary (TBD based on job experience and skill level)
  • Medical insurance is covered in full for the employee (Medical, Dental, and Vision)
  • Company will provide laptop and other needed computer equipment

How to Apply

Apply with a brief resume and either a written or video cover letter.

We review the cover letter before anything else in your application, so this really matters. This is your single biggest opportunity to improve your chances, and video submissions go right to the front of the line.

Prompt: How has AI changed the security landscape you work in: what's gotten easier, what's gotten harder, and how have you adapted? Tell us about a security program, control, or hard problem you're proud of owning. Tell us why this position is the one you've been hoping to find.

Written: No more than 600 words. We're looking for clarity of thought and strong communication. Use AI if you want, but don't send slop.

Build the platform that makes AI customer conversations accountable

Are you a Staff or Principal-level engineer who thrives on building complex systems from the ground up?

We're looking for a Founding Platform Engineer to help architect and build the core platform of an early-stage AI startup tackling one of the biggest emerging challenges in enterprise technology: ensuring AI-powered customer interactions are safe, compliant, reliable, and accountable.

As the first senior engineer, you'll work directly with the CTO, take ownership of the platform's architecture, and write production code while establishing the engineering foundations for future growth.

This is an opportunity to shape both the technology and the engineering culture of a company from its earliest stages.

The opportunity

Enterprises are deploying AI agents to handle customer conversations across voice, chat, email, and SMS. But as these systems take on increasingly sensitive interactions, businesses need more than capable AI — they need independent oversight, measurable quality and reliable evidence that their AI systems meet the standards required of them.

The company is building an AI monitoring and assurance platform that evaluates customer interactions against applicable regulations and business requirements, helping enterprises identify issues early, reduce risk, and demonstrate accountability.

You'll help build the infrastructure that makes this possible, from high-volume conversation processing to enterprise-grade auditability and security.

What you'll own

Core platform architecture

  • Design and build the backend systems that power a scalable, multi-tenant SaaS platform.
  • Establish robust APIs, data models, and distributed processing architecture.
  • Make key technical decisions that will shape the platform as the company grows.

Conversation pipelines and integrations

  • Build pipelines that transform raw conversations into structured, enriched, and scorable data.
  • Develop integrations with contact-centre platforms, ticketing systems and direct-upload workflows.
  • Help evolve the voice-processing architecture, including transcription and audio ingestion.

Auditability and data provenance

  • Implement immutable versioning for scoring rubrics and configurations.
  • Build tamper-evident audit trails and preserve evidence throughout the conversation lifecycle.
  • Ensure historical results can be reproduced and explained, including why a particular interaction received its original score.

Infrastructure and engineering excellence

  • Own infrastructure as code, CI/CD, environment management and deployment workflows.
  • Establish observability, logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, secrets management and disaster recovery.
  • Take responsibility for production reliability, incident response and operational readiness.

Scale, performance and reliability

  • Build reliable data storage, retention and queueing systems.
  • Implement idempotent processing and reprocessing to prevent duplicate work and unnecessary AI inference costs.
  • Define service-level objectives and help scale the platform from early pilots to millions of interactions per month.

Security and enterprise readiness

  • Build tenant isolation, permissions, customer-specific configuration, and entitlements into the platform.
  • Implement sensitive-data handling and redaction before conversations reach AI models.
  • Support evidence exports, SOC 2 readiness, and enterprise security reviews.

What we're looking for

  • Senior engineering ownership: You've operated at Staff, Principal or equivalent scope, owning critical production systems and setting technical direction for other engineers.
  • Strong backend and distributed-systems expertise: You understand high-volume data processing, event-driven architectures, API design and data modelling.
  • Hands-on infrastructure experience: You've built infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability capabilities yourself, rather than relying entirely on a dedicated platform team.
  • Early-stage startup experience: You've shipped products in an early-stage or high-growth environment where ambiguity, broad ownership and limited support functions were part of everyday life. This is essential.
  • Strong Python skills: You're comfortable building production-grade backend systems and have enough TypeScript and React experience to contribute to the product portal when needed.
  • ML systems fluency: You can discuss model evaluation, deployment, monitoring, accuracy, latency, and inference costs with an ML Lead. Research experience is not required.
  • Enterprise SaaS experience: You understand multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, access controls, and customer-specific entitlements.
  • A pragmatic approach to AI-assisted development: You're comfortable using coding agents, including Claude Code, while maintaining high standards for code quality, testing, security, and maintainability.

Bonus points

Experience in any of the following would be particularly valuable:

  • Auditability, data provenance or compliance-grade systems.
  • Speech and audio processing, including ASR, diarisation, streaming transcription or real-time systems.
  • Contact-centre technology, CCaaS, quality assurance or workforce optimisation.
  • Governance, risk and compliance (GRC) platforms or regulated enterprise environments.

Why consider this opportunity?

  • Founding-level impact: Work directly with the CTO and influence the platform's architecture from day one.
  • Real technical ownership: Build the systems, infrastructure, and engineering practices rather than inheriting established processes.
  • A meaningful problem to solve: Help enterprises adopt AI customer support with greater confidence, transparency, and accountability.
  • Broad engineering scope: Work across backend systems, cloud infrastructure, data pipelines, security, and product-facing functionality.
  • Room to shape the team: Establish the technical standards and foundations that future engineers will build upon.

Interested?

If you're a hands-on technical leader who enjoys solving difficult platform problems, building from first principles and taking ownership beyond the code, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or get in touch for a confidential conversation about the opportunity.

The developer will work closely with the React Lead, UX/UI designers, QA, DevOps, and backend teams to deliver modern web applications aligned with enterprise architecture and business requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1. Frontend Development

  • Develop responsive, interactive, and accessible web pages using React.js and Next.js.
  • Implement server-side rendering (SSR), static site generation (SSG), and incremental static regeneration (ISR) as required.
  • Build reusable components, custom hooks, and libraries.
  • Ensure cross-browser compatibility and mobile responsiveness.

2. Next.js Framework Implementation

  • Utilize Next.js features effectively:
    • getServerSideProps, getStaticProps, getStaticPaths
    • API routes and middleware
    • Dynamic routing, layouts, and nested routes
  • Optimize hydration, lazy-loading, and client/server data fetching.
  • Implement efficient caching and prefetching strategies for faster UX.

3. State Management & Data Handling

  • Manage application state using Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Recoil, or Context API + Hooks.
  • Integrate with REST or GraphQL APIs from BFF/backend layers.
  • Handle errors, loading states, and fallback UI for smoother user experiences.

4. UI/UX & Design System Integration

  • Work with designers to implement pixel-perfect UIs aligned with the enterprise design system.
  • Integrate components from Storybook or other design libraries.
  • Implement accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) and responsive design best practices.

5. Performance Optimization

  • Monitor and optimize Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID, CLS).
  • Reduce bundle size using code splitting, lazy loading, and tree shaking.
  • Optimize rendering performance and memory usage.

6. Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Write unit and integration tests using:
    • Jest
    • React Testing Library
  • Support end-to-end testing with Cypress or Playwright.
  • Participate in code reviews and maintain high-quality, maintainable code.

7. Security & Best Practices

  • Implement secure coding practices (input validation, XSS prevention, secure storage of tokens).
  • Follow best practices for API integration, routing, and data handling.
  • Collaborate with security teams to comply with enterprise security policies.

8. Collaboration & Agile Practices

  • Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate closely with React Lead, QA, DevOps, backend/BFF developers, and product teams.
  • Communicate technical challenges and propose solutions clearly.

Technical Skills

  • 5+ years experience in frontend development.
  • Strong expertise in:
    • React.js (Hooks, Context, Custom Hooks)
    • Next.js (SSR, SSG, ISR, Routing, API routes)
    • TypeScript
    • HTML5, CSS3, Sass, Styled Components, Tailwind CSS
  • Experience with:
    • State management (Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Recoil)
    • RESTful APIs / GraphQL
    • Performance optimization and debugging
    • Unit & integration testing frameworks (Jest, RTL)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern build tools (Webpack, Vite).

Soft Skills

  • Problem-solving mindset and ability to debug complex issues.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.
  • Ability to work in Agile/Scrum teams.
  • Detail-oriented with focus on high-quality, maintainable code.

Education & Background

  • Portfolio of web applications using React and Next.js preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant, Digital Experience Optimization
jobs.excerpt: Ready to Make Your Mark?  As a Senior Consultant at BlastX, you help clients solve the challenges that stand between customer insight and a better digital experience.
jobs.description:
Ready to Make Your Mark?

As a Senior Consultant at BlastX, you help clients solve the challenges that stand between customer insight and a better digital experience. You combine the strategic judgment to uncover friction, prioritize opportunities, and design an experimentation roadmap with the hands-on development skills to build, launch, troubleshoot, and measure sophisticated A/B tests and personalization campaigns.

In this client-facing role, you own optimization from discovery through activation: interpreting quantitative and qualitative insights, shaping test hypotheses, developing experiences with modern web technologies, ensuring technical quality, and translating results into actionable recommendations. You activate audiences, behavioral signals, and MarTech investments to deliver relevant customer experiences and measurable business outcomes. You have an opportunity to Make Your Mark every day on our clients, teammates, company, industry, and community.

Primary Responsibilities
  • Partner directly with client stakeholders to understand business objectives, diagnose digital experience challenges, and advise on optimization and personalization strategy.
  • Analyze web analytics, conversion funnels, customer feedback, heatmaps, session recordings, and user research to identify friction and prioritize high-impact opportunities.
  • Develop test hypotheses, experimentation roadmaps, audience strategies, success metrics, and measurement plans grounded in client goals.
  • Personally design, code, configure, and launch A/B/n, multivariate, multi-page, and personalization experiences using JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and leading optimization platforms.
  • Own technical implementation and troubleshooting of client-side experiments, including targeting, audience activation, integrations, and cross-browser/device quality assurance.
  • Work with client developers and cross-functional consultants to implement complex experiences across responsive websites, single-page applications, and mobile environments.
  • Interpret experiment results using sound statistical principles; communicate findings, limitations, and next-step recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Translate research and test ideas into clear requirements, wireframes or mockups as needed, and practical execution plans.
  • Apply audience and behavioral data, including CDP-enabled segments where available, to deliver relevant personalized experiences and measure their impact.
  • Lead client working sessions, present recommendations, train client teams, and strengthen ongoing partnerships through reliable delivery and consultative guidance.
  • Identify opportunities to improve experimentation processes, technical quality, program maturity, and the return on clients’ MarTech investments.
  • Stay current with emerging optimization platforms, privacy requirements, AI/ML capabilities, and modern development practices; contribute to team learning and client growth.

Desired Knowledge, Skills, & Qualifications
  • 6+ years of relevant experience in digital experience optimization, experimentation, front-end development, or consulting, with demonstrated ownership of both strategy and execution.
  • Deep hands-on experience building and troubleshooting A/B tests and personalization campaigns in Adobe Target (strongly preferred); Optimizely or comparable platforms also valuable.
  • Advanced proficiency in vanilla JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, DOM manipulation, and jQuery; ability to write production-quality code independently.
  • Amplitude experience is highly desirable.
  • Experience with React or other single-page application frameworks strongly preferred; familiarity with server-side testing is a plus.
  • Proven ability to turn customer and behavioral insights into test hypotheses, prioritization, experimentation plans, and measurable optimization outcomes.
  • Experience with conversion rate optimization, audience segmentation, personalization, and A/B/n or multivariate experimentation methodologies.
  • Comfort interpreting web analytics, qualitative research, and statistical test results to make sound recommendations.
  • Experience with cross-device and cross-browser QA, debugging, privacy constraints, and performance considerations.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts and business implications clearly to client stakeholders and collaborate with designers, analysts, and developers.
  • Experience using customer data platforms for audience activation, mobile experimentation, and Adobe Target/Optimizely certifications are advantageous.
  • Ability to manage multiple client engagements, work independently, and deliver high-quality solutions in a fast-paced consulting environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline preferred; equivalent practical experience welcomed.

To Be Successful
Success in this role requires curiosity about customer behavior, rigorous technical craftsmanship, and the confidence to guide clients from problem definition to measurable results.
  • Balances big-picture strategic thinking with close attention to implementation details.
  • Owns outcomes end to end rather than handing off strategy or development to someone else.
  • Approaches ambiguous client challenges with analytical rigor, creativity, and practical problem-solving.
  • Builds trusted relationships through clear communication, collaboration, accountability, and responsiveness.
  • Explains complex technical and statistical concepts in accessible, business-relevant terms.
  • Learns continuously, welcomes feedback, and helps teammates grow.
  • Demonstrates a Make Your Mark mindset through thoughtful, customized solutions and consistently high-quality delivery.

This is a full-time remote opportunity. Travel up to 5% for business purposes, determined by client requests or industry events.

Who We Are
BlastX Consulting provides strategic, digital experience advice and implementation services to help brands drive deeper customer relationships using data-driven insights to optimize the digital experience. Over the past 25 years we have assembled a seasoned team of consultants with deep expertise and experience across a wide array of strategic, technical, and operational disciplines who share a passion for helping brands be customer-centric, creating strategies to enable the ultimate experience across touchpoints.

BlastX Consulting embraces and holds to a set of Core Values and encourages each member of the team to continually find ways to “Make Your Mark” for clients, teammates, the community, the industry, and the company. We are an Inc. magazine top 5000 fastest-growing private company and is also a Great Place to Work-Certified company.

Why Work at BlastX Consulting
We believe in meaningful work. Regardless of role, you'll have the opportunity to Make Your Mark every day, solving challenges and seeing the positive impact of your contributions, as we support leaders to EVOLVE their organizations. Join us to Make Your Mark — on each other, our clients, our company, our industry, and the community. Ask any employee why they come to work here, and they'll say, "to make my mark!" We BELIEVE BlastX Consulting is a Great Place to Work! We are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work since 2019.

Who You Will Work With
Client Service Leads, Cross-functional Consultants, Project Delivery Managers, and other subject matter experts.

Compensation & Benefits
Salary Range: $111,538.00 - $165,000.00 USD annually DOE

We offer a competitive salary based on experience and a supportive, challenging, and fun work environment to ensure teamwork, productivity, and teammate happiness. We offer a flexible PTO policy, 60% employer paid medical insurance coverage options, 100% employer paid dental and vision insurance, 401k 4% company matching, profit sharing, education assistance, paid parental leave, performance-based salary increases, and year-end incentive bonuses.

We are not interested in placement agencies or companies at this time. BlastX Consulting is an “at-will” employer. Compensation, benefits, and job descriptions are subject to change based on individual performance and business conditions. BlastX Consulting is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO).

jobs.excerpt: VERSIONE ITALIANA CDP Venture Capital – insieme a Mutti, Sipcam Oxon, Crédit Agricole Italia e GELLIFY – lancia Novagria Ventures, il nuovo venture builder dedicato alla filiera agroalimentare italiana.
jobs.description:
VERSIONE ITALIANA

CDP Venture Capital – insieme a Mutti, Sipcam Oxon, Crédit Agricole Italia e GELLIFY – lancia Novagria Ventures, il nuovo venture builder dedicato alla filiera agroalimentare italiana.

🎯 Obiettivo:creare fino a 6 nuove startup in 3 anni, mobilitando oltre 45 milioni di euro di investimenti complessivi per colmare i gap di digitalizzazione e sostenibilità della filiera.

🚀Il ruolo: Entrepreneur in Residence (EIR) —Future CTO

Cerchiamo builder tecnologici pronti a diventare CTO & co-founder di una delle prossime startup che nasceranno dentro Novagria Ventures.

Come EIR sarai il motore tech della futura venture.
Partirai da una value proposition già pre-validata dal team GELLIFY e avrai la responsabilità di:

Product & Tech Ownership

  • Disegnare l’architettura della soluzione (anche no-code/low-code nelle fasi iniziali)
  • Coordinare lo sviluppo dell’MVP con designer e developer
  • Validare use case, feature, prototipi e metriche
  • Guidare la tech roadmap verso product-market fit

Market Validation & Growth

  • Testare MVP e iterare rapidamente sul prodotto
  • Supportare go-to-market, acquisire early users e sviluppare primi PoC
  • Identificare le metriche chiave per PMF

Fundraising & Leadership

  • Contribuire alla preparazione del round seed
  • Presentare la soluzione a investitori e partner
  • Costruire il futuro team tech (engineering, data, AI)

Obiettivo finale: diventare CTO & co-founder della startup dopo lo spin-off.

💡Chi cerchiamo

Un/una imprenditore·trice con anima da builder e forte competenza tecnologica.

Must have

  • 5–10 anni in: Product, Engineering, Tech Leadership, Startup, Venture Building
  • Provata esperienza con:
    • Architetture Full stack: sviluppo end-to-end di applicazioni web (frontend + backend + DB + deploy) su stack tecnologico React/Node.js con almeno un prodotto portato in produzione.
    • Architetture cloud: progettazione e sviluppo di sistemi scalabili, affidabili e sicuri da ambienti Cloud (microservizi / API-first).
    • Data & integrazione: progettazione di basi dati (SQL + NoSQL), data pipeline di base, integrazione via API.
    • Security & privacy: principi di sicurezza applicativa, gestione identità e accessi.
    • DevOps / Delivery: CI/CD, containerizzazione (es. Docker), monitoring, logging.
  • Esperienza pratica con MVP digitali, prototipazione e validazione rapida
  • Ottima capacità di tradurre problemi complessi in soluzioni scalabili
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, ownership, velocità, execution

Nice to have

  • Esperienza da founder o first-hire in startup early stage
  • Background in: AI/ML, SaaS, IoT, piattaforme B2B, cloud architecture
  • Interesse per agritech, foodtech, supply chain, sustainability

💰 Cosa offriamo

  • Retribuzione durante il periodo di lavoro all’interno di Novagria
  • Equity nella startup che sarà scorporata
  • Lavoro full-remote
  • Opportunità concreta di diventare CTO e co-founder di una startup backed da corporate top-tier

🌍Perché unirti a Novagria Ventures

  • Costruisci startup con un impatto reale sulla filiera agroalimentare italiana grazie al supporto dei partner CDP Venture Capital, GELLIFY, Mutti, Sipcam Oxon e Crédit Agricole Italia
  • Lavori in Le Village by CA Parma, cuore dell’innovazione agri-food
  • Impari un metodo di venture building replicabile e scalabile
  • Cresci come imprenditore, con supporto finanziario, operativo e strategico

🎬Come candidarti

Crediamo che i futuri founder si riconoscano dal modo in cui pensano.

Oltre al CV / LinkedIn, inviaci un breve video Loom (max 1 minuto) in cui racconti:

  • Quali problemi tech ti appassionano oggi e perché
  • Un prodotto o MVP che hai costruito o validato
  • Perché vuoi diventare CTO/co-founder con Novagria adesso

Il presente annuncio è rivolto ad entrambi i sessi, ai sensi delle leggi 903/77 e 125/91 e D.Lgs 198/2006

ENGLISH VERSION

CDP Venture Capital, Mutti, Sipcam Oxon, Crédit Agricole Italia and GELLIFY have just launched Novagria Ventures, the new venture builder dedicated to the Italian agrifood value chain.

🎯 Goal: build up to 6 new startups in 3 years, mobilizing over €45M in total investments to bridge the digitalization and sustainability gaps across the supply chain.

🚀 The Role: Entrepreneur in Residence (EIR) — Future CTO

We are looking for technology builders ready to become CTO & co-founder of one of the next startups created within Novagria Ventures.

As an EIR, you will be the tech engine of a future venture.
You will start from a value proposition already pre-validated by the GELLIFY team, and you will be responsible for:

Product & Tech Ownership

  • Design the solution architecture (including no-code/low-code approaches in early stages)
  • Coordinate MVP development with designers and developers
  • Validate use cases, features, prototypes, and metrics
  • Drive the tech roadmap toward product–market fit

Market Validation & Growth

  • Test the MVP and iterate rapidly on the product
  • Support go-to-market activities, onboard early users, and develop initial PoCs
  • Identify the key metrics required for PMF

Fundraising & Leadership

  • Contribute to the preparation of the seed round
  • Present the solution to investors and strategic partners
  • Build the future tech team (engineering, data, AI)

🎯 Ultimate goal: become CTO & co-founder of the startup after the spin-off.

💡 Who We’re Looking For

An entrepreneurial builder with strong technological expertise.

Must Have

5–10 years of experience in Product, Engineering, Tech Leadership, Startup or Venture Building roles.

Proven experience with:

  • Full-Stack Architectures: end-to-end development of web applications (frontend + backend + DB + deployment) using React/Node.js, with at least one product shipped to production.
  • Cloud Architectures: designing and developing scalable, reliable, and secure cloud-based systems (microservices / API-first).
  • Data & Integration: SQL + NoSQL database design, basic data pipelines, API integrations.
  • Security & Privacy: application security principles, identity and access management.
  • DevOps / Delivery: CI/CD, containerization (e.g., Docker), monitoring, logging.
  • Hands-on experience with MVPs, prototyping, and rapid validation
  • Excellent ability to translate complex problems into scalable solutions
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, ownership, speed, execution

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience as a founder or first-hire in an early-stage startup
  • Background in AI/ML, SaaS, IoT, B2B platforms, cloud architecture
  • Interest in agritech, foodtech, supply chain, sustainability

💰 What We Offer

  • Compensation during your residency within Novagria
  • Equity in the spin-off startup
  • Full-remote work option
  • A concrete opportunity to become CTO & co-founder of a startup backed by top-tier corporate players

🌍 Why Join Novagria Ventures

  • Build startups with real impact on the Italian agrifood supply chain, supported by CDP Venture Capital, GELLIFY, Mutti, Sipcam Oxon, and Crédit Agricole Italia
  • Work from Le Village by CA Parma, a leading hub for agrifood innovation
  • Learn a replicable, scalable venture-building method
  • Grow as an entrepreneur with strategic, operational, and financial support

🎬 How to Apply

We believe future founders reveal themselves through how they think.

Along with your CV / LinkedIn profile, send us a short Loom video (max 1 minute) explaining:

  • Which tech problems excite you today—and why
  • A product or MVP you built or validated
  • Why you want to become a CTO/co-founder with Novagria right now

This job advertisement is open to candidates of all genders, in accordance with Laws 903/77 and 125/91 and Legislative Decree 198/2006

jobs.excerpt: Alguna allows companies to optimise their revenue management by allowing them to set a unified pricing strategy, supporting complex pricing models, creating the most customizable quote options, enabling new revenue opportunities by proactively monitoring product usage and adoption, and forecasting revenue based on real-time insights.
jobs.description:
Alguna allows companies to optimise their revenue management by allowing them to set a unified pricing strategy, supporting complex pricing models, creating the most customizable quote options, enabling new revenue opportunities by proactively monitoring product usage and adoption, and forecasting revenue based on real-time insights.

📄 Who you are

  • You're a generalist who is willing to contribute across the stack, both frontend and backend

  • You have related production experience with any programming language

  • You're happy working on your own as well as collaborating within a team, understanding that we ultimately operate as a unit, not as individuals

  • Someone comfortable working in an ambiguous environment; we’re early-stage

🔑 What the job involves

  • Collaborating: We’re remote but highly collaborative in nature

  • Shipping value: We’re in the early stages of building the product, so we need to get features out there, get feedback, and iterate

  • Improving our internal developer experience: In order to allow us all to be efficient

  • Not just writing code: We write proposals to gather feedback on upcoming work and document our decisions

  • Being pragmatic: Given we’re still finding product-market fit, we will need to make tradeoffs with what we ship, and it’s not always going to be polished

🗼 Our stack

We use Typescript & Next.js and Golang for our platform. We deploy on Vercel and AWS. We use Axiom for observability and GitHub for CI and CD. We prefer always to buy tools rather than build, so we can focus our efforts on the things that differentiate us.

⏭️ Application process

  • A 45-minute intro call with one of the co-founders where we’ll talk about your experience, what we’re building, and what you’re looking for in your next role

  • A 60-minute call with some of your potential colleagues where we’ll discuss your background, dive deeper into your core abilities relevant to the role, and experience working with other cross-functional roles. If you have any example projects to show us at this point we’d love to see them

  • A 60-minute final call with the other co-founder and another colleague to chat about the company, goals, and answer any questions you may have

Assuming we are a mutual match, we’ll conduct reference checks to confirm what we learned about you throughout the interview process. Typically, we’d ask for a couple of managers or peers that you collaborated with in the recent past.

💗 Benefits

  • 📈 Meaningful equity: everyone who joins will have ownership in the success of Alguna

  • 🏖️ Paid time off: 33 days annual leave (including public holidays) - you may choose to take public holidays, or take these days at other times

  • 🏋️‍♀️ 🧑‍🎓 Wellbeing & learning budget: £1000/year to spend on anything that helps you grow - we trust you to know how to best spend this as you know your needs better than anyone else

  • 🏡 Home office setup: £250 towards your home office setup

  • 🌍 Location-specific benefits: pension, health insurance - to be discussed on case by case basis

jobs.description:
textilwerk

Als durch und durch digitales Lifestyle-Scale-up stehen wir aktuell an der Schwelle zur nächsten großen Wachstumsphase: der Entwicklung von einem erfolgreichen Online-Shop hin zu einer globalen Multichannel-Brand. Um diesen Weg erfolgreich zu gestalten, vergeben wir unsere IT nicht nach außen, sondern setzen auf eine starke Inhouse-Mentalität: Wir glauben zu 100% an unsere eigenen Ideen und die Innovationskraft unseres eigenen Teams!
Für diese Reise suchen wir ein entscheidendes Puzzleteil für unser Dev-Team: Einen technologisch versierten Kopf mit ausgeprägter Shopware-Expertise und echter Hands-on-Mentalität. Als Shopware Full Stack Backend Developer bist du das Herzstück unserer technologischen Weiterentwicklung. Deine Mission: Du gestaltest, optimierst und skalierst unser Backend-Setup, um ein nahtloses, hochperformantes Shopping-Erlebnis auf das nächste Level zu heben - vollständig remote und ortsunabhängig.
Gleichzeitig ist es uns ein echtes Anliegen, die Tech-Branche diverser zu gestalten. Wir möchten weibliche Tech-Talente ausdrücklich ermutigen, sich bei uns zu bewerben (Women in Tech) – bei uns im Team ist jede und jeder im Sinne echter Gleichberechtigung gleichermaßen herzlich willkommen!
Du hast Lust, die digitale Zukunft einer aufstrebenden Brand aktiv zu prägen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

deine aufgaben

  • Entwicklung unseres Shopware Backends: Du unterstützt uns in den Bereichen Plugin-Entwicklung, CLI-Scripts, API-Design und Stock-Handling. Du hilfst insbesondere bei der Performance-Optimierung von Cart und Order Processing und beim Ausbau unserer Vertriebskanäle.
  • Instandhaltung & Stabilisierung der Infrastruktur: Du führst regelmäßige Updates von Shopware und den Plugins durch, damit unser Onlineshop stets reibungslos läuft – insbesondere in der High Season. Zudem stellst du sicher, dass alle APIs zu DWH, Produktion, Versand oder CRM intakt sind und jederzeit auf die benötigten Daten zugreifen können. Du unterstützt die anderen Teams bei der Anbindung neuer Tools.
  • Optimierung & Skalierung: Du bist up-to-date im Shopware-Kosmos und hilfst uns, unseren Shop kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, sei es im Hinblick auf Plugins, neue AI-Features oder Developer Experience. Du erkennst, an welchen Stellen unser Headless-Setup von einer Überführung in den Shopware-Standard profitieren würde.
  • Technische Konzeption & Beratung: Als Teil des Dev-Teams berätst du die anderen Teams im Hinblick auf die technische Umsetzung der verschiedenen textilwerk-Projekte mit starkem Fokus auf Skalierbarkeit, Performance und das Shopping-Erlebnis für die Kund:innen.
  • Data, BI & KI: Du weißt, wie wichtig eine hohe Datenqualität für die Steuerung eines Unternehmens ist, und unterstützt die Teams Data, BI & KI bei der Optimierung und Erweiterung des Datenbestands durch z. B. neue Schnittstellen oder das Setup eines MCP-Servers.

dein profil

  • Relevante Berufserfahrung: Du hast mind. 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Betreuung von Shopware-Shops mit, idealerweise in einem D2C-Umfeld
  • Shopware 6 Skills: Ausgeprägte Kenntnisse im modernen Shopware 6 Ökosystem (App-System, Plugin-System, Rule Builder, Flow Builder, Administration). Idealerweise bringst du sogar eine Shopware-Backend-Zertifizierung mit und kennst dich sowohl mit Headless- als auch mit Standard-Shopware-Setups aus
  • Fullstack Skills: Idealerweise bringst du zudem Kenntnisse in Next.js, TypeScript und NestJS mit
  • Datenbanken & Suche im Enterprise-Scale: Fundiertes Wissen in MySQL/MariaDB sowie praktische Erfahrung mit Elasticsearch / OpenSearch zur Optimierung unseres Produktdatenhandlings
  • DevOps & CI/CD: Sicherer Umgang mit Git, Docker-basierten lokalen Entwicklungsumgebungen und Cloud-Diensten (AWS, Kubernetes)
  • Arbeitsweise & Remote-Competence: Du bist die strukturierte Arbeit in einem agilen, verteilten Remote-Umfeld gewohnt und offen dafür, bestehende Prozesse digital zu hinterfragen und zu optimieren. Du bist in der Lage, komplexe Projekte in MVPs zu übersetzen und diese stabil live zu bringen. Automatisierte Tests und der zielgerichtete Einsatz von KI gehören dabei selbstverständlich zu deiner Arbeitsweise.
  • Persönlichkeit: Du bringst ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, Selbstorganisation und ein Customer-First-Denken mit. Du magst die Flexibilität der E-Commerce-Branche und bringst im besten Fall eine Begeisterung für Design oder Textilien mit.

benefits

  • 100% Remote & Flexibilität: Maximale Freiheit für deinen Arbeitsort – arbeite vollständig aus dem Homeoffice innerhalb Deutschlands bei vollflexiblen Arbeitszeiten.
  • Work-Life-Balance: 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr für deine Erholung
  • Workation: 30 Tage pro Jahr ortsunabhängig aus dem Ausland arbeiten
  • Nettolohnoptimierung: 50 € monatlicher Sachbezugsgutschein über Become1
  • Mobilität & Rabatte: JobRad-Leasing sowie attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte auf unser gesamtes Sortiment
  • Kultur auf Augenhöhe: Starker Zusammenhalt auch im virtuellen Raum – kurze Entscheidungswege, flache Hierarchien und ein dynamisches Team, in dem es um Inhalte geht, nicht um Egos.

jobs.description:
About Greenlight Rent

Greenlight Rent, formerly Rhino + Jetty, is making housing more affordable and accessible for millions of renters each year. We're the market-leading rental housing platform building simpler, more accessible ways for people to move into homes — and for property managers to lease with confidence.

Our technology removes friction from the move-in process, lowers upfront costs for renters, and helps property managers make faster, more accurate decisions. We support a network of 3 million rental units nationwide and work with 47 of the NMHC Top 100 property owners, including Greystar, Brookfield, Asset Living, UDR, and more.

We pioneered security deposit insurance and continue to push the industry forward with a growing suite of products — from deposit management to lease guarantees and loss-of-employment protection. We're growing quickly, tackling real problems at scale, and building technology that's changing how renting works.

The role

Remote (Pakistan preferred) · Full-time

🧭 About the role

iClosed.io is a SaaS platform for sales and marketing teams, scaling to millions of users. This role sits in our Performance Team and owns the performance and scalability of our Node.js/TypeScript backend services and data layer.

We believe the biggest gains come from design, not just tuning: matching each store to its access pattern, moving work off the critical path, and drawing service boundaries that scale cleanly. You'll solve the problem in front of you, then shape the architecture so whole classes of problems never come up.

This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, high autonomy and significant technical influence.

🔀 How the work splits

You'll own performance across three connected areas, with genuine depth expected in both system design and data-layer internals:

  • Design: how a request flows, what runs synchronously, where state lives, and what happens when a dependency is slow.
  • Diagnosis: reading traces, execution plans and metrics to find the real cause rather than the obvious one.
  • Prevention: instrumentation, review standards and regression gates, so issues are caught long before they reach customers.

🎯 What you'll do

  • Lead the design of high-traffic flows end to end, keeping them fast under load and resilient when dependencies fail.
  • Diagnose latency across the full request path using traces, execution plans and metrics.
  • Match each workload to the right data store, and document the reasoning.
  • Scale reads and writes through caching, replicas, partitioning, sharding and queue-buffered writes.
  • Build reliable background processing on SQS and EventBridge with idempotency, retries, dead letters and backpressure.
  • Eliminate N+1 queries and chatty data access, including inefficient queries generated by ORMs such as Prisma and Mongoose.
  • Own data-layer capacity planning and cost per request alongside latency.
  • Set engineering standards: design and query review for hot paths, migration standards, CI regression gates, and load testing at production-realistic volumes.
  • Review architecture proposals from feature teams, and write the design docs others build from.

🧑‍💻 Who we're looking for

Required

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with 3+ where performance and scale were a named part of your job.
  • Performance ownership of a multi-tenant SaaS product under real load.
  • Systems you designed yourself, including the alternatives you rejected and the tradeoffs you accepted.
  • A concrete track record: a problem you diagnosed, its root cause, your fix, and the before-and-after numbers.
  • Strong system design judgement across caching, sharding, CQRS, queues, real-time delivery (WebSockets/SSE), autoscaling, high availability and resilience patterns. Knowing when not to use one matters more to us than listing its benefits.
  • Real depth in at least two of PostgreSQL/MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB and Redis, with working competence in the rest.
  • Production ownership of Node.js/TypeScript services, and a solid understanding of how ORMs and ODMs such as Prisma and Mongoose generate queries.
  • Hands-on Datadog APM and tracing experience (or equivalent), plus production experience on AWS (ECS/EKS), including the cost behaviour of managed data services.
  • Clear writing: design docs a team can build from and an executive can follow.

🗄️ Data layer depth

Nobody is deep in all four engines, and we'd rather you tell us where you are. Across your areas of depth, we expect you to reason about:

  • Relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL): execution plans as routine, composite and partial indexes and their write cost, locking, isolation levels, connection pooling and replica lag.
  • Document (MongoDB): embedding vs referencing, shard key selection, aggregation performance and working set sizing.
  • Key-value: access-pattern-first modelling, partition keys, hot partition avoidance, secondary indexes and capacity cost.
  • In-memory cache (Redis/Memcached): caching patterns, key design, eviction and TTL, and system behaviour when the cache is cold or unavailable.
  • Across engines: consistency boundaries, dual-write problems, and recognising when a query problem is really an application design problem.

🌟 What success looks like

  • Diagnosis: latency is attributed to real causes with evidence, and per-tenant investigations end with clear answers.
  • Design: critical paths have documented designs others can reason about, store selection is deliberate and written down, and queues behave predictably under load.
  • Measurable improvement: meaningful latency reduction on the highest-cost paths, with before-and-after numbers, and cost per request trending down.
  • Prevention: design and query review is standard practice for hot paths, regressions are caught before merge, and migration standards are followed across teams.
  • Partnership: feature teams bring you proposals early because you make them better, not slower.

➕ Nice to have

APM, error tracking and database performance tooling using tools like Datadog and Sentry · event streaming or messaging at scale · real-time delivery and fan-out at scale (Socket.IO) · third-party integrations where latency is outside your control · noisy-neighbour and tenant isolation · load testing tools and building that capability · SLOs and error budgets · infrastructure as code

🚫 What this role is not

  • Not a DBA role. Backups, patching and routine operations sit with DevOps. You set the performance requirements.
  • Not feature work. Your output is latency removed and regressions prevented.
  • Not a management role today. Leading the function as it grows is an open conversation.

💎 Why join

  • Shape the performance function and its priorities from day one.
  • Have direct influence on architecture across every engineering team.
  • Work on a polyglot stack at real scale.

📋 Practicalities

  • Location: Remote (Pakistan preferred)
  • Type: Full-time, permanent
  • Level: Senior individual contributor, no direct reports
  • Compensation: Market competitive
  • On-call: Part of the escalation rota
Salary: Market Competitive

We're scaling into a cell-based architecture, and the number of cells we run is growing fast, taking our Kubernetes footprint from dozens of clusters toward hundreds. That takes the platform in three directions at once: infrastructure configuration becomes a first-class layer with its own lifecycle, independent of application code; provisioning a new cell becomes a days-long automated operation rather than a multi-week effort; and cross-cell control points become standard, reusable, and consistent everywhere.

This is a Principal Engineer role with real breadth within the cloud platform. You'll set the architectural roadmap for our cloud, Kubernetes, and storage platform as it scales with AlphaSense's growth, and take dedicated ownership of the cloud-side configuration and Helm chart layer that every service depends on. Data storages are a critical part of this surface, and we're looking for genuine depth there.

It requires a deep cloud of both operational and software development skills, the ability to lead ambitious technical programmes, and the credibility to set direction with Engineering leaders and very senior engineers across dozens of teams.

We're looking for someone who genuinely embraces AI tooling in their day-to-day work, appreciates the productivity value it brings, and is motivated to make our infrastructure ever-more AI friendly.

  • Own the architectural roadmap for our cloud, Kubernetes, and storage platform
  • Own cloud-side configuration and the Helm chart layer for Cloud Core
  • Build the cell registry and automate provisioning to take new cell setup from weeks to days
  • Design the cross-cell gate mechanism as the reusable standard checkpoint across every cell
  • Own, operate and evolve our Cloud and Kubernetes platform, including our data storage layers
  • Make operations (upgrades, patching, lifecycle management) routine across hundreds of clusters
  • Continuously improve the security, reliability, cost efficiency and performance of our infrastructure
  • Champion standards and drive initiatives to promote uniformisation and eliminate duplication
  • Enable truly self-service and agentic workflow patterns that support a Build it - Own it model

  • Strong knowledge of data storages across SQL, MongoDB, ClickHouse and Elasticsearch
  • Strong operational and troubleshooting skill with Kubernetes, databases and messaging systems
  • Deep understanding of networking and production level usage of service meshes and gateways
  • Experience separating infrastructure configuration from application code at scale
  • Experience with cell-based, multi-tenant or multi-region architectures
  • Proficiency in Python and Golang
  • Evangelist of highly performant CI/CD practices that are supportive of agentic workflows
  • Ability and desire to design, lead, influence and deliver on ambitious technical roadmaps
